These insights offer actionable strategies for developing scalable, environmentally responsible artificial intelligence systems.

title: LightSBB-M: Bridging Schrödinger and Bass for Generative Diffusion Modeling
summary: The Schrodinger Bridge and Bass (SBB) formulation, which jointly controls drift and volatility, is an established extension of the classical Schrodinger Bridge (SB). Building on this framework, we introduce LightSBB-M, an algorithm that computes the optimal SBB transport plan in only a few iterations. The method exploits a dual representation of the SBB objective to obtain analytic expressions for the optimal drift and volatility, and it incorporates a tunable parameter beta greater than zero that interpolates between pure drift (the Schrodinger Bridge) and pure volatility (Bass martingale transport). We show that LightSBB-M achieves the lowest 2-Wasserstein distance on synthetic datasets against state-of-the-art SB and diffusion baselines with up to 32 percent improvement. We also illustrate the generative capability of the framework on an unpaired image-to-image translation task (adult to child faces in FFHQ). These findings demonstrate that LightSBB-M provides a scalable, high-fidelity SBB solver that outperforms existing SB and diffusion baselines across both synthetic and real-world generative tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/alexouadi/LightSBB-M.

title: Instance-Guided Radar Depth Estimation for 3D Object Detection
summary: Accurate depth estimation is fundamental to 3D perception in autonomous driving, supporting tasks such as detection, tracking, and motion planning. However, monocular camera-based 3D detection suffers from depth ambiguity and reduced robustness under challenging conditions. Radar provides complementary advantages such as resilience to poor lighting and adverse weather, but its sparsity and low resolution limit its direct use in detection frameworks. This motivates the need for effective Radar-camera fusion with improved preprocessing and depth estimation strategies. We propose an end-to-end framework that enhances monocular 3D object detection through two key components. First, we introduce InstaRadar, an instance segmentation-guided expansion method that leverages pre-trained segmentation masks to enhance Radar density and semantic alignment, producing a more structured representation. InstaRadar achieves state-of-the-art results in Radar-guided depth estimation, showing its effectiveness in generating high-quality depth features. Second, we integrate the pre-trained RCDPT into the BEVDepth framework as a replacement for its depth module. With InstaRadar-enhanced inputs, the RCDPT integration consistently improves 3D detection performance. Overall, these components yield steady gains over the baseline BEVDepth model, demonstrating the effectiveness of InstaRadar and the advantage of explicit depth supervision in 3D object detection. Although the framework lags behind Radar-camera fusion models that directly extract BEV features, since Radar serves only as guidance rather than an independent feature stream, this limitation highlights potential for improvement. Future work will extend InstaRadar to point cloud-like representations and integrate a dedicated Radar branch with temporal cues for enhanced BEV fusion.

title: Generalizable IoT Traffic Representations for Cross-Network Device Identification
summary: Machine learning models have demonstrated strong performance in classifying network traffic and identifying Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices, enabling operators to discover and manage IoT assets at scale. However, many existing approaches rely on end-to-end supervised pipelines or task-specific fine-tuning, resulting in traffic representations that are tightly coupled to labeled datasets and deployment environments, which can limit generalizability. In this paper, we study the problem of learning generalizable traffic representations for IoT device identification. We design compact encoder architectures that learn per-flow embeddings from unlabeled IoT traffic and evaluate them using a frozen-encoder protocol with a simple supervised classifier. Our specific contributions are threefold. (1) We develop unsupervised encoder--decoder models that learn compact traffic representations from unlabeled IoT network flows and assess their quality through reconstruction-based analysis. (2) We show that these learned representations can be used effectively for IoT device-type classification using simple, lightweight classifiers trained on frozen embeddings. (3) We provide a systematic benchmarking study against the state-of-the-art pretrained traffic encoders, showing that larger models do not necessarily yield more robust representations for IoT traffic. Using more than 18 million real IoT traffic flows collected across multiple years and deployment environments, we learn traffic representations from unlabeled data and evaluate device-type classification on disjoint labeled subsets, achieving macro F1-scores exceeding 0.9 for device-type classification and demonstrating robustness under cross-environment deployment.

title: Modeling Sampling Workflows for Code Repositories
summary: Empirical software engineering research often depends on datasets of code repository artifacts, where sampling strategies are employed to enable large-scale analyses. The design and evaluation of these strategies are critical, as they directly influence the generalizability of research findings. However, sampling remains an underestimated aspect in software engineering research: we identify two main challenges related to (1) the design and representativeness of sampling approaches, and (2) the ability to reason about the implications of sampling decisions on generalizability. To address these challenges, we propose a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) to explicitly describe complex sampling strategies through composable sampling operators. This formalism supports both the specification and the reasoning about the generalizability of results based on the applied sampling strategies. We implement the DSL as a Python-based fluent API, and demonstrate how it facilitates representativeness reasoning using statistical indicators extracted from sampling workflows. We validate our approach through a case study of MSR papers involving code repository sampling. Our results show that the DSL can model the sampling strategies reported in recent literature.

title: Perception-to-Pursuit: Track-Centric Temporal Reasoning for Open-World Drone Detection and Autonomous Chasing
comments: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 15 references. Intended for submission to ICCV 2027
summary: Autonomous drone pursuit requires not only detecting drones but also predicting their trajectories in a manner that enables kinematically feasible interception. Existing tracking methods optimize for prediction accuracy but ignore pursuit feasibility, resulting in trajectories that are physically impossible to intercept 99.9% of the time. We propose Perception-to-Pursuit (P2P), a track-centric temporal reasoning framework that bridges detection and actionable pursuit planning. Our method represents drone motion as compact 8-dimensional tokens capturing velocity, acceleration, scale, and smoothness, enabling a 12-frame causal transformer to reason about future behavior. We introduce the Intercept Success Rate (ISR) metric to measure pursuit feasibility under realistic interceptor constraints. Evaluated on the Anti-UAV-RGBT dataset with 226 real drone sequences, P2P achieves 28.12 pixel average displacement error and 0.597 ISR, representing a 77% improvement in trajectory prediction and 597x improvement in pursuit feasibility over tracking-only baselines, while maintaining perfect drone classification accuracy (100%). Our work demonstrates that temporal reasoning over motion patterns enables both accurate prediction and actionable pursuit planning.

title: StableQAT: Stable Quantization-Aware Training at Ultra-Low Bitwidths
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is essential for deploying large models under strict memory and latency constraints, yet achieving stable and robust optimization at ultra-low bitwidths remains challenging. Common approaches based on the straight-through estimator (STE) or soft quantizers often suffer from gradient mismatch, instability, or high computational overhead. As such, we propose StableQAT, a unified and efficient QAT framework that stabilizes training in ultra low-bit settings via a novel, lightweight, and theoretically grounded surrogate for backpropagation derived from a discrete Fourier analysis of the rounding operator. StableQAT strictly generalizes STE as the latter arises as a special case of our more expressive surrogate family, yielding smooth, bounded, and inexpensive gradients that improve QAT training performance and stability across various hyperparameter choices. In experiments, StableQAT exhibits stable and efficient QAT at 2-4 bit regimes, demonstrating improved training stability, robustness, and superior performance with negligible training overhead against standard QAT techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StableQAT.

title: Polyhedral design with blended $n$-sided interpolants
summary: A new parametric surface representation is proposed that interpolates the vertices of a given closed mesh of arbitrary topology. Smoothly connecting quadrilateral patches are created by blending local, multi-sided quadratic interpolants. In the non-four-sided case, this requires a special parameterization technique involving rational curves. Appropriate handling of triangular subpatches and alternative subpatch representations are also discussed.

title: Innovator-VL: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Scientific Discovery
summary: We present Innovator-VL, a scientific multimodal large language model designed to advance understanding and reasoning across diverse scientific domains while maintaining excellent performance on general vision tasks. Contrary to the trend of relying on massive domain-specific pretraining and opaque pipelines, our work demonstrates that principled training design and transparent methodology can yield strong scientific intelligence with substantially reduced data requirements. (i) First, we provide a fully transparent, end-to-end reproducible training pipeline, covering data collection, cleaning, preprocessing, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation, along with detailed optimization recipes. This facilitates systematic extension by the community. (ii) Second, Innovator-VL exhibits remarkable data efficiency, achieving competitive performance on various scientific tasks using fewer than five million curated samples without large-scale pretraining. These results highlight that effective reasoning can be achieved through principled data selection rather than indiscriminate scaling. (iii) Third, Innovator-VL demonstrates strong generalization, achieving competitive performance on general vision, multimodal reasoning, and scientific benchmarks. This indicates that scientific alignment can be integrated into a unified model without compromising general-purpose capabilities. Our practices suggest that efficient, reproducible, and high-performing scientific multimodal models can be built even without large-scale data, providing a practical foundation for future research.

title: CaseMaster: Designing and Evaluating a Probe for Oral Case Presentation Training with LLM Assistance
comments: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '26), April 13--17, 2026, Barcelona, Spain
summary: Preparing an oral case presentation (OCP) is a crucial skill for medical students, requiring clear communication of patient information, clinical findings, and treatment plans. However, inconsistent student participation and limited guidance can make this task challenging. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can provide structured content to streamline the process, their role in facilitating skill development and supporting medical education integration remains underexplored. To address this, we conducted a formative study with six medical educators and developed CaseMaster, an interactive probe that leverages LLM-generated content tailored to medical education to help users enhance their OCP skills. The controlled study suggests CaseMaster has the potential to both improve presentation quality and reduce workload compared to traditional methods, an implication reinforced by expert feedback. We propose guidelines for educators to develop adaptive, user-centered training methods using LLMs, while considering the implications of integrating advanced technologies into medical education.

title: Metric $k$-clustering using only Weak Comparison Oracles
summary:
Clustering is a fundamental primitive in unsupervised learning. However, classical algorithms for $k$-clustering (such as $k$-median and $k$-means) assume access to exact pairwise distances -- an unrealistic requirement in many modern applications. We study clustering in the \emph{Rank-model (R-model)}, where access to distances is entirely replaced by a \emph{quadruplet oracle} that provides only relative distance comparisons. In practice, such an oracle can represent learned models or human feedback, and is expected to be noisy and entail an access cost.
  Given a metric space with $n$ input items, we design randomized algorithms that, using only a noisy quadruplet oracle, compute a set of $O(k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ centers along with a mapping from the input items to the centers such that the clustering cost of the mapping is at most constant times the optimum $k$-clustering cost. Our method achieves a query complexity of $O(n\cdot k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ for arbitrary metric spaces and improves to $O((n+k^2) \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ when the underlying metric has bounded doubling dimension. When the metric has bounded doubling dimension we can further improve the approximation from constant to $1+\varepsilon$, for any arbitrarily small constant $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, while preserving the same asymptotic query complexity. Our framework demonstrates how noisy, low-cost oracles, such as those derived from large language models, can be systematically integrated into scalable clustering algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 仅使用弱比较预言机的度量 $k$-聚类
AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于仅提供相对距离比较的噪声预言机（四元组预言机）进行 $k$-聚类的新方法，避免了对精确距离的依赖。该方法在一般情况下能达到常数倍近似，在特定（有界双倍维度）情况下可达到 $1+\varepsilon$ 近似，展示了将低成本、噪声反馈集成到可扩展聚类算法中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 经典的 $k$-聚类算法（如 $k$-中值和 $k$-均值）要求访问精确的成对距离，这在许多现代应用中是不切实际的。因此，研究在“排名模型”（R-model）下进行聚类，其中仅使用提供相对距离比较的“四元组预言机”。
AI.method: 设计了随机算法，仅使用带噪声的四元组预言机，计算 $O(k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ 个中心，并提供了一个聚类成本至多为最优 $k$-聚类成本常数倍的映射。对于具有有界双倍维度的度量，进一步实现了 $1+\varepsilon$ 近似，同时保持相同的渐近查询复杂度。
AI.result: 在任意度量空间中，查询复杂度为 $O(n\cdot k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$，可将聚类成本限制在最优值的常数倍内。当度量具有有界双倍维度时，查询复杂度改进为 $O((n+k^2) \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$，并且可以将近似比提高到 $1+\varepsilon$。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了如何将噪声的、低成本的预言机（例如源自大型语言模型的预言机）系统地集成到可扩展的聚类算法中，实现了对最优 $k$-聚类成本的常数倍近似，并在特定条件下实现了 $1+\varepsilon$ 近似。
AI.translation: 聚类是无监督学习中的一个基本原语。然而，经典的 $k$-聚类算法（如 $k$-中值和 $k$-均值）假设可以访问精确的成对距离——这在许多现代应用中是不切实际的要求。我们在“排名模型”（R-model）中研究聚类，其中对距离的访问完全被一个仅提供相对距离比较的“四元组预言机”所取代。在实践中，这种预言机可以代表学习到的模型或人类反馈，并且预计是带噪声的并会产生访问成本。给定一个具有 $n$ 个输入项的度量空间，我们设计了随机算法，仅使用一个带噪声的四元组预言机，计算一组 $O(k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ 个中心，以及一个从输入项到中心的映射，使得该映射的聚类成本至多是最佳 $k$-聚类成本的常数倍。我们的方法在任意度量空间中实现了 $O(n\cdot k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$ 的查询复杂度，当底层度量具有有界双倍维度时，改进到 $O((n+k^2) \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$。当度量具有有界双倍维度时，我们还可以进一步将近似值从常数倍提高到 $1+\varepsilon$，其中 $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ 是任意小的常数，同时保持相同的渐近查询复杂度。我们的框架展示了如何将噪声的、低成本的预言机（如源自大型语言模型的预言机）系统地集成到可扩展的聚类算法中。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在“排名模型”下使用仅提供相对距离比较的带噪声“四元组预言机”进行度量 $k$-聚类的问题，以替代对精确距离的依赖。研究人员设计了随机算法，在任意度量空间中实现了最优 $k$-聚类成本的常数倍近似，查询复杂度为 $O(n\cdot k \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$。对于具有有界双倍维度的度量，查询复杂度可改进至 $O((n+k^2) \cdot \mathsf{polylog}(n))$，并且可以将近似比进一步提高到 $1+\varepsilon$。
AI.keywords: 度量聚类, 弱比较预言机, 四元组预言机, 排名模型, 近似算法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于用仅提供相对距离比较的“四元组预言机”取代了对精确成对距离的依赖，这在许多现代应用中更具现实意义。它展示了如何将基于噪声的低成本预言机（如来自大型语言模型的反馈）系统地集成到可扩展的聚类算法中，并针对不同度量空间（特别是具有有界双倍维度的空间）提供了优于常数倍的近似保证。限制在于其近似比在一般度量空间中仍为常数倍，而非 $1+\varepsilon$。

title: When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs
summary: Benchmark-based evaluation is the de facto standard for comparing large language models (LLMs). However, its reliability is increasingly threatened by test set contamination, where test samples or their close variants leak into training data and artificially inflate reported performance. To address this issue, prior work has explored two main lines of mitigation. One line attempts to identify and remove contaminated benchmark items before evaluation, but this inevitably alters the evaluation set itself and becomes unreliable when contamination is moderate or severe. The other line preserves the benchmark and instead suppresses contaminated behavior at evaluation time; however, such interventions often interfere with normal inference and lead to noticeable performance degradation on clean inputs. We propose DeconIEP, a decontamination framework that operates entirely during evaluation by applying small, bounded perturbations in the input embedding space. Guided by a relatively less-contaminated reference model, DeconIEP learns an instance-adaptive perturbation generator that steers the evaluated model away from memorization-driven shortcut pathways. Across multiple open-weight LLMs and benchmarks, extensive empirical results show that DeconIEP achieves strong decontamination effectiveness while incurring only minimal degradation in benign utility.

AI.title_translation: 当基准测试泄露时：LLM的推理时间去污
AI.tldr: 测试集污染影响LLM评估的可靠性。本文提出了DeconIEP，一种在推理时工作的去污框架，它使用一个参考模型来指导，通过在嵌入空间中添加微小、自适应的扰动来阻止模型利用训练数据中泄露的知识，从而在有效去污的同时保持了模型在干净数据上的性能。
AI.motivation: 基准测试评估是比较LLM的标准方法，但测试集污染（测试样本或其变体泄露到训练数据中）正威胁着评估的可靠性。现有方法要么修改评估集，要么在评估时抑制污染行为但会损害正常推理。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DeconIEP的去污框架，该框架完全在评估期间运行，通过在输入嵌入空间中应用小的、有界的扰动来实现。它以一个相对污染较少的参考模型为指导，学习一个实例自适应的扰动生成器，将被评估的模型引向远离记忆驱动的捷径路径。
AI.result: DeconIEP在多个开源LLM和基准测试上实现了强大的去污效果，同时仅对良性输入的效用造成了极小的退化。
AI.conclusion: DeconIEP在多个开源LLM和基准测试上展示了强大的去污效果，同时对良性输入的性能损失极小。
AI.translation: 基准测试驱动的评估是比较大型语言模型（LLMs）的既定标准。然而，其可靠性正日益受到测试集污染的威胁，即测试样本或其紧密变体泄露到训练数据中，人为地夸大了报告的性能。为了解决这个问题，先前的研究探索了两种主要的缓解途径。一种途径试图在评估前识别并移除受污染的基准项，但这不可避免地改变了评估集本身，并在污染中度或严重时变得不可靠。另一种途径保留基准测试，而是在评估时抑制受污染的行为；然而，这种干预通常会干扰正常的推理，并导致在干净输入上的性能出现明显的下降。我们提出了DeconIEP，一个完全在评估期间运行的去污框架，它通过在输入嵌入空间中应用小的、有界的扰动来实现。在相对污染较少的参考模型的指导下，DeconIEP学习了一个实例自适应的扰动生成器，使被评估的模型远离记忆驱动的捷径路径。跨多个开源LLM和基准测试的广泛实证结果表明，DeconIEP实现了强大的去污效果，同时仅对良性输入的效用造成了极小的退化。
AI.summary: 为了解决大型语言模型（LLM）评估中日益严重的测试集污染问题，本文提出了DeconIEP框架。该框架完全在推理阶段操作，通过学习一个实例自适应的扰动生成器，在输入嵌入空间中施加微小扰动，以引导模型避开记忆驱动的捷径。实验证明，DeconIEP在有效去污的同时，对模型在干净输入上的性能影响极小。
AI.keywords: 测试集污染, LLM评估, 推理时去污, 扰动生成, 基准测试
AI.comments: DeconIEP的创新之处在于它在推理时（Evaluation-time）进行去污，并且通过学习实例自适应的扰动来避免干扰正常推理，这与以往预先移除测试样本或在推理时进行粗暴干预的方法形成了对比。其局限性在于性能的提升依赖于一个“相对污染较少的参考模型”。

title: From Observations to Events: Event-Aware World Model for Reinforcement Learning
summary: While model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) improves sample efficiency by learning world models from raw observations, existing methods struggle to generalize across structurally similar scenes and remain vulnerable to spurious variations such as textures or color shifts. From a cognitive science perspective, humans segment continuous sensory streams into discrete events and rely on these key events for decision-making. Motivated by this principle, we propose the Event-Aware World Model (EAWM), a general framework that learns event-aware representations to streamline policy learning without requiring handcrafted labels. EAWM employs an automated event generator to derive events from raw observations and introduces a Generic Event Segmentor (GES) to identify event boundaries, which mark the start and end time of event segments. Through event prediction, the representation space is shaped to capture meaningful spatio-temporal transitions. Beyond this, we present a unified formulation of seemingly distinct world model architectures and show the broad applicability of our methods. Experiments on Atari 100K, Craftax 1M, and DeepMind Control 500K, DMC-GB2 500K demonstrate that EAWM consistently boosts the performance of strong MBRL baselines by 10%-45%, setting new state-of-the-art results across benchmarks. Our code is released at https://github.com/MarquisDarwin/EAWM.

AI.title_translation: 从观察到事件：用于强化学习的事件感知世界模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为EAWM的事件感知世界模型框架，通过自动生成和分割事件来改进模型学习，以解决现有模型在结构相似场景中的泛化能力不足和对纹理/颜色变化的脆弱性问题。实验证明EAWM能显著提升强化学习基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的强化学习方法在泛化到结构相似的场景以及应对纹理或颜色变化等虚假变化方面存在困难。受人类将连续感官流分割成离散事件并依赖这些关键事件进行决策的认知科学原理启发，提出EAWM以改进模型学习。
AI.method: EAWM框架通过自动事件生成器从原始观察中提取事件，并引入通用事件分割器（GES）来识别事件边界。通过事件预测来塑造表示空间，使其能够捕捉有意义的时空转换。此外，还提出了一种统一的公式来处理不同的世界模型架构。
AI.result: 在Atari 100K、Craftax 1M和DeepMind Control 500K、DMC-GB2 500K的实验中，EAWM consistently将强模型基线的性能提升了10%-45%，并在各基准测试中创下新的最先进成果。
AI.conclusion: EAWM通过学习事件感知表示来简化策略学习，无需手工标注，并在多个基准测试中显著提高了模型基线的性能，展示了其广泛的适用性。
AI.translation: 虽然基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过从原始观察中学习世界模型来提高样本效率，但现有方法在泛化到结构相似的场景方面存在困难，并且容易受到诸如纹理或颜色变化之类的虚假变化的影响。从认知科学的角度来看，人类将连续的感官流分割成离散的事件，并依赖这些关键事件进行决策。受这一原理的启发，我们提出了事件感知世界模型（EAWM），一个通用的框架，它学习事件感知的表示来简化策略学习，而无需手工制作的标签。EAWM采用自动事件生成器从原始观察中导出事件，并引入通用事件分割器（GES）来识别事件边界，这些边界标志着事件片段的开始和结束时间。通过事件预测，表示空间被塑造为捕获有意义的时空转换。除此之外，我们还提出了一个统一的公式来处理看似不同的世界模型架构，并展示了我们方法的广泛适用性。在Atari 100K、Craftax 1M和DeepMind Control 500K、DMC-GB2 500K上的实验表明，EAWM始终将强大的MBRL基线的性能提高了10%-45%，并在基准测试中创造了新的最先进成果。我们的代码发布在https://github.com/MarquisDarwin/EAWM。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种事件感知世界模型（EAWM）框架，旨在解决现有模型在泛化和鲁棒性方面的问题。EAWM通过自动生成和分割事件来学习事件感知表示，从而在无需手工标注的情况下简化策略学习。实验结果表明，EAWM能够显著提升多种强化学习基线的性能，并在多个基准测试中达到最先进水平。
AI.keywords: 事件感知世界模型, 强化学习, 模型学习, 事件分割, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 该研究提出的EAWM框架在解决模型泛化和鲁棒性问题上具有创新性，通过借鉴人类的事件感知机制，为模型学习提供了新的思路。自动事件生成和通用事件分割器的设计是该方法的关键亮点。然而，事件生成和分割的自动化程度和准确性可能对最终性能产生影响，这可能是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。代码的公开有助于该方法的复现和进一步发展。

title: SETA: Statistical Fault Attribution for Compound AI Systems
comments: Accepted to CAIN 2026 co-hosted with ICSE 2026
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly comprise multiple interconnected neural networks to tackle complex inference tasks. Testing such systems for robustness and safety entails significant challenges. Current state-of-the-art robustness testing techniques, whether black-box or white-box, have been proposed and implemented for single-network models and do not scale well to multi-network pipelines. We propose a modular robustness testing framework that applies a given set of perturbations to test data. Our testing framework supports (1) a component-wise system analysis to isolate errors and (2) reasoning about error propagation across the neural network modules. The testing framework is architecture and modality agnostic and can be applied across domains. We apply the framework to a real-world autonomous rail inspection system composed of multiple deep networks and successfully demonstrate how our approach enables fine-grained robustness analysis beyond conventional end-to-end metrics.
comment: Accepted to CAIN 2026 co-hosted with ICSE 2026

AI.title_translation: SETA：面向复合人工智能系统的统计故障归因
AI.tldr: SETA是一个新的框架，用于测试由多个相互连接的神经网络组成的复杂AI系统的鲁棒性。它通过组件级分析和错误传播推理来隔离和理解错误，并且独立于架构和模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒性测试技术难以扩展到由多个相互连接的神经网络组成的复杂AI系统，并且在测试这些系统的鲁棒性和安全性方面带来了重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个模块化的鲁棒性测试框架，该框架将一组给定的扰动应用于测试数据。该框架支持组件级系统分析以隔离错误，并推理跨神经网络模块的错误传播。该框架独立于架构和模式，可跨领域应用。
AI.result: 在由多个深度网络组成的真实世界自动轨道检测系统中成功应用了该框架，证明了该方法能够进行精细的鲁棒性分析，超越了传统的端到端指标。
AI.conclusion: SETA框架能够对复合AI系统的鲁棒性进行精细化分析，克服了现有技术难以扩展到多网络管线的局限性。
AI.translation: 现代人工智能系统越来越多地由多个相互连接的神经网络组成，以处理复杂的推理任务。测试这些系统的鲁棒性和安全性带来了重大挑战。当前最先进的鲁棒性测试技术，无论是黑盒还是白盒，都已针对单网络模型提出并实现，但不能很好地扩展到多网络管线。我们提出一个模块化的鲁棒性测试框架，该框架将一组给定的扰动应用于测试数据。我们的测试框架支持（1）组件级的系统分析以隔离错误，以及（2）推理跨神经网络模块的错误传播。该测试框架独立于架构和模式，可跨领域应用。我们将该框架应用于一个由多个深度网络组成的真实世界自动轨道检测系统，并成功证明了我们的方法如何能够实现超越传统端到端指标的精细鲁棒性分析。
AI.summary: SETA是一个新颖的模块化鲁棒性测试框架，用于评估由多个相互连接的神经网络组成的复合AI系统的稳健性。它通过组件级分析和错误传播推理来隔离和理解错误，并且独立于架构和模式。在自动轨道检测系统上的应用证明了其超越传统端到端指标的精细分析能力。
AI.keywords: 复合AI系统, 鲁棒性测试, 故障归因, 模块化框架, 错误传播
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个名为SETA的创新框架，解决了当前AI系统中普遍存在的复合系统鲁棒性测试难题。SETA通过其模块化设计和对错误传播的推理能力，有效地克服了传统方法在扩展性上的限制。该框架的架构和模式无关性使其具有广泛的应用前景。然而，对该方法在不同类型复合系统上的实际性能和计算开销的进一步评估将是有价值的。

title: The Psychological Science of Artificial Intelligence: A Rapidly Emerging Field of Psychology
summary: The psychological science of artificial intelligence (AI) can be broadly defined as an emerging field of psychology that examines all AI-related mental and behavioral processes from the perspective of psychology. This field has been growing exponentially in the recent decade. This review synthesizes the existing literature on the psychological science of AI with a goal to provide a comprehensive conceptual framework for planning, conducting, and assessing scientific research in the field. It consists of six parts, starting with an overview of the entire field of the psychological science of artificial intelligence, then synthesizing the literature in each of the four specific areas (i.e., Psychology of designing AI, psychology of using AI, AI for examining psychological processes, and AI for advancing psychological methods), and concluding with an outlook on the field in the future.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能的心理科学：一个快速兴起的心理学领域
AI.tldr: 人工智能的心理科学是一个新兴的心理学领域，研究AI相关的心理和行为过程。该领域在过去十年中呈指数级增长。本文综述了该领域的现有文献，旨在为研究提供一个全面的概念框架，涵盖AI设计心理学、AI使用心理学、AI用于检验心理过程以及AI用于推进心理学方法等四个具体领域，并对该领域的未来进行了展望。
AI.motivation: 人工智能的心理科学（AI心理学）作为一个新兴领域，其研究涵盖了所有与AI相关的心理和行为过程。该领域在过去十年中快速增长，需要一个全面的概念框架来指导和评估相关研究。
AI.method: 本文通过对现有文献进行综合，构建了一个全面的概念框架。该框架分为六个部分：首先概述整个AI心理学领域，然后分别综述AI设计心理学、AI使用心理学、AI用于检验心理过程以及AI用于推进心理学方法这四个具体领域的文献，最后对该领域的未来进行展望。
AI.result: 本文成功地综合了AI心理学领域的现有文献，并提出了一个全面的概念框架，为该领域的研究规划、实施和评估提供了指导。
AI.conclusion: AI心理学是一个快速发展的领域，需要一个结构化的框架来指导未来的研究，包括AI的设计、使用、以及AI在心理学研究中的应用。
AI.translation: 人工智能的心理科学（AI心理学）可以广义地定义为心理学中一个新兴的领域，它从心理学的角度考察所有与人工智能相关的心理和行为过程。在最近十年中，该领域得到了指数级的增长。本综述旨在综合AI心理学领域的现有文献，以提供一个全面的概念框架，用于规划、进行和评估该领域内的科学研究。它包含六个部分，首先概述整个AI心理科学领域，然后综合四个具体领域的文献（即AI设计心理学、AI使用心理学、AI用于检验心理过程以及AI用于推进心理学方法），最后对该领域的未来进行展望。
AI.summary: 本文对人工智能的心理科学（AI心理学）进行了综述，该领域研究AI相关的心理和行为过程，并在过去十年中快速发展。文章提出了一个全面的概念框架，用于指导AI心理学领域的研究，该框架涵盖了AI设计、AI使用、AI在心理学研究中的应用以及AI对心理学方法的贡献，并对该领域的未来发展进行了展望。
AI.keywords: 人工智能心理学,AI设计,AI使用,心理学方法,未来展望
AI.comments: 该综述有效地梳理了AI心理学这一新兴领域的研究现状，并提供了一个结构化的框架，对于该领域未来的研究具有重要的指导意义。然而，文章可能可以更深入地探讨AI技术对人类认知和社会行为的具体影响，以及伦理方面的考量。

title: Eco-Driving Control for Electric Vehicles with Multi-Speed Transmission: Optimizing Vehicle Speed and Powertrain Operation in Dynamic Environments
comments: Accepted by SAE International Journal of Connected and Automated Vehicles
summary: This article presents an eco-driving algorithm for electric vehicles featuring multi-speed transmissions. The proposed controller is formulated as a co-optimization problem, simultaneously optimizing both vehicle longitudinal speed and powertrain operation to maximize energy efficiency. Constraints derived from a connected vehicle based traffic prediction algorithm are used to ensure traffic safety and smooth traffic flow in dynamic environments with multiple signalized intersections and mixed traffic. By simplifying the complex, nonlinear mixed integer problem, the proposed controller achieves computational efficiency, enabling real-time implementation. To evaluate its performance, traffic scenarios from both Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) and real-world road tests are employed. The results demonstrate a notable reduction in energy consumption by up to 11.36\% over an \SI{18}{\km} drive.
comment: Accepted by SAE International Journal of Connected and Automated Vehicles

AI.title_translation: 配备多速变速器的电动汽车的生态驾驶控制：动态环境中车辆速度和动力系统操作的优化
AI.tldr: 开发了一种用于多速电动汽车的生态驾驶控制器，通过同时优化速度和动力系统操作，并利用交通预测约束，实现了实时、高效的节能，在测试中能耗降低了超过11%。
AI.motivation: 针对配备多速变速器的电动汽车，开发一种生态驾驶算法，旨在动态环境中通过同时优化车辆速度和动力系统操作来最大化能源效率，并确保交通安全和流畅。
AI.method: 将生态驾驶控制问题表述为一个协同优化问题，同时优化车辆纵向速度和动力系统操作。使用基于车联网的交通预测算法推导的约束，以确保在动态环境中的交通安全和流畅。通过简化复杂的非线性混合整数问题，实现了计算效率以支持实时实施。
AI.result: 在18公里的驾驶过程中，能耗降低了高达11.36%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的控制器在SUMO模拟和真实道路测试中均验证了其性能，实现了高达11.36%的能耗降低。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于配备多速变速器的电动汽车的生态驾驶算法。所提出的控制器被表述为一个协同优化问题，同时优化车辆纵向速度和动力系统操作，以最大化能源效率。源自基于车联网的交通预测算法的约束被用于确保在具有多个信号灯路口和混合交通的动态环境中交通安全和流畅。通过简化复杂的非线性混合整数问题，所提出的控制器实现了计算效率，从而能够实时实施。为评估其性能，采用了来自城市交通模拟（SUMO）和真实道路测试的交通场景。结果表明，在18公里的驾驶中，能耗显著降低了高达11.36%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对配备多速变速器的电动汽车的生态驾驶算法。该算法将车辆速度和动力系统操作的优化作为协同优化问题，同时考虑了基于车联网的交通预测约束，以确保动态环境下的安全和效率。该方法通过简化非线性问题实现了实时计算，并在模拟和实际测试中证明了高达11.36%的能耗降低效果。
AI.keywords: 电动汽车, 生态驾驶, 多速变速器, 协同优化, 能源效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将车辆纵向速度优化与多速变速器电动汽车的动力系统操作进行协同优化，以最大化能效。其重要性在于在复杂的动态交通环境中（如信号灯路口）实现了实时、高效的节能控制。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但实时性要求对算法的计算效率提出了较高要求。

title: Robust Uncertainty Estimation under Distribution Shift via Difference Reconstruction
summary: Estimating uncertainty in deep learning models is critical for reliable decision-making in high-stakes applications such as medical imaging. Prior research has established that the difference between an input sample and its reconstructed version produced by an auxiliary model can serve as a useful proxy for uncertainty. However, directly comparing reconstructions with the original input is degraded by information loss and sensitivity to superficial details, which limits its effectiveness. In this work, we propose Difference Reconstruction Uncertainty Estimation (DRUE), a method that mitigates this limitation by reconstructing inputs from two intermediate layers and measuring the discrepancy between their outputs as the uncertainty score. To evaluate uncertainty estimation in practice, we follow the widely used out-of-distribution (OOD) detection paradigm, where in-distribution (ID) training data are compared against datasets with increasing domain shift. Using glaucoma detection as the ID task, we demonstrate that DRUE consistently achieves superior AUC and AUPR across multiple OOD datasets, highlighting its robustness and reliability under distribution shift. This work provides a principled and effective framework for enhancing model reliability in uncertain environments.

AI.title_translation: 通过差异重建实现分布偏移下的鲁棒不确定性估计
AI.tldr: 提出DRUE，通过比较模型两个中间层重建的差异来估计不确定性，有效提高了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和可靠性，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在深度学习模型中估计不确定性对于高风险应用（如医学成像）中的可靠决策至关重要，但现有方法（使用输入与其重建版本之间的差异作为不确定性代理）因信息丢失和对表面细节敏感而效果受限。
AI.method: 提出差异重建不确定性估计 (DRUE) 方法，通过从两个中间层重建输入，并测量其输出之间的差异作为不确定性分数。
AI.result: 使用青光眼检测作为ID任务，DRUE在多个OOD数据集上持续实现了优越的AUC和AUPR，突显了其在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DRUE提供了一个原则性且有效的框架，用于增强模型在不确定环境下的可靠性。
AI.translation: 在深度学习模型中估计不确定性对于高风险应用（如医学成像）中的可靠决策至关重要。先前的研究已经证明，输入样本与其由辅助模型生成的重建版本之间的差异可以用作不确定性的有用代理。然而，直接比较重建与原始输入会因信息丢失和对表面细节的敏感性而受到影响，这限制了其有效性。在工作中，我们提出了差异重建不确定性估计（DRUE），一种通过从两个中间层重建输入并将它们的输出之间的差异作为不确定性分数来测量的，从而减轻这一限制的方法。为了在实践中评估不确定性估计，我们遵循广泛使用的域外（OOD）检测范式，其中将类内（ID）训练数据与具有增加的域偏移的数据集进行比较。使用青光眼检测作为ID任务，我们证明了DRUE在多个OOD数据集上持续实现了优越的AUC和AUPR，突显了其在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和可靠性。这项工作为增强模型在不确定环境下的可靠性提供了一个原则性且有效的框架。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统基于重建差异的不确定性估计方法在分布偏移下鲁棒性差的问题，提出了一种名为差异重建不确定性估计（DRUE）的新方法。DRUE通过比较从模型两个中间层重建输入的差异来量化不确定性，而不是直接比较原始输入与重建输出。实验证明，DRUE在青光眼检测的OOD场景中表现出优越的性能。
AI.keywords: 不确定性估计, 分布偏移, 差异重建, 领域泛化, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于使用两个中间层的重建输出来测量差异作为不确定性度量，从而克服了直接比较原始输入和重建输出时信息丢失和对表面细节敏感的问题。这对于在分布偏移下保证模型的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Modeling Behavioral Signals in Job Scams: A Human-Centered Security Study
summary: Job scams have emerged as a rapidly growing form of cybercrime that manipulates human decision-making processes. Existing countermeasures primarily focus on scam typologies or post-loss indicators, offering limited support for early-stage intervention. In this study, we examine how behavioral decision signals can be operationalized as computational features for identifying vulnerability-associated signals in job fraud. Using anonymous survey data collected from a university population, we analyze two dominant job scam pathways: payment-based scams that require upfront fees and task-based scams that begin with small rewards before escalating to financial demands. Drawing on behavioral economics, we operationalize sunk cost influence, urgency/time-pressure cues, and social proof as measurable behavioral signals, and analyze their association with payment behavior using exact inference under sparsity and uncertainty-aware estimation, with social proof treated as a context-dependent legitimacy cue rather than a standalone predictor. Our results show that urgency/time-pressure cues are significantly associated with payment behavior, consistent with their role as proximal compliance triggers during escalation. In contrast, opportunity-loss/FOMO cues were not reliably identifiable under the current operationalization in our encounter subset, highlighting the importance of measurement fidelity and cue-definition consistency. We further observe that emotional tone in victim narratives and selective non-response to sensitive questions vary systematically with financial loss and reporting behavior, suggesting that missingness may reflect a combination of survey fatigue and selective non-disclosure for sensitive items rather than purely random noise.

AI.title_translation: 模拟求职诈骗中的行为信号：一项以人为本的安全研究
AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析调查数据，将行为经济学概念（如紧迫性）转化为可计算的特征来识别求职诈骗中的脆弱性，发现紧迫性线索是支付行为的关键预测因素，并强调了测量准确性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有的对策主要关注诈骗类型或事后指标，对早期干预支持有限。本研究旨在研究如何将行为决策信号操作化为计算特征，以识别与脆弱性相关的求职欺诈信号。
AI.method: 使用大学人群匿名调查数据，分析基于支付和基于任务的两种主要诈骗路径。基于行为经济学，将沉没成本影响、紧迫性/时间压力线索和社会认同作为可测量的行为信号进行操作化，并使用稀疏性和不确定性感知估计下的精确推断分析其与支付行为的关联。社会认同被视为上下文依赖的合法性线索。
AI.result: 结果显示，紧迫性/时间压力线索与支付行为显著相关。与此相反，在当前的操作化下，错失恐惧/FOMO线索在样本子集中无法可靠识别。研究还观察到，受害者叙述中的情绪基调和对敏感问题的选择性不回应与经济损失和报告行为存在系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，紧迫性/时间压力线索与支付行为显著相关，表明它们是升级过程中的近端合规触发因素。此外，受害者叙述中的情绪基调和对敏感问题的选择性不回应与经济损失和报告行为系统相关，暗示缺失可能反映了调查疲劳和选择性不披露的组合。
AI.translation: 求职诈骗已成为一种快速增长的网络犯罪形式，它操纵了人类的决策过程。现有的对策主要集中在诈骗类型学或事后损失指标上，对早期干预的支持有限。在这项研究中，我们研究了如何将行为决策信号操作化为计算特征，以识别与脆弱性相关的求职欺诈信号。我们使用从大学人群中收集的匿名调查数据，分析了两种主要的求职诈骗途径：需要预先支付费用的基于支付的诈骗和以小额奖励开始，然后升级为财务要求的基于任务的诈骗。基于行为经济学，我们将沉没成本影响、紧迫性/时间压力线索和社会认同作为可测量的行为信号进行操作化，并使用稀疏性和不确定性感知估计下的精确推断来分析它们与支付行为的关联，其中社会认同被视为上下文依赖的合法性线索而非独立预测因子。我们的结果显示，紧迫性/时间压力线索与支付行为显著相关，与其在升级过程中作为近端合规触发因素的作用一致。相比之下，在当前的操作化下，错失恐惧/FOMO线索在我们的遭遇子集中无法可靠识别，凸显了测量保真度和线索定义一致性的重要性。我们进一步观察到，受害者叙述中的情绪基调和对敏感问题的选择性不回应与经济损失和报告行为系统地变化，表明缺失可能反映了调查疲劳和对敏感项目的选择性不披露的组合，而非纯粹的随机噪声。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过将行为决策信号操作化为计算特征，以实现对求职诈骗的早期干预。研究人员利用对大学人群的调查数据，分析了两种主要的求职诈骗路径，并基于行为经济学原理提取了沉没成本、紧迫性和社会认同等信号。分析发现，紧迫性/时间压力线索与支付行为呈显著相关性，而其他一些线索的识别则受测量保真度的影响。研究还指出受害者叙述中的情感和缺失数据可能携带重要信息。
AI.keywords: 求职诈骗, 行为信号, 早期干预, 紧迫性线索, 决策过程
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将行为经济学原理转化为可计算的特征来识别求职诈骗中的脆弱性信号，并侧重于早期干预。其局限性在于“错失恐惧/FOMO”等线索在当前操作化下未能被可靠识别，这表明了测量保真度和线索定义一致性的重要性。

title: AI-driven Intrusion Detection for UAV in Smart Urban Ecosystems: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: UAVs have the potential to revolutionize urban management and provide valuable services to citizens. They can be deployed across diverse applications, including traffic monitoring, disaster response, environmental monitoring, and numerous other domains. However, this integration introduces novel security challenges that must be addressed to ensure safe and trustworthy urban operations. This paper provides a structured, evidence-based synthesis of UAV applications in smart cities and their associated security challenges as reported in the literature over the last decade, with particular emphasis on developments from 2019 to 2025. We categorize these challenges into two primary classes: 1) cyber-attacks targeting the communication infrastructure of UAVs and 2) unwanted or unauthorized physical intrusions by UAVs themselves. We examine the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques in developing intrusion detection mechanisms to mitigate these security threats. We analyze how AI-based methods, such as machine/deep learning for anomaly detection and computer vision for object recognition, can play a pivotal role in enhancing UAV security through unified detection systems that address both cyber and physical threats. Furthermore, we consolidate publicly available UAV datasets across network traffic and vision modalities suitable for Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) development and evaluation. The paper concludes by identifying ten key research directions, including scalability, robustness, explainability, data scarcity, automation, hybrid detection, large language models, multimodal approaches, federated learning, and privacy preservation. Finally, we discuss the practical challenges of implementing UAV IDS solutions in real-world smart city environments.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能驱动的智慧城市生态系统中无人机的入侵检测：一项综合综述
AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于利用AI技术检测智慧城市中无人机网络和物理入侵的全面综述，总结了现有工作、数据集和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 无人机在智慧城市中的集成带来了新的安全挑战，必须解决这些挑战以确保城市运行的安全和可信赖。
AI.method: 对过去十年（特别是2019年至2025年）的文献进行了结构化、循证的综合分析，重点关注无人机在智慧城市中的应用、安全挑战以及为缓解这些威胁而采用的AI技术。
AI.result: 论文对文献中报告的无人机应用及其安全挑战进行了分类，主要分为针对通信基础设施的网络攻击和无人机自身的未经授权的物理入侵。分析了AI技术（如机器学习、深度学习和计算机视觉）在增强无人机安全方面的潜力，并汇总了可用于IDS开发的公共数据集。
AI.conclusion: 文章最后确定了十个关键的研究方向，并讨论了在现实世界智慧城市环境中实施无人机入侵检测系统（IDS）的实际挑战。
AI.translation: 无人机有潜力彻底改变城市管理并为市民提供有价值的服务。它们可以部署在各种应用中，包括交通监控、灾难响应、环境监测以及许多其他领域。然而，这种集成带来了必须解决的新安全挑战，以确保城市运行的安全和可信赖。本文对过去十年文献中报告的无人机在智慧城市中的应用及其相关安全挑战进行了结构化的、循证的综合分析，特别强调了2019年至2025年的发展。我们将这些挑战分为两大主要类别：1）针对无人机通信基础设施的网络攻击和2）无人机本身的非必要或未经授权的物理入侵。我们研究了人工智能（AI）技术在开发入侵检测机制以减轻这些安全威胁方面的潜力。我们分析了诸如用于异常检测的机器学习/深度学习和用于物体识别的计算机视觉等AI方法，如何在通过解决网络和物理威胁的统一检测系统中发挥关键作用，从而增强无人机安全性。此外，我们汇总了跨网络流量和视觉模式的公开无人机数据集，适用于入侵检测系统（IDS）的开发和评估。最后，本文确定了十个关键研究方向，包括可扩展性、鲁棒性、可解释性、数据稀缺性、自动化、混合检测、大型语言模型、多模态方法、联邦学习和隐私保护。最后，我们讨论了在现实世界智慧城市环境中实施无人机IDS解决方案的实际挑战。
AI.summary: 本文对智慧城市中无人机的应用及其安全挑战进行了全面的文献综述，重点关注了人工智能（AI）在开发能够应对网络和物理入侵的入侵检测机制方面的作用。文章分析了AI方法，汇总了相关数据集，并提出了未来研究的十大方向及实际实施的挑战。
AI.keywords: 无人机, 入侵检测, 智慧城市, 人工智能, 安全挑战
AI.comments: 本论文的创新性在于对无人机在智慧城市生态系统中的入侵检测进行了全面且结构化的综述，特别关注了AI驱动的解决方案，并涵盖了网络和物理两个维度的威胁。其重要性在于为确保未来城市中无人机的安全可靠运行提供了路线图。局限性在于它是一篇综述，而不是提出了新的方法。

title: GeoSSA: Geometric Sparrow Search Algorithm for UAV Path Planning and Engineering Design Optimization
summary: The Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA), characterized by its simple structure and ease of implementation, nevertheless suffers from an insufficient balance between exploration and exploitation, making it prone to premature convergence and slow optimization progress. To address these shortcomings, this paper proposes a Geometric Sparrow Search Algorithm (GeoSSA). By integrating Good Nodes Set initialization, a Sine-Cosine Enhanced Producer position update strategy, and a Triangular-Walk Enhanced Edge Sparrow update strategy, GeoSSA significantly improves the global exploration ability, local exploitation efficiency, and convergence stability of the original SSA. To thoroughly validate the effectiveness of GeoSSA, we conducted ablation studies, qualitative analysis, and comparative experiments on 23 benchmark functions against state-of-the-art algorithms. Experimental results show that GeoSSA achieves the best or near-best performance in terms of average fitness, standard deviation, Wilcoxon tests, and Friedman rankings, with an Overall Effectiveness ($OE$) of 95.65\%. Its overall performance is significantly superior to all compared algorithms. In three-dimensional UAV path planning tasks, GeoSSA demonstrates excellent stability and superior path quality. In four categories of engineering design optimization problems, GeoSSA consistently attains the highest solution accuracy and strongest stability. GeoSSA not only exhibits outstanding global optimization performance on standard benchmark functions but also shows strong robustness and generalization ability in practical applications such as UAV path planning and engineering design. Therefore, GeoSSA provides an efficient and reliable solution framework for complex optimization problems.

AI.title_translation: 无人机路径规划与工程设计优化的几何麻雀搜索算法
AI.tldr: GeoSSA通过引入新的初始化和更新策略，改进了SSA算法在探索和利用方面的平衡，解决了过早收敛的问题，并在基准函数测试、无人机路径规划和工程设计优化中表现出优越的性能和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 原始的麻雀搜索算法（SSA）在探索和利用之间平衡不足，容易过早收敛，优化进展缓慢。
AI.method: 提出几何麻雀搜索算法（GeoSSA），整合了优良节点集初始化、正弦余弦增强生产者位置更新策略和三角行走增强边缘麻雀更新策略。
AI.result: GeoSSA在23个基准函数上的平均适应度、标准差、Wilcoxon检验和Friedman排名方面均达到最佳或接近最佳性能，整体有效性（OE）为95.65%。在三维无人机路径规划任务和工程设计优化问题中，GeoSSA也表现出优异的稳定性、路径质量、解决方案精度和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: GeoSSA不仅在标准基准函数上展现出出色的全局优化性能，还在无人机路径规划和工程设计等实际应用中显示出强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力，为复杂优化问题提供了一个高效可靠的解决方案框架。
AI.translation: 麻雀搜索算法（SSA）以其结构简单、易于实现为特点，但其在探索与利用之间的平衡不足，容易导致过早收敛和优化进展缓慢。为了解决这些缺点，本文提出了几何麻雀搜索算法（GeoSSA）。通过整合优良节点集初始化、正弦余弦增强生产者位置更新策略以及三角行走增强边缘麻雀更新策略，GeoSSA显著提高了原始SSA的全局探索能力、局部利用效率和收敛稳定性。为了全面验证GeoSSA的有效性，我们在23个基准函数上进行了消减研究、定性分析和与最先进算法的比较实验。实验结果表明，GeoSSA在平均适应度、标准差、Wilcoxon检验和Friedman排名方面均取得了最佳或接近最佳的性能，整体有效性（OE）为95.65%。其整体性能显著优于所有比较算法。在三维无人机路径规划任务中，GeoSSA表现出出色的稳定性和优越的路径质量。在四类工程设计优化问题中，GeoSSA持续获得最高的解决方案精度和最强的稳定性。GeoSSA不仅在标准基准函数上展现出出色的全局优化性能，还在无人机路径规划和工程设计等实际应用中显示出强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力。因此，GeoSSA为复杂优化问题提供了一个高效可靠的解决方案框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为几何麻雀搜索算法（GeoSSA）的改进型麻雀搜索算法，旨在解决原始SSA在探索与利用平衡性不足及易过早收敛的问题。GeoSSA通过结合优良节点集初始化、正弦余弦增强生产者位置更新以及三角行走增强边缘麻雀更新策略，显著增强了算法的全局探索能力、局部利用效率和收敛稳定性。实验结果表明，GeoSSA在基准函数测试、三维无人机路径规划以及工程设计优化问题上均表现出优越的性能、稳定性和泛化能力，整体有效性达到95.65%，优于现有算法。
AI.keywords: 麻雀搜索算法, 几何麻雀搜索算法, 无人机路径规划, 工程设计优化, 全局优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为GeoSSA的改进麻雀搜索算法，通过多项创新策略有效解决了原始SSA的局限性，并在多个基准测试和实际应用场景中验证了其优越性。研究结果令人信服，GeoSSA在保持算法简单性的同时，显著提升了优化性能和鲁棒性。然而，对于更复杂、更大规模的工程问题，其可扩展性和计算效率仍有待进一步考察。

title: CommSense: Facilitating Bias-Aware and Reflective Navigation of Online Comments for Rational Judgment
comments: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '26), April 13--17, 2026, Barcelona, Spain
summary: Online comments significantly influence users' judgments, yet their presentation, often determined by platform algorithms, can introduce biases, such as anchoring effects, which distort reasoning. While existing research emphasizes mitigating individual cognitive biases, the evolution of user judgments during comment engagement remains overlooked. This study investigates how presentation cues impact reasoning and explores interface design strategies to mitigate bias. Through a preliminary experiment (N=18) and a co-design workshop, we identified key challenges users face across a four-stage process and distilled four design requirements: pre-engagement framing, interactive organization, reflective prompts, and synthesis support. Based on these insights, we developed CommSense, an on-the-fly plugin that enhances user engagement with online comments by providing visual overviews and lightweight prompts to guide reasoning. A between-subject evaluation (N=24) demonstrates that CommSense improves bias awareness and reflective thinking, helping users produce more comprehensive, evidence-based rationales while maintaining high usability.

title: Cross-Examination Framework: A Task-Agnostic Diagnostic for Information Fidelity in Text-to-Text Generation
summary: Traditional metrics like BLEU and BERTScore fail to capture semantic fidelity in generative text-to-text tasks. We adapt the Cross-Examination Framework (CEF) for a reference-free, multi-dimensional evaluation by treating the source and candidate as independent knowledge bases. CEF generates verifiable questions from each text and performs a cross-examination to derive three interpretable scores: Coverage, Conformity, and Consistency. Validated across translation, summarization and clinical note-generation, our framework identifies critical errors, such as content omissions and factual contradictions, missed by standard metrics. A key contribution is a systematic robustness analysis to select a stable judge model. Crucially, the strong correlation between our reference-free and with-reference modes validates CEF's reliability without gold references. Furthermore, human expert validation demonstrates that CEF mismatching questions align with meaning-altering semantic errors higher than with non-semantic errors, particularly excelling at identifying entity-based and relational distortions.

title: GraphSB: Boosting Imbalanced Node Classification on Graphs through Structural Balance
summary: Imbalanced node classification is a critical challenge in graph learning, where most existing methods typically utilize Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to learn node representations. These methods can be broadly categorized into the data-level and the algorithm-level. The former aims to synthesize minority-class nodes to mitigate quantity imbalance, while the latter tries to optimize the learning process to highlight minority classes. However, neither of them addresses the inherently imbalanced graph structure, which is a fundamental factor that incurs majority-class dominance and minority-class assimilation in GNNs. Our theoretical analysis further supports this critical insight. Therefore, we propose GraphSB (Graph Structural Balance), a novel framework that incorporates Structural Balance as a key strategy to address the underlying imbalanced graph structure before node synthesis. Structural Balance performs a two-stage structure optimization: Structure Enhancement that mines hard samples near decision boundaries through dual-view analysis and enhances connectivity for minority classes through adaptive augmentation, and Relation Diffusion that propagates the enhanced minority context while simultaneously capturing higher-order structural dependencies. Thus, GraphSB balances structural distribution before node synthesis, enabling more effective learning in GNNs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GraphSB significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. More importantly, the proposed Structural Balance can be seamlessly integrated into state-of-the-art methods as a simple plug-and-play module, increasing their accuracy by an average of 4.57%.

title: Self-Supervised Path Planning in Unstructured Environments via Global-Guided Differentiable Hard Constraint Projection
summary: Deploying deep learning agents for autonomous navigation in unstructured environments faces critical challenges regarding safety, data scarcity, and limited computational resources. Traditional solvers often suffer from high latency, while emerging learning-based approaches struggle to ensure deterministic feasibility. To bridge the gap from embodied to embedded intelligence, we propose a self-supervised framework incorporating a differentiable hard constraint projection layer for runtime assurance. To mitigate data scarcity, we construct a Global-Guided Artificial Potential Field (G-APF), which provides dense supervision signals without manual labeling. To enforce actuator limitations and geometric constraints efficiently, we employ an adaptive neural projection layer, which iteratively rectifies the coarse network output onto the feasible manifold. Extensive benchmarks on a test set of 20,000 scenarios demonstrate an 88.75\% success rate, substantiating the enhanced operational safety. Closed-loop experiments in CARLA further validate the physical realizability of the planned paths under dynamic constraints. Furthermore, deployment verification on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX confirms an inference latency of 94 ms, showing real-time feasibility on resource-constrained embedded hardware. This framework offers a generalized paradigm for embedding physical laws into neural architectures, providing a viable direction for solving constrained optimization in mechatronics. Source code is available at: https://github.com/wzq-13/SSHC.git.

title: Seepage analysis using a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method
summary: This work develops a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method for steady-state, transient, and free-surface seepage in saturated porous media. Wachspress interpolation on convex polygonal elements is combined with cell-based gradient smoothing, so that element matrices are assembled using boundary integrals without in-element derivatives. Polygonal, quadtree, and hybrid quadtree--polygonal meshes are employed to accommodate local refinement and hanging nodes, and a solution-driven adaptive strategy further concentrates resolution near steep gradients and wet--dry transitions. Free-surface seepage is solved using a fixed-mesh iterative scheme that updates the wetted region, permeability field, and boundary conditions. Benchmark tests demonstrate accurate hydraulic-head and free-surface predictions, and show that adaptivity attains similar accuracy with substantially fewer degrees of freedom and CPU time.

title: Binary Token-Level Classification with DeBERTa for All-Type MWE Identification: A Lightweight Approach with Linguistic Enhancement
summary: We present a comprehensive approach for multiword expression (MWE) identification that combines binary token-level classification, linguistic feature integration, and data augmentation. Our DeBERTa-v3-large model achieves 69.8% F1 on the CoAM dataset, surpassing the best results (Qwen-72B, 57.8% F1) on this dataset by 12 points while using 165x fewer parameters. We achieve this performance by (1) reformulating detection as binary token-level START/END/INSIDE classification rather than span-based prediction, (2) incorporating NP chunking and dependency features that help discontinuous and NOUN-type MWEs identification, and (3) applying oversampling that addresses severe class imbalance in the training data. We confirm the generalization of our method on the STREUSLE dataset, achieving 78.9% F1. These results demonstrate that carefully designed smaller models can substantially outperform LLMs on structured NLP tasks, with important implications for resource-constrained deployments.

title: Revisiting Parameter Server in LLM Post-Training
summary: Modern data parallel (DP) training favors collective communication over parameter servers (PS) for its simplicity and efficiency under balanced workloads. However, the balanced workload assumption no longer holds in large language model (LLM) post-training due to the high variance in sequence lengths. Under imbalanced workloads, collective communication creates synchronization barriers, leading to under-utilization of devices with smaller workloads. This change in training dynamics calls for a revisit of the PS paradigm for its robustness to such imbalance. We propose \textbf{On-Demand Communication (ODC)}, which adapts PS into Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) by replacing collective all-gather and reduce-scatter with direct point-to-point communication. Compared to FSDP, ODC reduces the synchronization barrier from once per layer to once per minibatch and decouples the workload on each device so that faster workers are not stalled. It also enables simpler and more effective load balancing at the minibatch level. Across diverse LLM post-training tasks, ODC consistently improves device utilization and training throughput, achieving up to a 36\% speedup over standard FSDP. These results demonstrate that ODC is a superior fit for the prevalent imbalanced workloads in LLM post-training. Our implementation of ODC and integration with FSDP is open-sourced at https://github.com/sail-sg/odc.

title: Pareto-Guided Optimization for Uncertainty-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Uncertainty in medical image segmentation is inherently non-uniform, with boundary regions exhibiting substantially higher ambiguity than interior areas. Conventional training treats all pixels equally, leading to unstable optimization during early epochs when predictions are unreliable. We argue that this instability hinders convergence toward Pareto-optimal solutions and propose a region-wise curriculum strategy that prioritizes learning from certain regions and gradually incorporates uncertain ones, reducing gradient variance. Methodologically, we introduce a Pareto-consistent loss that balances trade-offs between regional uncertainties by adaptively reshaping the loss landscape and constraining convergence dynamics between interior and boundary regions; this guides the model toward Pareto-approximate solutions. To address boundary ambiguity, we further develop a fuzzy labeling mechanism that maintains binary confidence in non-boundary areas while enabling smooth transitions near boundaries, stabilizing gradients, and expanding flat regions in the loss surface. Experiments on brain metastasis and non-metastatic tumor segmentation show consistent improvements across multiple configurations, with our method outperforming traditional crisp-set approaches in all tumor subregions.

title: CHEHAB RL: Learning to Optimize Fully Homomorphic Encryption Computations
summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations directly on encrypted data, but its high computational cost remains a significant barrier. Writing efficient FHE code is a complex task requiring cryptographic expertise, and finding the optimal sequence of program transformations is often intractable. In this paper, we propose CHEHAB RL, a novel framework that leverages deep reinforcement learning (RL) to automate FHE code optimization. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or combinatorial search, our method trains an RL agent to learn an effective policy for applying a sequence of rewriting rules to automatically vectorize scalar FHE code while reducing instruction latency and noise growth. The proposed approach supports the optimization of both structured and unstructured code. To train the agent, we synthesize a diverse dataset of computations using a large language model (LLM). We integrate our proposed approach into the CHEHAB FHE compiler and evaluate it on a suite of benchmarks, comparing its performance against Coyote, a state-of-the-art vectorizing FHE compiler. The results show that our approach generates code that is $5.3\times$ faster in execution, accumulates $2.54\times$ less noise, while the compilation process itself is $27.9\times$ faster than Coyote (geometric means).

title: On the Analysis of Platooned Vehicular Networks on Highways
summary: Vehicular platooning refers to coordinated and close movement of vehicular users (VUs) traveling together along a common route segment, offering strategic benefits such as reduced fuel costs, lower emissions, and improved traffic flow. {Highways offer a natural setting for platooning due to extended travel distances, yet their potential remains underexplored, particularly in terms of communication and connectivity. Given that effective platooning relies on robust vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) links, understanding connectivity dynamics on highways is essential.} In this paper, we analyze the dynamics of vehicular platooning on a highway and its impact on the performance of two forms of vehicular communications -- namely V2V and V2I communication -- compared to independent vehicle movement on a highway. The vehicular networks consists of road-side units (RSUs), modeled as a 1D Poisson point process (PPP), to provide the vehicular connectivity to the VUs. VUs are modeled as 1D PPP under the non-platooned traffic scenario (N-PTS) and as a 1D Matern cluster process (MCP) under the platooned traffic scenario (PTS). We evaluate the distribution on the per-RSU load, representing the number of VUs served, for the typical and tagged RSU. Additionally, we derive coverage probability (CP) and rate coverage (RC), which measures the probability of the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) and achievable rate above a specified threshold at the typical VU along with their meta distribution (MD), providing a deeper understanding of the reliability and variability of these metrics across different spatial distributions of VUs and RSUs. Finally, we validate our theoretical findings through simulations and provide numerical insights into the impact of different traffic patterns on RSU load distribution, CP, and RC performance.

title: Selective Steering: Norm-Preserving Control Through Discriminative Layer Selection
summary: Despite significant progress in alignment, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that elicit harmful behaviors. Activation steering techniques offer a promising inference-time intervention approach, but existing methods suffer from critical limitations: activation addition requires careful coefficient tuning and is sensitive to layer-specific norm variations, while directional ablation provides only binary control. Recent work on Angular Steering introduces continuous control via rotation in a 2D subspace, but its practical implementation violates norm preservation, causing distribution shift and generation collapse, particularly in models below 7B parameters. We propose Selective Steering, which addresses these limitations through two key innovations: (1) a mathematically rigorous norm-preserving rotation formulation that maintains activation distribution integrity, and (2) discriminative layer selection that applies steering only where feature representations exhibit opposite-signed class alignment. Experiments across nine models demonstrate that Selective Steering achieves 5.5x higher attack success rates than prior methods while maintaining zero perplexity violations and approximately 100\% capability retention on standard benchmarks. Our approach provides a principled, efficient framework for controllable and stable LLM behavior modification. Code: https://github.com/knoveleng/steering

title: Teaching Machine Learning Fundamentals with LEGO Robotics
summary: This paper presents the web-based platform Machine Learning with Bricks and an accompanying two-day course designed to teach machine learning concepts to students aged 12 to 17 through programming-free robotics activities. Machine Learning with Bricks is an open source platform and combines interactive visualizations with LEGO robotics to teach three core algorithms: KNN, linear regression, and Q-learning. Students learn by collecting data, training models, and interacting with robots via a web-based interface. Pre- and post-surveys with 14 students demonstrate significant improvements in conceptual understanding of machine learning algorithms, positive shifts in AI perception, high platform usability, and increased motivation for continued learning. This work demonstrates that tangible, visualization-based approaches can make machine learning concepts accessible and engaging for young learners while maintaining technical depth. The platform is freely available at https://learning-and-dynamics.github.io/ml-with-bricks/, with video tutorials guiding students through the experiments at https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLx1grFu4zAcwfKKJZ1Ux4LwRqaePCOA2J.

AI.title_translation: 使用乐高机器人教授机器学习基础知识
AI.tldr: 一个名为“Machine Learning with Bricks”的开源平台，结合乐高机器人和可视化工具，通过为期两天的无编程活动，向12-17岁的学生教授KNN、线性回归和Q-learning。实验证明该方法显著提高了学生的理解和学习动机。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过有形的、基于可视化的方法，使机器学习概念对年轻学习者（12至17岁）而言易于理解和参与，同时保持技术深度。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为“Machine Learning with Bricks”的开源网络平台及配套的两日课程。该平台将交互式可视化与乐高机器人相结合，教授KNN、线性回归和Q-learning三种核心算法。通过让学生收集数据、训练模型并与机器人互动（无需编程）进行教学。使用课前和课后问卷对14名学生进行了评估。
AI.result: 对14名学生的课前和课后调查显示，学生对机器学习算法的概念理解有显著提高，对人工智能的看法发生积极转变，平台可用性高，并增强了继续学习的动力。

AI.translation: 本文介绍了基于网络的平台“Machine Learning with Bricks”以及配套的为期两天的课程，旨在通过无需编程的机器人活动向12至17岁的学生教授机器学习概念。“Machine Learning with Bricks”是一个开源平台，它将交互式可视化与乐高机器人相结合，用于教授三个核心算法：KNN、线性回归和Q-learning。学生通过收集数据、训练模型以及通过基于网络的界面与机器人互动来进行学习。对14名学生的课前和课后调查表明，学生对机器学习算法的概念理解有了显著提高，对人工智能的认知发生了积极转变，平台具有很高的可用性，并增强了继续学习的动力。这项工作表明，有形的、基于可视化的方法可以使机器学习概念对年轻学习者来说既易于理解又富有吸引力，同时保持了技术深度。该平台可在 https://learning-and-dynamics.github.io/ml-with-bricks/ 免费获取，学生可通过 https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLx1grFu4zAcwfKKJZ1Ux4LwRqaePCOA2J 上的视频教程指导完成实验。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一款名为“Machine Learning with Bricks”的开源网络平台及其配套的两日课程，专为12至17岁的青少年设计。该平台利用乐高机器人和可视化工具，通过无编程的实践活动教授KNN、线性回归和Q-learning等核心机器学习算法。研究结果显示，这种有形且可视化的教学方法显著提升了14名受试学生的算法理解力、对AI的积极认知以及学习动机。
AI.keywords: 机器学习教育, 乐高机器人, 可视化, KNN, Q-learning
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将实体乐高机器人、交互式可视化工具和无编程环境相结合，成功地向青少年教授了包括Q-learning在内的核心机器学习算法，极大地降低了学习门槛。其重要性在于提供了一种可复制且有效的早期AI教育模式。然而，其局限性在于样本量较小（14名学生），且课程时长仅为两天，长期学习效果和更广泛的适用性仍需进一步验证。

title: Establishing dermatopathology encyclopedia DermpathNet with Artificial Intelligence-Based Workflow
summary: Accessing high-quality, open-access dermatopathology image datasets for learning and cross-referencing is a common challenge for clinicians and dermatopathology trainees. To establish a comprehensive open-access dermatopathology dataset for educational, cross-referencing, and machine-learning purposes, we employed a hybrid workflow to curate and categorize images from the PubMed Central (PMC) repository. We used specific keywords to extract relevant images, and classified them using a novel hybrid method that combined deep learning-based image modality classification with figure caption analyses. Validation on 651 manually annotated images demonstrated the robustness of our workflow, with an F-score of 89.6\% for the deep learning approach, 61.0\% for the keyword-based retrieval method, and 90.4\% for the hybrid approach. We retrieved over 7,772 images across 166 diagnoses and released this fully annotated dataset, reviewed by board-certified dermatopathologists. Using our dataset as a challenging task, we found the current image analysis algorithm from OpenAI inadequate for analyzing dermatopathology images. In conclusion, we have developed a large, peer-reviewed, open-access dermatopathology image dataset, DermpathNet, which features a semi-automated curation workflow.

AI.title_translation: 使用基于人工智能的工作流建立皮肤病理学百科全书DermpathNet
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个名为DermpathNet的大型、开放获取的皮肤病理学图像数据集，该数据集包含7,772多张图像和166种诊断，通过结合深度学习和图示标题分析的混合AI工作流从PMC中自动提取和整理。
AI.motivation: 临床医生和皮肤病理学学员难以获取高质量、开放获取的皮肤病理学图像数据集用于学习和交叉参考。
AI.method: 采用混合工作流从PubMed Central (PMC) 存储库中提取图像。使用特定关键词进行检索，并通过结合基于深度学习的图像模态分类和图示标题分析的新型混合方法对图像进行分类和整理。工作流的稳健性通过651张手动标注图像进行了验证。
AI.result: 检索到超过7,772张图像，涵盖166种诊断，并发布了经过董事会认证的皮肤病理学家审查的完整标注数据集（DermpathNet）。工作流的混合方法验证F-score为90.4\%。发现当前OpenAI的图像分析算法不适合分析该数据集。
AI.conclusion: 开发了一个名为DermpathNet的大型、经过同行评审的开放获取皮肤病理学图像数据集，该数据集具有半自动化整理工作流。
AI.translation: 获取高质量、开放获取的皮肤病理学图像数据集用于学习和交叉参考，是临床医生和皮肤病理学学员面临的普遍挑战。为了建立一个用于教育、交叉参考和机器学习目的的综合性开放获取皮肤病理学数据集，我们采用了一种混合工作流来整理和分类来自PubMed Central (PMC) 存储库的图像。我们使用特定的关键词提取相关图像，并采用结合了基于深度学习的图像模态分类和图示标题分析的新型混合方法对其进行分类。对651张手动标注图像的验证证明了我们工作流的稳健性，其中深度学习方法的F-score为89.6\%，基于关键词的检索方法为61.0\%，混合方法为90.4\%。我们检索到了涵盖166种诊断的7,772多张图像，并发布了这个经过董事会认证的皮肤病理学家审查的完整标注数据集。使用我们的数据集作为一个具有挑战性的任务，我们发现当前来自OpenAI的图像分析算法不足以分析皮肤病理学图像。总之，我们开发了一个大型、经过同行评审的开放获取皮肤病理学图像数据集DermpathNet，该数据集具有一个半自动化整理工作流。
AI.summary: 本文针对皮肤病理学高质量开放数据集缺乏的问题，提出了一种半自动化的混合AI工作流，用于从PMC存储库中提取、分类和整理图像。该工作流结合了深度学习图像分类和图示标题分析，在验证中表现出90.4\%的高F-score。最终，研究人员建立了DermpathNet，一个包含超过7,772张图像和166种诊断的大型、经过专家审查的开放获取数据集，并指出现有通用AI模型难以处理该数据集。
AI.keywords: 皮肤病理学, 开放数据集, 深度学习, 混合工作流, DermpathNet
AI.comments:
**创新性：** 论文的关键创新在于其“混合工作流”，它结合了传统的信息检索（关键词/标题分析）和现代的深度学习技术进行图像模态分类，实现了高效且高准确率（F-score 90.4%）的半自动化数据整理。这为从大规模非结构化医学文献库中提取专业图像提供了一个稳健的范例。

**重要性：** DermpathNet的建立解决了皮肤病理学领域高质量、开放获取训练数据的关键瓶颈。作为一个包含7,772多张图像、涵盖166种诊断且经过董事会认证的皮肤病理学家审查的数据集，它对于教育、临床交叉参考以及推动该领域AI模型的开发具有重大价值。

**启示：** 文章侧面揭示了当前通用图像分析算法（如OpenAI的算法）在处理高度专业化的医学图像（如皮肤病理学）时的局限性，突显了领域特定、高质量数据集对于开发实用医疗AI工具的必要性。

title: Tri-Reader: An Open-Access, Multi-Stage AI Pipeline for First-Pass Lung Nodule Annotation in Screening CT
summary: Using multiple open-access models trained on public datasets, we developed Tri-Reader, a comprehensive, freely available pipeline that integrates lung segmentation, nodule detection, and malignancy classification into a unified tri-stage workflow. The pipeline is designed to prioritize sensitivity while reducing the candidate burden for annotators. To ensure accuracy and generalizability across diverse practices, we evaluated Tri-Reader on multiple internal and external datasets as compared with expert annotations and dataset-provided reference standards.

AI.title_translation: Tri-Reader：用于筛查CT中首次肺结节标注的开源多阶段AI流程
AI.tldr: 开发了一个名为 Tri-Reader 的开源三阶段AI流程，用于筛查CT中的肺结节分割、检测和恶性分类，旨在提高灵敏度并减轻标注者的负担。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一个全面、免费的AI流程（Tri-Reader），用于筛查CT中的首次肺结节标注，该流程整合了肺分割、结节检测和恶性分类，以优先考虑灵敏度并减少标注者的候选负担。
AI.method: 该方法是基于多个在公共数据集上训练的开源模型，构建了一个统一的三阶段流程（Tri-Reader），整合了肺分割、结节检测和恶性分类。通过与专家标注和参考标准对比，在多个内部和外部数据集上进行了评估。
AI.result: 摘要中提到在多个内部和外部数据集上与专家标注和参考标准进行了评估，以确保准确性和泛化能力。（具体性能指标未提及）
AI.translation: 我们利用在公共数据集上训练的多个开源模型，开发了 Tri-Reader，这是一个全面、免费的流程，将肺分割、结节检测和恶性分类整合到一个统一的三阶段工作流程中。该流程旨在优先考虑灵敏度，同时减轻标注者的候选负担。为了确保在不同实践中的准确性和泛化能力，我们通过与专家标注和数据集提供的参考标准进行比较，在多个内部和外部数据集上对 Tri-Reader 进行了评估。
AI.summary: Tri-Reader是一个开源、免费且集成的AI流程，用于筛查CT中的肺结节标注。它结合了肺分割、结节检测和恶性分类这三个阶段，旨在高灵敏度地减少人工标注工作量。该流程已在多个内部和外部数据集上进行了评估，以验证其准确性和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 肺结节标注, AI流程, 筛查CT, 开源, 多阶段
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将多个开源模型整合为一个统一、免费的三阶段流程（Tri-Reader），专门用于筛查CT中的“首次通过”标注。其重要性在于实现了双重目标：最大化灵敏度（对筛查至关重要）同时最小化人工标注者的负担。强调使用开源模型并在多样化的内部/外部数据集上进行评估，表明其对实际应用和泛化能力的高度关注，这解决了医疗AI工具中的一个常见限制。

title: High-quality data augmentation for code comment classification
comments: Accepted at the NLBSE Workshop (co-located with ICSE)
summary: Code comments serve a crucial role in software development for documenting functionality, clarifying design choices, and assisting with issue tracking. They capture developers' insights about the surrounding source code, serving as an essential resource for both human comprehension and automated analysis. Nevertheless, since comments are in natural language, they present challenges for machine-based code understanding. To address this, recent studies have applied natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning techniques to classify comments according to developers' intentions. However, existing datasets for this task suffer from size limitations and class imbalance, as they rely on manual annotations and may not accurately represent the distribution of comments in real-world codebases. To overcome this issue, we introduce new synthetic oversampling and augmentation techniques based on high-quality data generation to enhance the NLBSE'26 challenge datasets. Our Synthetic Quality Oversampling Technique and Augmentation Technique (Q-SYNTH) yield promising results, improving the base classifier by $2.56\%$.
comment: Accepted at the NLBSE Workshop (co-located with ICSE)

AI.title_translation: 高质量数据增强用于代码注释分类
AI.tldr: 针对代码注释分类任务中数据集规模小和类别不平衡的问题，本文提出了一种名为Q-SYNTH的高质量合成过采样和增强技术，成功将基线分类器的性能提高了2.56%。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码注释分类数据集存在规模限制和类别不平衡的问题，且依赖手动标注，不能准确代表真实代码库中的分布。本文旨在通过数据增强技术克服这些限制。
AI.method: 引入了基于高质量数据生成的新型合成过采样和增强技术（命名为Q-SYNTH：Synthetic Quality Oversampling Technique and Augmentation Technique）。该技术用于增强NLBSE'26挑战赛数据集。
AI.result: Q-SYNTH技术将基线分类器的性能提高了2.56%。
AI.translation: 代码注释在软件开发中扮演着至关重要的角色，用于记录功能、阐明设计选择以及协助问题跟踪。它们捕捉了开发人员对周围源代码的见解，是人类理解和自动化分析的重要资源。然而，由于注释是自然语言，它们给基于机器的代码理解带来了挑战。为了解决这个问题，最近的研究应用了自然语言处理（NLP）和深度学习技术，根据开发人员的意图对注释进行分类。然而，现有用于此任务的数据集存在规模限制和类别不平衡的问题，因为它们依赖手动标注，并且可能无法准确代表真实代码库中注释的分布。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了基于高质量数据生成的新型合成过采样和增强技术，以增强NLBSE'26挑战赛数据集。我们的合成质量过采样技术和增强技术（Q-SYNTH）产生了有希望的结果，将基线分类器的性能提高了2.56%。
AI.summary: 代码注释对于软件理解至关重要，但由于其自然语言特性，给机器分析带来了挑战。针对现有注释分类数据集规模小和类别不平衡的问题，本文提出了一种名为Q-SYNTH的高质量合成过采样和增强技术。该技术旨在通过生成高质量数据来增强NLBSE'26挑战赛数据集，实验结果显示，Q-SYNTH成功将基线分类器的性能提升了2.56%。
AI.keywords: 代码注释分类, 数据增强, 合成过采样, 类别不平衡, Q-SYNTH
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种针对代码注释分类任务的特定高质量数据增强方法（Q-SYNTH），有效地解决了该领域中常见的数据稀疏和类别不平衡问题。代码注释作为连接代码和自然语言的关键桥梁，其自动化分析对于软件工程自动化具有重要意义。通过专注于“高质量”的合成数据生成，该方法有望避免传统数据增强可能引入的噪声，从而实现稳健的性能提升。

title: GenPairX: A Hardware-Algorithm Co-Designed Accelerator for Paired-End Read Mapping
summary: Genome sequencing has become a central focus in computational biology. A genome study typically begins with sequencing, which produces millions to billions of short DNA fragments known as reads. Read mapping aligns these reads to a reference genome. Read mapping for short reads comes in two forms: single-end and paired-end, with the latter being more prevalent due to its higher accuracy and support for advanced analysis. Read mapping remains a major performance bottleneck in genome analysis due to expensive dynamic programming. Prior efforts have attempted to mitigate this cost by employing filters to identify and potentially discard computationally expensive matches and leveraging hardware accelerators to speed up the computations. While partially effective, these approaches have limitations. In particular, existing filters are often ineffective for paired-end reads, as they evaluate each read independently and exhibit relatively low filtering ratios. In this work, we propose GenPairX, a hardware-algorithm co-designed accelerator that efficiently minimizes the computational load of paired-end read mapping while enhancing the throughput of memory-intensive operations. GenPairX introduces: (1) a novel filtering algorithm that jointly considers both reads in a pair to improve filtering effectiveness, and a lightweight alignment algorithm to replace most of the computationally expensive dynamic programming operations, and (2) two specialized hardware mechanisms to support the proposed algorithms. Our evaluations show that GenPairX delivers substantial performance improvements over state-of-the-art solutions, achieving 1575x and 1.43x higher throughput per watt compared to leading CPU-based and accelerator-based read mappers, respectively, all without compromising accuracy.

AI.title_translation: GenPairX：一种用于双端测序读段映射的软硬件协同设计加速器
AI.tldr: GenPairX是一种软硬件协同设计的加速器，用于解决双端测序读段映射中动态规划的性能瓶颈。它引入了一种新的联合考虑读段对的过滤算法和轻量级比对算法。相比现有CPU和加速器解决方案，GenPairX在不牺牲准确性的前提下，每瓦特吞吐量分别提高了1575倍和1.43倍。
AI.motivation: 基因组测序中的读段映射，特别是双端测序读段映射，由于昂贵的动态规划操作，仍然是性能的主要瓶颈。现有的过滤方法对双端读段无效，因为它们独立评估每个读段，且过滤率相对较低。
AI.method: 提出GenPairX，一个软硬件协同设计的加速器。方法包括：1. 一种新的过滤算法，该算法联合考虑读段对，以提高过滤效率；2. 一种轻量级比对算法，用于取代大部分计算昂贵的动态规划操作；3. 两个专门的硬件机制来支持上述算法。
AI.result: GenPairX在不影响准确性的前提下，实现了显著的性能提升。与领先的基于CPU的读段映射器相比，每瓦特吞吐量提高了1575倍；与领先的基于加速器的读段映射器相比，每瓦特吞吐量提高了1.43倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计，GenPairX成功地将双端测序读段映射的计算负载降至最低，同时提高了内存密集型操作的吞吐量，实现了远超现有最先进解决方案的性能提升，且不牺牲准确性。
AI.translation: 基因组测序已成为计算生物学的核心焦点。基因组研究通常始于测序，该过程会产生数百万到数十亿被称为读段的短DNA片段。读段映射将这些读段比对到参考基因组上。短读段映射有两种形式：单端和双端，后者因其更高的准确性和对高级分析的支持而更为普遍。由于昂贵的动态规划，读段映射仍然是基因组分析中的主要性能瓶颈。以前的努力试图通过使用过滤器来识别并可能丢弃计算成本高的匹配，并利用硬件加速器来加速计算，从而减轻这一成本。虽然部分有效，但这些方法存在局限性。特别是，现有过滤器通常对双端读段无效，因为它们独立评估每个读段，并且过滤率相对较低。在这项工作中，我们提出了GenPairX，一个软硬件协同设计的加速器，它有效地最小化了双端测序读段映射的计算负载，同时提高了内存密集型操作的吞吐量。GenPairX引入了：（1）一种新颖的过滤算法，该算法联合考虑读段对以提高过滤效率，以及一种轻量级比对算法来取代大部分计算昂贵的动态规划操作，和（2）两个专门的硬件机制来支持所提出的算法。我们的评估表明，GenPairX比最先进的解决方案提供了实质性的性能改进，与领先的基于CPU和基于加速器的读段映射器相比，每瓦特吞吐量分别提高了1575倍和1.43倍，所有这些都没有牺牲准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GenPairX，一个用于双端测序读段映射的软硬件协同设计加速器，旨在解决昂贵动态规划带来的性能瓶颈。GenPairX的核心创新在于引入了一种联合考虑读段对的新型过滤算法和轻量级比对算法，并设计了专门的硬件机制来支持这些算法。评估结果显示，GenPairX在不影响准确性的前提下，实现了对现有CPU和加速器方案显著的吞吐量提升（每瓦特吞吐量分别达到1575倍和1.43倍）。
AI.keywords: 双端测序读段映射, 软硬件协同设计, 加速器, 动态规划, GenPairX
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于其软硬件协同设计方法，专门针对双端测序读段映射的固有挑战。通过引入一种联合处理读段对的新型过滤算法，它有效地解决了现有独立过滤方法对双端读段无效的局限性，显著降低了后续昂贵的动态规划计算的负载。其结果表明，这种协同设计策略在能效（每瓦特吞吐量）方面带来了极大的提升，特别是在与传统CPU解决方案相比时，显示出在高性能计算生物学领域巨大的应用潜力。

title: MIRAGE: Enabling Real-Time Automotive Mediated Reality
summary: Traffic is inherently dangerous, with around 1.19 million fatalities annually. Automotive Mediated Reality (AMR) can enhance driving safety by overlaying critical information (e.g., outlines, icons, text) on key objects to improve awareness, altering objects' appearance to simplify traffic situations, and diminishing their appearance to minimize distractions. However, real-world AMR evaluation remains limited due to technical challenges. To fill this sim-to-real gap, we present MIRAGE, an open-source tool that enables real-time AMR in real vehicles. MIRAGE implements 15 effects across the AMR spectrum of augmented, diminished, and modified reality using state-of-the-art computational models for object detection and segmentation, depth estimation, and inpainting. In an on-road expert user study (N=9) of MIRAGE, participants enjoyed the AMR experience while pointing out technical limitations and identifying use cases for AMR. We discuss these results in relation to prior work and outline implications for AMR ethics and interaction design.

AI.title_translation: MIRAGE：实现实时车载中介现实
AI.tldr: MIRAGE是一个开源工具，旨在通过利用先进的计算模型（如目标检测和深度估计），在真实车辆中实现实时车载中介现实（AMR）。初步的用户研究表明，参与者对AMR体验感到满意，并为未来的伦理和交互设计提供了见解。
AI.motivation: 交通固有的危险性（每年约119万例死亡）。车载中介现实（AMR）可以通过叠加关键信息、简化交通情况或减少干扰来增强驾驶安全。然而，由于技术挑战，AMR的真实世界评估受到限制，存在“模拟到现实”（sim-to-real）的差距。
AI.method: 提出了开源工具MIRAGE，它能够在真实车辆中实现实时AMR。MIRAGE利用最先进的计算模型（包括目标检测和分割、深度估计和图像修复），实现了跨越增强现实、减弱现实和修改现实三个AMR谱系的15种效果。
AI.result: 对MIRAGE进行了一项车载专家用户研究（N=9）。参与者享受了AMR体验，同时指出了技术限制并确定了AMR的使用场景。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及对AMR安全性的明确结论，但讨论了研究结果与先前工作的关系，并概述了对AMR伦理和交互设计的影响。
AI.translation: 交通固有地具有危险性，每年约有119万例死亡。车载中介现实（AMR）可以通过在关键物体上叠加关键信息（例如轮廓、图标、文本）来提高感知，改变物体的外观以简化交通情况，并减弱它们的出现以最小化干扰，从而增强驾驶安全。然而，由于技术挑战，真实世界的AMR评估仍然有限。为了填补这一模拟到现实的差距，我们提出了MIRAGE，这是一个开源工具，能够在真实车辆中实现实时AMR。MIRAGE利用最先进的计算模型进行物体检测和分割、深度估计和图像修复，实现了跨越增强现实、减弱现实和修改现实三个AMR谱系的15种效果。在一项针对MIRAGE的道路专家用户研究（N=9）中，参与者享受了AMR体验，同时指出了技术限制并确定了AMR的使用场景。我们讨论了这些结果与先前工作的关系，并概述了对AMR伦理和交互设计的启示。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MIRAGE，一个旨在弥合车载中介现实（AMR）“模拟到现实”差距的开源工具。AMR通过增强、修改或减弱现实元素来提高驾驶安全，但其真实世界评估面临技术障碍。MIRAGE利用目标检测、深度估计和图像修复等先进模型，实现了15种实时AMR效果。一项对9名专家的车载用户研究验证了该工具的体验性，并为AMR的潜在应用、伦理和交互设计提供了数据基础。
AI.keywords: 车载中介现实, MIRAGE, 实时评估, 驾驶安全, 开源工具
AI.comments: MIRAGE的关键创新在于它提供了一个开放源代码的、可用于真实车辆的实时AMR评估平台，有效地解决了该领域长期存在的“模拟到现实”的评估难题。通过集成了15种效果和SOTA计算模型，它极大地推动了AMR在实际驾驶环境中的研究和应用潜力，特别是为未来关于AMR伦理和交互设计的讨论奠定了基础。

title: Bridging the Socio-Emotional Gap: The Functional Dimension of Human-AI Collaboration for Software Engineering
comments: This is the authors accepted manuscript. The final version appears in ACM CHASE 2026
summary: As GenAI models are adopted to support software engineers and their development teams, understanding effective human-AI collaboration (HAIC) is increasingly important. Socio-emotional intelligence (SEI) enhances collaboration among human teammates, but its role in HAIC remains unclear. Current AI systems lack SEI capabilities that humans bring to teamwork, creating a potential gap in collaborative dynamics. In this study, we investigate how software practitioners perceive the socio-emotional gap in HAIC and what capabilities AI systems require for effective collaboration. Through semi-structured interviews with 10 practitioners, we examine how they think about collaborating with human versus AI teammates, focusing on their SEI expectations and the AI capabilities they envision. Results indicate that practitioners currently view AI models as intellectual teammates rather than social partners and expect fewer SEI attributes from them than from human teammates. However, they see the socio-emotional gap not as AIs failure to exhibit SEI traits, but as a functional gap in collaborative capabilities (AIs inability to negotiate responsibilities, adapt contextually, or maintain sustained partnerships). We introduce the concept of functional equivalents: technical capabilities (internal cognition, contextual intelligence, adaptive learning, and collaborative intelligence) that achieve collaborative outcomes comparable to human SEI attributes. Our findings suggest that effective collaboration with AI for SE tasks may benefit from functional design rather than replicating human SEI traits for SE tasks, thereby redefining collaboration as functional alignment.
