title: BugLens: Leveraging Bisection for Lightweight Compiler Bug Deduplication
summary: Random testing has proven to be an effective technique for compiler validation. However, the debugging of bugs identified through random testing presents a significant challenge due to the frequent occurrence of duplicate test programs that expose identical compiler bugs. The process to identify duplicates is a practical research problem known as bug deduplication. Prior methodologies for compiler bug deduplication primarily rely on program analysis to extract bug-related features for duplicate identification, which can result in substantial computational overhead and limited generalizability. This paper investigates the feasibility of employing bisection, a standard debugging procedure largely overlooked in prior research on compiler bug deduplication, for this purpose. Our study demonstrates that the utilization of bisection to locate failure-inducing commits provides a valuable criterion for deduplication, albeit one that requires supplementary techniques for more accurate identification. Building on these results, we introduce BugLens, a novel deduplication method that primarily uses bisection, enhanced by the identification of bug-triggering optimizations to minimize false negatives. Empirical evaluations conducted on four real-world datasets demonstrate that BugLens significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art analysis-based methodologies Tamer and D3 by saving an average of 26.98% and 9.64% human effort to identify the same number of distinct bugs. Given the inherent simplicity and generalizability of bisection, it presents a highly practical solution for compiler bug deduplication in real-world applications.

title: Minimal residual rational Krylov subspace method for sequences of shifted linear systems
summary: The solution of sequences of shifted linear systems is a classic problem in numerical linear algebra, and a variety of efficient methods have been proposed over the years. Nevertheless, there still exist challenging scenarios witnessing a lack of performing solvers. For instance, state-of-the-art procedures struggle to handle nonsymmetric problems where the shifts are complex numbers that do not come as conjugate pairs. We design a novel projection strategy based on the rational Krylov subspace equipped with a minimal residual condition. We also devise a novel pole selection procedure, tailored to our problem, providing poles for the rational Krylov basis construction that yield faster convergence than those computed by available general-purpose schemes. A panel of diverse numerical experiments shows that our novel approach performs better than state-of-the-art techniques, especially on the very challenging problems mentioned above.

title: A Gift from the Integration of Discriminative and Diffusion-based Generative Learning: Boundary Refinement Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Remote sensing semantic segmentation must address both what the ground objects are within an image and where they are located. Consequently, segmentation models must ensure not only the semantic correctness of large-scale patches (low-frequency information) but also the precise localization of boundaries between patches (high-frequency information). However, most existing approaches rely heavily on discriminative learning, which excels at capturing low-frequency features, while overlooking its inherent limitations in learning high-frequency features for semantic segmentation. Recent studies have revealed that diffusion generative models excel at generating high-frequency details. Our theoretical analysis confirms that the diffusion denoising process significantly enhances the model's ability to learn high-frequency features; however, we also observe that these models exhibit insufficient semantic inference for low-frequency features when guided solely by the original image. Therefore, we integrate the strengths of both discriminative and generative learning, proposing the Integration of Discriminative and diffusion-based Generative learning for Boundary Refinement (IDGBR) framework. The framework first generates a coarse segmentation map using a discriminative backbone model. This map and the original image are fed into a conditioning guidance network to jointly learn a guidance representation subsequently leveraged by an iterative denoising diffusion process refining the coarse segmentation. Extensive experiments across five remote sensing semantic segmentation datasets (binary and multi-class segmentation) confirm our framework's capability of consistent boundary refinement for coarse results from diverse discriminative architectures.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)

title: High-Layer Attention Pruning with Rescaling
summary: Pruning is a highly effective approach for compressing large language models (LLMs), significantly reducing inference latency. However, conventional training-free structured pruning methods often employ a heuristic metric that indiscriminately removes some attention heads across all pruning layers, without considering their positions within the network architecture. In this work, we propose a novel pruning algorithm that strategically prunes attention heads in the model's higher layers. Since the removal of attention heads can alter the magnitude of token representations, we introduce an adaptive rescaling parameter that calibrates the representation scale post-pruning to counteract this effect. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a wide range of LLMs, including LLaMA3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen2-7B, and Gemma2-9B. Our evaluation includes both generation and discriminative tasks across 27 datasets. The results consistently demonstrate that our method outperforms existing structured pruning methods. This improvement is particularly notable in generation tasks, where our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/SongtaoLiu0823/HARP.

title: ExPO: Unlocking Hard Reasoning with Self-Explanation-Guided Reinforcement Learning
comments: Accepted to NeurIPS 2025 (Poster). Code available at https://github.com/HumainLab/ExPO_rl_reasoning_by_explanation
summary: Self-improvement via RL often fails on complex reasoning tasks because GRPO-style post-training methods rely on the model's initial ability to generate positive samples. Without guided exploration, these approaches merely reinforce what the model already knows (distribution-sharpening) rather than enabling the model to solve problems where it initially generates no correct solutions. To unlock reasoning ability in such settings, the model must explore new reasoning trajectories beyond its current output distribution. Such exploration requires access to sufficiently good positive samples to guide the learning. While expert demonstrations seem like a natural solution, we find that they are often ineffective in RL post-training. Instead, we identify two key properties of effective positive samples: they should (1) be likely under the current policy, and (2) increase the model's likelihood of predicting the correct answer. Based on these insights, we propose $\textbf{Self-Explanation Policy Optimization (ExPO)}$-a simple and modular framework that generates such samples by conditioning on the ground-truth answer. It can be integrated with popular RL training methods like GRPO and DPO. ExPO enables efficient exploration and guides the model to produce reasoning trajectories more aligned with its policy than expert-written CoTs, while ensuring higher quality than its own (incorrect) samples. Experiments show that ExPO improves both learning efficiency and final performance on reasoning benchmarks, surpassing expert-demonstration-based methods in challenging settings such as MATH level-5, where the model initially struggles the most. Code is available at https://github.com/HumainLab/ExPO_rl_reasoning_by_explanation .
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2025 (Poster). Code available at https://github.com/HumainLab/ExPO_rl_reasoning_by_explanation

title: UQLM: A Python Package for Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
comments: Accepted by JMLR; UQLM Repository: https://github.com/cvs-health/uqlm
summary: Hallucinations, defined as instances where Large Language Models (LLMs) generate false or misleading content, pose a significant challenge that impacts the safety and trust of downstream applications. We introduce UQLM, a Python package for LLM hallucination detection using state-of-the-art uncertainty quantification (UQ) techniques. This toolkit offers a suite of UQ-based scorers that compute response-level confidence scores ranging from 0 to 1. This library provides an off-the-shelf solution for UQ-based hallucination detection that can be easily integrated to enhance the reliability of LLM outputs.
comment: Accepted by JMLR; UQLM Repository: https://github.com/cvs-health/uqlm

title: Why is Your Language Model a Poor Implicit Reward Model?
comments: Accepted to ICLR 2026; Code available at https://github.com/princeton-pli/exrm-vs-imrm
summary: Reward models are key to language model post-training and inference pipelines. Conveniently, recent work showed that every language model defines an implicit reward model (IM-RM), without requiring any architectural changes. However, such IM-RMs tend to generalize worse, especially out-of-distribution, compared to explicit reward models (EX-RMs) that apply a dedicated linear head over the hidden representations of a language model. The existence of a generalization gap is puzzling, as EX-RMs and IM-RMs are nearly identical. They can be trained using the same data, loss function, and language model, and differ only in how the reward is computed. Toward a fundamental understanding of the implicit biases underlying different reward model types, we investigate the root cause of this gap. Our main finding, backed by theory and experiments, is that IM-RMs rely more heavily on superficial token-level cues. Consequently, they often generalize worse than EX-RMs under token-level distribution shifts, as well as in-distribution. Furthermore, we provide evidence against alternative hypotheses for the generalization gap. Most notably, we challenge the claim that IM-RMs struggle in tasks where generation is harder than verification because they can operate both as a verifier and a generator. Overall, our results highlight that seemingly minor design choices can substantially impact the generalization behavior of reward models.
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026; Code available at https://github.com/princeton-pli/exrm-vs-imrm

title: BootSeer: Analyzing and Mitigating Initialization Bottlenecks in Large-Scale LLM Training
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a cornerstone of modern AI, driving breakthroughs in natural language processing and expanding into multimodal jobs involving images, audio, and video. As with most computational software, it is important to distinguish between ordinary runtime performance and startup overhead. Prior research has focused on runtime performance: improving training efficiency and stability. This work focuses instead on the increasingly critical issue of startup overhead in training: the delay before training jobs begin execution. Startup overhead is particularly important in large, industrial-scale LLMs, where failures occur more frequently and multiple teams operate in iterative update-debug cycles. In one of our training clusters, more than 3.5% of GPU time is wasted due to startup overhead alone.
  In this work, we present the first in-depth characterization of LLM training startup overhead based on real production data. We analyze the components of startup cost, quantify its direct impact, and examine how it scales with job size. These insights motivate the design of Bootseer, a system-level optimization framework that addresses three primary startup bottlenecks: (a) container image loading, (b) runtime dependency installation, and (c) model checkpoint resumption. To mitigate these bottlenecks, Bootseer introduces three techniques: (a) hot block record-and-prefetch, (b) dependency snapshotting, and (c) striped HDFS-FUSE. Bootseer has been deployed in a production environment and evaluated on real LLM training workloads, demonstrating a 50% reduction in startup overhead.

title: GOFAI meets Generative AI: Development of Expert Systems by means of Large Language Models
summary: The development of large language models (LLMs) has successfully transformed knowledge-based systems such as open domain question nswering, which can automatically produce vast amounts of seemingly coherent information. Yet, those models have several disadvantages like hallucinations or confident generation of incorrect or unverifiable facts. In this paper, we introduce a new approach to the development of expert systems using LLMs in a controlled and transparent way. By limiting the domain and employing a well-structured prompt-based extraction approach, we produce a symbolic representation of knowledge in Prolog, which can be validated and corrected by human experts. This approach also guarantees interpretability, scalability and reliability of the developed expert systems. Via quantitative and qualitative experiments with Claude Sonnet 3.7 and GPT-4.1, we show strong adherence to facts and semantic coherence on our generated knowledge bases. We present a transparent hybrid solution that combines the recall capacity of LLMs with the precision of symbolic systems, thereby laying the foundation for dependable AI applications in sensitive domains.

title: Noradrenergic-inspired gain modulation attenuates the stability gap in joint training
summary: Recent work in continual learning has highlighted the stability gap -- a temporary performance drop on previously learned tasks when new ones are introduced. This phenomenon reflects a mismatch between rapid adaptation and strong retention at task boundaries, underscoring the need for optimization mechanisms that balance plasticity and stability over abrupt distribution changes. While optimizers such as momentum-SGD and Adam introduce implicit multi-timescale behavior, they still exhibit pronounced stability gaps. Importantly, these gaps persist even under ideal joint training, making it crucial to study them in this setting to isolate their causes from other sources of forgetting. Motivated by how noradrenergic (neuromodulatory) bursts transiently increase neuronal gain under uncertainty, we introduce a dynamic gain scaling mechanism as a two-timescale optimization technique that balances adaptation and retention by modulating effective learning rates and flattening the local landscape through an effective reparameterization. Across domain- and class-incremental MNIST, CIFAR, and mini-ImageNet benchmarks under task-agnostic joint training, dynamic gain scaling effectively attenuates stability gaps while maintaining competitive accuracy, improving robustness at task transitions.

title: Diffusion models for multivariate subsurface generation and efficient probabilistic inversion
comments: 35 p., 16 figs. This updated version corrects an error with the analysis of the denoising scores' magnitudes in the results section. The discussion and conclusions of our study remain unchanged. The scores' trends were erroneously reported with inverted time-step order, now fixed in Figure 5a and b (now with the correct increasing trends) and in the corresponding analysis in the Results section
summary: Diffusion models offer stable training and state-of-the-art performance for deep generative modeling tasks. Here, we consider their use in the context of multivariate subsurface modeling and probabilistic inversion. We first demonstrate that diffusion models enhance multivariate modeling capabilities compared to variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks. In diffusion modeling, the generative process involves a comparatively large number of time steps with update rules that can be modified to account for conditioning data. We propose different corrections to the popular Diffusion Posterior Sampling approach by Chung et al. (2023). In particular, we introduce a likelihood approximation accounting for the noise-contamination that is inherent in diffusion modeling. We assess performance in a multivariate geological scenario involving facies and correlated acoustic impedance. Conditional modeling is demonstrated using both local hard data (well logs) and nonlinear geophysics (fullstack seismic data). Our tests show significantly improved statistical robustness, enhanced sampling of the posterior probability density function and reduced computational costs, compared to the original approach. The method can be used with both hard and indirect conditioning data, individually or simultaneously. As the inversion is included within the diffusion process, it is faster than other methods requiring an outer-loop around the generative model, such as Markov chain Monte Carlo.

AI.title_translation: 用于多变量地下生成和高效概率反演的扩散模型
AI.tldr: 本文使用扩散模型（DM）进行多变量地下建模和概率反演，通过改进现有的扩散后验采样（DPS）方法，引入了考虑噪声的似然近似。结果显示，该方法比原方法在统计鲁棒性、后验采样效率和计算速度上均有显著提升，且速度优于MCMC等外循环方法。
AI.motivation: 利用扩散模型在深度生成建模中的优势，解决多变量地下建模和概率反演问题。需要一种比现有方法（如VAE和GAN）更强大的多变量建模能力，并实现一种高效、能够处理局部硬数据和非线性地球物理数据的概率反演方法。
AI.method: 采用扩散模型作为生成模型。提出了对流行的扩散后验采样（DPS）方法的修正，特别是引入了一种考虑扩散模型中固有噪声污染的似然近似方法。该反演过程被整合到扩散过程内部。
AI.result: 扩散模型比VAE和GAN增强了多变量建模能力。与原始DPS方法相比，新方法显著提高了统计鲁棒性、增强了后验概率密度函数的采样效果，并降低了计算成本。该方法能够同时或单独使用硬数据和间接条件数据，且比需要外循环的其他方法（如MCMC）更快。
AI.conclusion: 改进后的扩散模型方法（引入了考虑噪声的似然近似）为多变量地下生成和概率反演提供了一种稳健、高效且在统计学上更强大的方法。由于反演被整合到扩散过程中，其计算效率优于传统的迭代方法。
AI.translation: 扩散模型为深度生成建模任务提供了稳定的训练和最先进的性能。在本文中，我们考虑它们在多变量地下建模和概率反演背景下的应用。我们首先证明，与变分自编码器（VAEs）和生成对抗网络（GANs）相比，扩散模型增强了多变量建模能力。在扩散建模中，生成过程涉及相对大量的具有更新规则的时间步，这些更新规则可以被修改以适应条件数据。我们对Chung等人（2023）提出的流行扩散后验采样（Diffusion Posterior Sampling，DPS）方法提出了不同的修正。特别是，我们引入了一种考虑到扩散建模中固有的噪声污染的似然近似方法。我们在一个涉及相（facies）和相关声阻抗的多变量地质场景中评估了性能。使用局部硬数据（测井数据）和非线性地球物理数据（全叠前地震数据）演示了条件建模。我们的测试表明，与原始方法相比，统计鲁棒性显著提高，后验概率密度函数的采样得到增强，并且计算成本降低。该方法可以单独或同时用于硬数据和间接条件数据。由于反演被包含在扩散过程中，它比需要围绕生成模型进行外循环的其他方法（如马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 MCMC）更快。
AI.summary: 本文将扩散模型应用于多变量地下生成和高效概率反演。研究表明，扩散模型在多变量建模能力上优于VAEs和GANs。主要贡献在于对扩散后验采样（DPS）方法进行了修正，引入了一种考虑扩散模型固有噪声污染的似然近似。在涉及相和声阻抗的多变量地质场景中，使用硬数据（测井）和间接数据（地震）进行条件建模。测试结果显示，改进后的方法在统计鲁棒性、后验采样效率和计算速度上均有显著提升，且优于MCMC等传统外循环方法。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 概率反演, 地下生成, 多变量建模, 扩散后验采样
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将扩散模型（DM）应用于复杂的多变量地下建模和高效概率反演任务。技术上的核心创新是针对扩散后验采样（DPS）中的噪声污染问题，提出了一种定制的似然近似，这对于在生成模型中实现准确的概率推断至关重要。其重要性在于，它提供了一种比传统的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）等外循环方法快得多的概率反演解决方案，有效解决了地球物理和储层建模中的计算瓶颈问题。此外，该方法成功地在一个统一的生成框架内整合了非线性地震数据和局部硬数据。

title: DeepSieve: Information Sieving via LLM-as-a-Knowledge-Router
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at many reasoning tasks but struggle with knowledge-intensive queries due to their inability to dynamically access up-to-date or domain-specific information. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution, enabling LLMs to ground their responses in external sources. However, existing RAG methods lack fine-grained control over both the query and source sides, often resulting in noisy retrieval and shallow reasoning. In this work, we introduce DeepSieve, an agentic RAG framework that incorporates information sieving via LLM-as-a-knowledge-router. DeepSieve decomposes complex queries into structured sub-questions and recursively routes each to the most suitable knowledge source, filtering irrelevant information through a multi-stage distillation process. Our design emphasizes modularity, transparency, and adaptability, leveraging recent advances in agentic system design. Experiments on multi-hop QA tasks across heterogeneous sources demonstrate improved reasoning depth, retrieval precision, and interpretability over conventional RAG approaches. Our codes are available at https://github.com/MinghoKwok/DeepSieve.

AI.title_translation: DeepSieve：通过将大型语言模型作为知识路由器进行信息筛选
AI.tldr: DeepSieve是一个代理式RAG框架，将LLM作为知识路由器，通过分解复杂查询和多阶段筛选来提高多跳问答的检索精度和推理深度。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM在知识密集型查询中动态知识访问的不足。现有的RAG方法缺乏对查询和源的细粒度控制，导致检索结果嘈杂和推理肤浅。
AI.method: 引入DeepSieve，一个代理式RAG框架。它将LLM作为知识路由器，将复杂查询分解为结构化子问题，递归地将每个子问题路由到最合适的知识源，并通过多阶段蒸馏过程过滤不相关信息。
AI.result: 在异构源上的多跳问答任务中，DeepSieve比传统RAG方法提高了推理深度、检索精度和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: DeepSieve作为一个代理式RAG框架，通过信息筛选和知识路由，有效解决了传统RAG的局限性，显著提高了多跳问答任务的性能和可解释性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）擅长许多推理任务，但由于无法动态访问最新或特定领域的信息，它们在知识密集型查询方面表现不佳。检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种有前景的解决方案，使LLM能够将其响应基于外部来源。然而，现有的RAG方法缺乏对查询端和源端的细粒度控制，通常导致检索结果嘈杂和推理肤浅。在这项工作中，我们引入了DeepSieve，一个代理式RAG框架，它通过将LLM作为知识路由器来整合信息筛选。DeepSieve将复杂查询分解为结构化子问题，并递归地将每个子问题路由到最合适的知识源，通过多阶段蒸馏过程过滤不相关信息。我们的设计强调模块化、透明度和适应性，利用了代理系统设计的最新进展。在跨异构源的多跳问答任务上的实验表明，与传统的RAG方法相比，DeepSieve提高了推理深度、检索精度和可解释性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/MinghoKwok/DeepSieve获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeepSieve，一个代理式检索增强生成（RAG）框架，旨在解决现有RAG方法中检索嘈杂和推理肤浅的问题。DeepSieve利用LLM作为知识路由器，将复杂查询分解为子问题并递归路由至最合适的知识源，并通过多阶段蒸馏进行信息筛选。实验证明，该方法在多跳问答任务上显著提高了推理深度、检索精度和可解释性。
AI.keywords: RAG, 代理式框架, 信息筛选, 知识路由器, 多跳问答
AI.comments: DeepSieve的核心创新在于其“代理式”设计，将LLM提升为主动的“知识路由器”，从而实现了对知识源和查询的细粒度控制。通过将复杂查询分解并递归路由，它解决了传统RAG在处理多跳问题时检索精度低和推理深度不足的关键局限。此外，强调模块化和可解释性使其在实际应用中更具吸引力，标志着RAG范式从简单检索向主动信息管理迈进了一步。

title: GraphRAG-R1: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Process-Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has shown great effectiveness in enhancing the reasoning abilities of LLMs by leveraging graph structures for knowledge representation and modeling complex real-world relationships. However, existing GraphRAG methods still face significant bottlenecks when handling complex problems that require multi-hop reasoning, as their query and retrieval phases are largely based on pre-defined heuristics and do not fully utilize the reasoning potentials of LLMs. To address this problem, we propose GraphRAG-R1, an adaptive GraphRAG framework by training LLMs with process-constrained outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance the multi-hop reasoning ability. Our method can decompose complex problems, autonomously invoke retrieval tools to acquire necessary information, and perform effective reasoning. Specifically, we utilize a modified version of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that supports rollout-with-thinking capability. Next, we design two process-constrained reward functions. To handle the shallow retrieval problem, we design a Progressive Retrieval Attenuation (PRA) reward to encourage essential retrievals. Then, to handle the over-thinking problem, we design Cost-Aware F1 (CAF) reward to balance the model performance with computational costs. We further design a phase-dependent training strategy, containing three training stages corresponding to cold start and these two rewards. Lastly, our method adopts a hybrid graph-textual retrieval to improve the reasoning capacity. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that GraphRAG-R1 boosts LLM capabilities in solving complex reasoning problems compared to state-of-the-art GraphRAG methods on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets. Furthermore, our framework can be flexibly integrated with various existing retrieval methods, consistently delivering performance improvements.

AI.title_translation: GraphRAG-R1：基于过程约束强化学习的图检索增强生成
AI.tldr: 针对现有GraphRAG在多跳推理中的不足，本文提出了GraphRAG-R1，一个使用过程约束的成果导向强化学习（RL）训练LLM的自适应框架。它通过设计PRA和CAF两种奖励函数来优化检索和计算成本，显著提升了LLM在复杂推理问题上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）方法在处理需要多跳推理的复杂问题时面临瓶颈。它们的查询和检索阶段主要依赖预定义的启发式规则，未能充分利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理潜力。
AI.method:
提出GraphRAG-R1框架，通过过程约束的成果导向强化学习（RL）来训练LLM以增强多跳推理能力。具体方法包括：
1. 使用支持“思考式展开”（rollout-with-thinking）能力的改进版群组相对策略优化（GRPO）。
2. 设计两种过程约束奖励函数：渐进检索衰减（PRA）奖励（解决浅层检索问题）和成本感知F1（CAF）奖励（解决过度思考问题，平衡性能与计算成本）。
3. 设计包含三个阶段（冷启动和两种奖励对应阶段）的阶段依赖训练策略。
4. 采用混合图文检索。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与最先进的GraphRAG方法相比，GraphRAG-R1在域内和域外数据集上都能显著提高LLM解决复杂推理问题的能力。此外，该框架可以灵活地与各种现有检索方法集成，并持续带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过强化学习有效地增强了LLM的多跳推理能力，解决了现有GraphRAG方法的瓶颈，并展示了其在复杂推理任务中的优越性能和灵活性。
AI.translation: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过利用图结构进行知识表示和建模复杂的现实世界关系，在增强LLM的推理能力方面表现出巨大的有效性。然而，现有的GraphRAG方法在处理需要多跳推理的复杂问题时仍然面临重大瓶颈，因为它们的查询和检索阶段主要基于预定义的启发式规则，并且没有充分利用LLM的推理潜力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GraphRAG-R1，这是一个自适应的GraphRAG框架，通过使用过程约束的成果导向强化学习（RL）来训练LLM，以增强多跳推理能力。我们的方法可以分解复杂问题，自主调用检索工具获取必要信息，并执行有效的推理。具体来说，我们利用支持“思考式展开”能力的改进版群组相对策略优化（GRPO）。接下来，我们设计了两种过程约束奖励函数。为了解决浅层检索问题，我们设计了渐进检索衰减（PRA）奖励以鼓励必要的检索。然后，为了解决过度思考问题，我们设计了成本感知F1（CAF）奖励以平衡模型性能与计算成本。我们进一步设计了一种阶段依赖的训练策略，包含对应于冷启动和这两种奖励的三个训练阶段。最后，我们的方法采用了混合图文检索来提高推理能力。广泛的实验结果表明，与最先进的GraphRAG方法相比，GraphRAG-R1在域内和域外数据集上都能显著提高LLM解决复杂推理问题的能力。此外，我们的框架可以灵活地与各种现有检索方法集成，并持续带来性能改进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GraphRAG-R1框架，旨在解决现有GraphRAG方法在多跳推理中的不足。GraphRAG-R1通过引入过程约束的成果导向强化学习（RL）来训练LLM，使其能够自主分解问题、调用工具并进行有效推理。该框架采用了改进的GRPO算法，并设计了PRA（鼓励检索）和CAF（平衡成本与性能）两种奖励函数，以及相应的多阶段训练策略。实验证明，GraphRAG-R1显著优于现有SOTA方法，并具有良好的集成灵活性。
AI.keywords: 图检索增强生成, 强化学习, 多跳推理, 过程约束, LLM
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于将流程约束的强化学习机制引入到图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）中，从而使得LLM能够更自适应、更有效地进行复杂的多跳推理。通过设计PRA和CAF两种针对性奖励函数，作者成功地解决了GraphRAG应用中常见的“检索不足”和“过度计算”问题，体现了对实际应用中效率和效果平衡的深刻理解。RL的应用使得GraphRAG从依赖启发式规则迈向了更智能的、基于学习的推理决策，对于提升知识图谱与LLM结合的推理能力具有重要意义。局限性方面，抽象中未提及RL训练的计算复杂度和数据需求，这可能是实际部署中的挑战。

title: Leveraging Convolutional and Graph Networks for an Unsupervised Remote Sensing Labelling Tool
comments: Accepted for Taylor and Francis, Annals of GIS * Video supplement demonstrating feature-space exploration and interactive labelling is available at: https://youtu.be/GZl1ebZJgEA and is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16676591
summary: Machine learning for remote sensing imaging relies on up-to-date and accurate labels for model training and testing. Labelling remote sensing imagery is time and cost intensive, requiring expert analysis. Previous labelling tools rely on pre-labelled data for training in order to label new unseen data. In this work, we define an unsupervised pipeline for finding and labelling geographical areas of similar context and content within Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. Our approach removes limitations of previous methods by utilising segmentation with convolutional and graph neural networks to encode a more robust feature space for image comparison. Unlike previous approaches we segment the image into homogeneous regions of pixels that are grouped based on colour and spatial similarity. Graph neural networks are used to aggregate information about the surrounding segments enabling the feature representation to encode the local neighbourhood whilst preserving its own local information. This reduces outliers in the labelling tool, allows users to label at a granular level, and allows a rotationally invariant semantic relationship at the image level to be formed within the encoding space. Our pipeline achieves high contextual consistency, with similarity scores of SSIM = 0.96 and SAM = 0.21 under context-aware evaluation, demonstrating robust organisation of the feature space for interactive labelling.
comment: Accepted for Taylor and Francis, Annals of GIS * Video supplement demonstrating feature-space exploration and interactive labelling is available at: https://youtu.be/GZl1ebZJgEA and is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16676591

AI.title_translation: 利用卷积网络和图网络实现无监督遥感标注工具
AI.tldr: 开发了一个利用卷积网络和图网络对Sentinel-2遥感图像进行分割和特征编码的无监督标注流程，通过将图像分割成同质区域并使用GNN聚合邻域信息，实现了高上下文一致性（SSIM=0.96, SAM=0.21），解决了传统方法对预标注数据的依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像标注耗时、成本高昂且需要专家分析。现有的标注工具依赖于预标注数据进行训练，才能标注新的未见数据。本文的动机是开发一个无监督的流程，以消除对预标注数据的依赖，实现对具有相似上下文和内容的地理区域的自动查找和标注。
AI.method: 本文定义了一个无监督流程，用于在Sentinel-2卫星影像中查找和标注具有相似上下文和内容的地理区域。方法核心包括：1. **图像分割：** 将图像分割成基于颜色和空间相似性分组的同质像素区域。2. **特征编码：** 利用卷积网络和图神经网络（GNN）进行分割，以编码更鲁棒的特征空间。3. **邻域聚合：** 使用GNN聚合周边区域的信息，使得特征表示能够编码局部邻域信息，同时保留自身的局部信息。
AI.result: 该流程实现了高上下文一致性，在上下文感知评估下，相似性得分达到SSIM = 0.96和SAM = 0.21，证明了其特征空间对于交互式标注具有鲁棒的组织能力。
AI.translation: 遥感成像的机器学习依赖于最新和准确的标签进行模型训练和测试。遥感影像的标注耗时且成本高昂，需要专家分析。以前的标注工具依赖于预标注数据进行训练，才能标注新的未见数据。在这项工作中，我们定义了一个无监督的流程，用于在Sentinel-2卫星影像中查找和标注具有相似上下文和内容的地理区域。我们的方法通过利用卷积和图神经网络进行分割，编码出更鲁棒的特征空间进行图像比较，从而消除了先前方法的局限性。与以前的方法不同，我们将图像分割成基于颜色和空间相似性分组的同质像素区域。图神经网络用于聚合周边区域的信息，使特征表示能够编码局部邻域信息，同时保留其自身的局部信息。这减少了标注工具中的异常值，允许用户在细粒度级别进行标注，并允许在编码空间内形成图像级别的旋转不变语义关系。我们的流程实现了高上下文一致性，在上下文感知评估下，相似性得分达到SSIM = 0.96和SAM = 0.21，证明了特征空间对于交互式标注的鲁棒组织能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用卷积网络（CNN）和图神经网络（GNN）的无监督遥感影像标注流程。该方法解决了传统标注工具依赖预标注数据的局限性。通过将Sentinel-2图像分割成同质区域，并使用GNN聚合邻域上下文信息，该流程生成了鲁棒且具有旋转不变性的特征表示。实验结果显示，该方法在上下文感知评估中表现出高一致性（SSIM=0.96，SAM=0.21），适用于交互式细粒度标注。
AI.keywords: 无监督标注, 遥感, 图神经网络, 卷积网络, Sentinel-2
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将图像分割与图神经网络相结合，在遥感标注领域提供了一个无监督的解决方案。通过摆脱对昂贵预标注数据的依赖，该方法极大地降低了遥感数据处理的门槛和成本。利用GNN聚合局部邻域信息，确保了特征编码的上下文一致性和鲁棒性，特别适用于处理遥感图像中复杂的地理空间关系。性能指标（SSIM和SAM）表明其在特征组织方面非常有效，对交互式标注工具的开发具有重要意义。

title: A Context-Aware Dual-Metric Framework for Confidence Estimation in Large Language Models
summary: Accurate confidence estimation is essential for trustworthy large language models (LLMs) systems, as it empowers the user to determine when to trust outputs and enables reliable deployment in safety-critical applications. Current confidence estimation methods for LLMs neglect the relevance between responses and contextual information, a crucial factor in output quality evaluation, particularly in scenarios where background knowledge is provided. To bridge this gap, we propose CRUX (Context-aware entropy Reduction and Unified consistency eXamination), the first framework that integrates context faithfulness and consistency for confidence estimation via two novel metrics. First, contextual entropy reduction represents data uncertainty with the information gain through contrastive sampling with and without context. Second, unified consistency examination captures potential model uncertainty through the global consistency of the generated answers with and without context. Experiments across three benchmark datasets (CoQA, SQuAD, QuAC) and two domain-specific datasets (BioASQ, EduQG) demonstrate CRUX's effectiveness, achieving the highest AUROC than existing baselines.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于大型语言模型置信度估计的上下文感知双指标框架
AI.tldr: 为了提高LLM的置信度估计的可信赖性，我们提出了CRUX框架，这是一个上下文感知的双指标方法。它通过“上下文熵减”和“统一一致性检验”来测量数据和模型的双重不确定性。实验结果显示，该方法在五个问答数据集上的AUROC表现优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 准确的置信度估计对于可信赖的大型语言模型（LLMs）系统至关重要，它使用户能够确定何时信任输出，并使得在安全关键应用中可靠部署成为可能。然而，现有方法忽略了响应与上下文信息之间的相关性，而这是评估输出质量的关键因素，尤其是在提供了背景知识的场景中。
AI.method:
提出了CRUX（上下文感知熵减和统一一致性检验）框架，这是第一个整合上下文忠实度和一致性进行置信度估计的方法。它包含两个新颖的指标：
1.  **上下文熵减：** 通过对比有无上下文的对比采样信息增益来表示数据不确定性。
2.  **统一一致性检验：** 通过考察有无上下文生成的答案的全局一致性来捕获潜在的模型不确定性。
AI.result: 实验在三个基准数据集（CoQA、SQuAD、QuAC）和两个特定领域数据集（BioASQ、EduQG）上进行，结果证明CRUX框架是有效的，并取得了高于现有基线的最高AUROC值。
AI.conclusion: CRUX框架通过整合上下文忠实度和一致性，并利用上下文熵减和统一一致性检验这两个新颖的指标，显著提高了大型语言模型置信度估计的准确性，并在多个数据集上取得了最高的AUROC表现。
AI.translation: 准确的置信度估计对于可信赖的大型语言模型（LLMs）系统至关重要，因为它使用户能够确定何时信任输出，并使得在安全关键应用中可靠部署成为可能。当前的LLMs置信度估计方法忽略了响应与上下文信息之间的相关性，而这是评估输出质量的关键因素，尤其是在提供了背景知识的场景中。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了CRUX（上下文感知熵减和统一一致性检验），这是第一个通过两个新颖的指标，整合上下文忠实度和一致性来进行置信度估计的框架。首先，“上下文熵减”通过对比有无上下文的采样信息增益来表示数据不确定性。其次，“统一一致性检验”通过考察有无上下文生成的答案的全局一致性来捕获潜在的模型不确定性。跨越三个基准数据集（CoQA、SQuAD、QuAC）和两个特定领域数据集（BioASQ、EduQG）的实验证明了CRUX的有效性，实现了比现有基线最高的AUROC。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CRUX框架，一个用于提高大型语言模型（LLMs）置信度估计准确性的上下文感知双指标方法。针对现有方法忽略上下文关联性的问题，CRUX创新性地引入了“上下文熵减”（衡量数据不确定性）和“统一一致性检验”（衡量模型不确定性）两个指标，整合了上下文忠实度和一致性。实验证明，CRUX在五个数据集上的AUROC表现优于所有现有基线。
AI.keywords: 置信度估计, 大型语言模型, 上下文感知, 双指标, AUROC
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于认识到上下文信息（尤其是在提供了背景知识的场景中）对LLM输出质量评估的关键性，并将其系统性地整合到置信度估计框架CRUX中。通过设计“上下文熵减”和“统一一致性检验”这两个相互补充的指标（分别关注数据不确定性和模型不确定性），CRUX提供了一个更全面、更鲁棒的置信度评估机制，有助于提高LLMs在安全关键应用中的可信赖性。其在多个领域数据集上超越现有基线的表现，证实了上下文感知方法在置信度估计中的重要性和有效性。

title: TestWeaver: Execution-aware, Feedback-driven Regression Testing Generation with Large Language Models
summary: While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating test generation for regression testing, they often suffer from limited reasoning about program execution, resulting in stagnated coverage growth - a phenomenon known as the coverage plateau. This paper presents TestWeaver, a novel LLM-based approach that integrates lightweight program analysis to create a focused execution context that assists LLMs in better test generation. TestWeaver strategically chooses the following components to overcome LLMs' limited reasoning on complex execution: (1) it reduces hallucinations and improves focus by supplying the LLM with the backward slice from the target line instead of a full program context; (2) it identifies and incorporates close test cases - those that share control-flow similarities with the path to the target line - to provide focused execution context within the LLM's context window; and (3) it enhances LLM's reasoning with execution in-line annotations that encode variable states as comments along the executed path. By equipping LLMs with these targeted and contextualized inputs, it improves coverage-guided test generation and mitigates redundant explorations. Empirical results show that TestWeaver accelerates code coverage growth and generates more effective test cases than the state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.title_translation: TestWeaver：执行感知、反馈驱动的基于大语言模型的回归测试生成
AI.tldr: TestWeaver是一种新的基于LLM的回归测试生成方法，它通过结合轻量级程序分析（如反向切片、相似测试用例和执行路径注释）来提供聚焦的执行上下文，从而克服LLM在复杂执行推理上的不足，显著加速代码覆盖增长并生成更有效的测试用例。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在自动化回归测试生成中展现出潜力，但它们在程序执行推理方面存在局限性，导致覆盖率增长停滞，即“覆盖率平台”现象。
AI.method: TestWeaver是一种基于LLM的方法，它集成轻量级程序分析来创建聚焦的执行上下文。具体策略包括：（1）提供目标行反向切片而非完整程序上下文，以减少幻觉并提高专注度；（2）识别并纳入与目标行路径共享控制流相似性的“相近”测试用例；（3）使用执行内联注释来编码执行路径上的变量状态，从而增强LLM的推理能力。
AI.result: TestWeaver加速了代码覆盖率的增长，并生成了比现有最先进方法更有效的测试用例。
AI.conclusion: 通过为大语言模型配备这些有针对性和情境化的输入，TestWeaver提高了覆盖率引导的测试生成效率，并减轻了冗余探索。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展在自动化回归测试生成方面展现出前景，但它们往往因对程序执行的推理有限而受到影响，导致覆盖率增长停滞——这一现象被称为覆盖率平台。本文提出了TestWeaver，一种新颖的基于LLM的方法，它集成了轻量级程序分析来创建聚焦的执行上下文，从而协助LLMs更好地生成测试。TestWeaver战略性地选择了以下组件来克服LLMs在复杂执行推理上的局限性：（1）通过向LLM提供目标行的反向切片而不是完整的程序上下文，来减少幻觉并提高专注度；（2）识别并纳入相近的测试用例——那些与目标行路径共享控制流相似性的用例——在LLM的上下文窗口内提供聚焦的执行上下文；以及（3）通过执行内联注释来增强LLM的推理能力，这些注释将变量状态编码为沿执行路径的注释。通过为LLMs配备这些有针对性和情境化的输入，它提高了覆盖率引导的测试生成效率并减轻了冗余探索。实证结果表明，TestWeaver加速了代码覆盖率的增长，并生成了比现有最先进方法更有效的测试用例。
AI.summary: TestWeaver是一种新颖的LLM驱动的回归测试生成方法，旨在解决LLM因缺乏执行推理能力而导致的覆盖率平台问题。该方法通过集成轻量级程序分析，提供高度聚焦的上下文，具体包括使用目标行的反向切片、识别控制流相似的相近测试用例以及利用编码变量状态的执行内联注释。实证结果表明，TestWeaver能有效加速代码覆盖率增长，并生成比现有技术更有效的测试用例。
AI.keywords: 回归测试, 大语言模型, 测试生成, 执行感知, 覆盖率平台
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其“执行感知、反馈驱动”的框架，有效地弥补了大语言模型在复杂程序执行推理上的固有缺陷。通过战略性地使用轻量级程序分析技术（如反向切片和执行注释）来创建聚焦且上下文丰富的输入，TestWeaver成功地将LLMs的能力从通用代码生成转向精确的覆盖率引导的测试生成，解决了测试自动化领域中LLM应用的一个关键瓶颈——覆盖率平台问题。

title: $R^2$-CoD: Understanding Text-Graph Complementarity in Relational Reasoning via Knowledge Co-Distillation
summary: Relational reasoning lies at the core of many NLP tasks, drawing on complementary signals from text and graphs. While prior research has investigated how to leverage this dual complementarity, a detailed and systematic understanding of text-graph interplay and its effect on hybrid models remains underexplored. We take an analysis-driven approach to investigate text-graph representation complementarity via a unified architecture that supports knowledge co-distillation (CoD). We explore five tasks involving relational reasoning that differ in how text and graph structures encode the information needed to solve that task. By tracking how these dual representations evolve during training, we uncover interpretable patterns of alignment and divergence, and provide insights into when and why their integration is beneficial.

AI.title_translation: $R^2$-CoD：通过知识协同蒸馏理解关系推理中的文本-图互补性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了$R^2$-CoD框架，采用分析驱动的方法，通过知识协同蒸馏（CoD）来系统地研究文本和图结构在五种关系推理任务中的互补性，揭示了它们对齐和发散的模式，并解释了何时以及为何整合它们是有益的。
AI.motivation: 关系推理是许多NLP任务的核心，它依赖于文本和图的互补信号。尽管现有研究探索了如何利用这种双重互补性，但对于文本-图的相互作用及其对混合模型影响的详细和系统性理解仍有待深入探索。
AI.method: 采用分析驱动的方法，通过一个支持知识协同蒸馏（CoD）的统一架构来研究文本-图表示的互补性。研究探索了五种涉及关系推理的任务，并通过跟踪双重表示在训练过程中的演变来揭示模式。
AI.result: 揭示了可解释的对齐和发散模式，并提供了关于何时以及为何整合文本和图结构（即它们的集成）是有益的见解。
AI.translation: 关系推理是许多自然语言处理（NLP）任务的核心，它依赖于来自文本和图的互补信号。尽管先前的研究已经调查了如何利用这种双重互补性，但对于文本-图相互作用及其对混合模型影响的详细和系统性理解仍然不足。我们采用分析驱动的方法，通过一个支持知识协同蒸馏（CoD）的统一架构来研究文本-图表示的互补性。我们探索了五种涉及关系推理的任务，它们在文本和图结构如何编码解决任务所需的信息方面有所不同。通过跟踪这些双重表示在训练过程中的演变，我们揭示了解释性的对齐和发散模式，并提供了关于何时以及为何它们的集成是有益的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了$R^2$-CoD框架，旨在系统性地理解关系推理任务中文本和图表示的互补性。通过采用知识协同蒸馏（CoD）的统一分析驱动架构，研究者在五种不同的关系推理任务上追踪了双重表示的演变。结果揭示了文本和图信号对齐与发散的可解释模式，从而提供了关于整合文本和图信息何时最有益的关键洞察。
AI.keywords: 关系推理, 文本-图互补性, 知识协同蒸馏, 混合模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其分析驱动的方法，旨在系统地理解文本和图结构在关系推理中的深层互补性，而不仅仅是简单地将它们结合起来。通过引入$R^2$-CoD（知识协同蒸馏）的统一架构，它提供了一个平台来追踪和解释两种模态表示在训练中的动态变化，揭示了它们对齐和发散的模式。这项工作的重要性在于，它为未来设计更高效、更具解释性的混合模型提供了理论基础和实践指导，尤其是在处理依赖多模态信息进行复杂推理的NLP任务时。

title: Web-CogReasoner: Towards Knowledge-Induced Cognitive Reasoning for Web Agents
comments: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Our code and data is released at https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner
summary: Multimodal large-scale models have significantly advanced the development of web agents, enabling perception and interaction with digital environments akin to human cognition. In this paper, we argue that web agents must first acquire sufficient knowledge to effectively engage in cognitive reasoning. Therefore, we decompose a web agent's capabilities into two essential stages: knowledge content learning and cognitive processes. To formalize this, we propose Web-CogKnowledge Framework, categorizing knowledge as Factual, Conceptual, and Procedural. In this framework, knowledge content learning corresponds to the agent's processes of Memorizing and Understanding, which rely on the first two knowledge types, representing the "what" of learning. Conversely, cognitive processes correspond to Exploring, grounded in Procedural knowledge, defining the "how" of reasoning and action. To facilitate knowledge acquisition, we construct the Web-CogDataset, a structured resource curated from 14 real-world websites, designed to systematically instill core knowledge necessary for web agent. This dataset serves as the agent's conceptual grounding-the "nouns" upon which comprehension is built-as well as the basis for learning how to reason and act. Building on this foundation, we operationalize these processes through a novel knowledge-driven Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning framework, developing and training our proposed agent, the Web-CogReasoner. Extensive experimentation reveals its significant superiority over existing models, especially in generalizing to unseen tasks where structured knowledge is decisive. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce the Web-CogBench, a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to assess and compare agent performance across the delineated knowledge domains and cognitive capabilities. Our code and data is open sourced at https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Our code and data is released at https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner

AI.title_translation: Web-CogReasoner：迈向知识诱导的Web智能体认知推理
AI.tldr: 提出Web-CogReasoner智能体，使用Web-CogDataset（包含事实、概念、程序知识）和知识驱动的思维链（CoT）框架进行认知推理，显著提高了Web任务的泛化能力，并引入了评估基准Web-CogBench。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体需要先获取足够的知识才能进行有效的认知推理。因此，本文将智能体的能力分解为知识内容学习和认知过程两个基本阶段，以实现更接近人类的认知能力。
AI.method: 提出了Web-CogKnowledge框架，将知识分为事实、概念和程序三类，并将智能体能力分解为知识内容学习（记忆、理解）和认知过程（探索）。构建了Web-CogDataset（包含14个真实网站的数据）以系统灌输核心知识。最后，通过一种新颖的知识驱动思维链（CoT）推理框架，开发并训练了Web-CogReasoner智能体，并引入了Web-CogBench进行严格评估。
AI.result: 广泛实验证明，Web-CogReasoner显著优于现有模型，特别是在结构化知识具有决定性作用的新任务泛化方面表现出卓越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化知识和认知推理框架，Web-CogReasoner在Web智能体任务中实现了卓越的性能和泛化能力，特别是在处理需要结构化知识的未见任务时。
AI.translation: 多模态大规模模型显著推动了Web智能体的发展，使其能够像人类认知一样感知和交互数字环境。在本文中，我们认为Web智能体必须首先获取足够的知识才能有效地进行认知推理。因此，我们将Web智能体的能力分解为两个基本阶段：知识内容学习和认知过程。为了形式化这一过程，我们提出了Web-CogKnowledge框架，将知识归类为事实性、概念性和程序性知识。在该框架中，知识内容学习对应于智能体的记忆和理解过程，依赖于前两种知识类型，代表学习的“内容（what）”。相反，认知过程对应于探索，以程序性知识为基础，定义了推理和行动的“方式（how）”。为了促进知识获取，我们构建了Web-CogDataset，这是一个从14个真实世界网站整理而来的结构化资源，旨在系统地灌输Web智能体所需的核心知识。该数据集作为智能体的概念基础——构建理解的“名词”——以及学习如何推理和行动的基础。在此基础上，我们通过一种新颖的知识驱动思维链（CoT）推理框架来操作这些过程，开发并训练了我们提出的智能体Web-CogReasoner。广泛的实验表明，它显著优于现有模型，特别是在泛化到结构化知识具有决定性作用的未见任务方面。为了实现严格的评估，我们引入了Web-CogBench，这是一个旨在评估和比较智能体在所描绘的知识域和认知能力上的性能的综合评估套件。我们的代码和数据已在 https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner 开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Web-CogReasoner，一个面向Web智能体的知识诱导认知推理框架。作者提出了Web-CogKnowledge框架，将智能体能力分解为知识内容学习（记忆与理解）和认知过程（探索），并将知识分为事实、概念和程序性三类。为此，他们构建了Web-CogDataset来系统地灌输核心知识，并基于知识驱动的思维链（CoT）推理框架训练了Web-CogReasoner。实验证明，该智能体在泛化到需要结构化知识的新任务方面，显著优于现有模型。同时，还引入了Web-CogBench用于严格评估。
AI.keywords: Web智能体, 认知推理, 知识诱导, 思维链, Web-CogDataset
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于明确提出并形式化了Web智能体的“知识”在认知推理中的核心作用。通过将智能体能力分解为知识学习和认知过程，并提出了Web-CogKnowledge框架（区分事实、概念和程序知识），提供了一个清晰的理论基础。构建Web-CogDataset和Web-CogBench是重要的贡献，它们不仅为知识的系统灌输提供了资源，也为未来智能体的严格评估设立了标准。知识驱动的CoT推理框架是实现高效泛化的关键，这解决了现有Web智能体在处理未见任务时结构化知识不足的局限性。

title: PyCAT4: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer-based Framework for 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Recently, a significant improvement in the accuracy of 3D human pose estimation has been achieved by combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with pyramid grid alignment feedback loops. Additionally, innovative breakthroughs have been made in the field of computer vision through the adoption of Transformer-based temporal analysis architectures. Given these advancements, this study aims to deeply optimize and improve the existing Pymaf network architecture. The main innovations of this paper include: (1) Introducing a Transformer feature extraction network layer based on self-attention mechanisms to enhance the capture of low-level features; (2) Enhancing the understanding and capture of temporal signals in video sequences through feature temporal fusion techniques; (3) Implementing spatial pyramid structures to achieve multi-scale feature fusion, effectively balancing feature representations differences across different scales. The new PyCAT4 model obtained in this study is validated through experiments on the COCO and 3DPW datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed improvement strategies significantly enhance the network's detection capability in human pose estimation, further advancing the development of human pose estimation technology.

AI.title_translation: PyCAT4：一种基于层次化视觉Transformer的3D人体姿态估计框架
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入基于Transformer的自注意力机制、时间特征融合和空间金字塔结构，对现有Pymaf网络进行了深度优化，提出了PyCAT4模型，该模型在COCO和3DPW数据集上显著提高了3D人体姿态估计的检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（CNN和金字塔网格对齐反馈循环、基于Transformer的时间分析架构）已显著提高了3D人体姿态估计的精度。本文旨在对现有的Pymaf网络架构进行深度优化和改进。
AI.method: 提出新的PyCAT4模型，旨在优化Pymaf网络。主要方法创新包括：1. 引入基于自注意力机制的Transformer特征提取网络层，以增强低级特征捕获。2. 通过特征时间融合技术，增强对视频序列中时间信号的理解。3. 实施空间金字塔结构，实现多尺度特征融合。
AI.result: 在COCO和3DPW数据集上进行了实验验证。结果表明，所提出的改进策略显著增强了网络在人体姿态估计中的检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的改进策略显著提升了网络性能，进一步推动了人体姿态估计技术的发展。
AI.translation: 最近，通过将卷积神经网络（CNN）与金字塔网格对齐反馈循环相结合，3D人体姿态估计的准确性取得了显著提高。此外，通过采用基于Transformer的时间分析架构，计算机视觉领域也取得了创新性突破。鉴于这些进展，本研究旨在对现有的Pymaf网络架构进行深度优化和改进。本文的主要创新包括：（1）引入基于自注意力机制的Transformer特征提取网络层，以增强对低级特征的捕获；（2）通过特征时间融合技术，增强对视频序列中时间信号的理解和捕获；（3）实施空间金字塔结构，以实现多尺度特征融合，有效平衡不同尺度间的特征表示差异。本研究中获得的新模型PyCAT4通过在COCO和3DPW数据集上的实验得到验证。结果表明，所提出的改进策略显著增强了网络在人体姿态估计中的检测能力，进一步推动了人体姿态估计技术的发展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PyCAT4的层次化视觉Transformer框架，旨在深度优化现有Pymaf网络以进行3D人体姿态估计。其主要创新点在于引入基于自注意力机制的Transformer层以捕获低级特征、使用时间融合技术处理视频序列中的时间信号，以及通过空间金字塔结构实现多尺度特征融合。在COCO和3DPW数据集上的实验结果表明，这些改进策略显著增强了网络的人体姿态检测能力。
AI.keywords: 3D人体姿态估计, 视觉Transformer, 层次化, 时间融合, PyCAT4
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将现有的Pymaf网络与最新的Transformer技术和时间建模方法进行有效融合。它不仅引入了基于自注意力机制的Transformer层来专门增强低级特征的捕获，还通过时间融合技术提高了对视频序列中时间信息的理解。这种层次化和多尺度的设计，结合了CNN的局部优势和Transformer的全局优势，是推动3D人体姿态估计领域发展的重要一步。

title: SoilNet: A Multimodal Multitask Model for Hierarchical Classification of Soil Horizons
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), in particular foundation models, have improved the state of the art in many application domains including geosciences. Some specific problems, however, could not benefit from this progress yet. Soil horizon classification, for instance, remains challenging because of its multimodal and multitask characteristics and a complex hierarchically structured label taxonomy. Accurate classification of soil horizons is crucial for monitoring soil condition. In this work, we propose \textit{SoilNet} - a multimodal multitask model to tackle this problem through a structured modularized pipeline. In contrast to omnipurpose AI foundation models, our approach is designed to be inherently transparent by following the task structure human experts developed for solving this challenging annotation task. The proposed approach integrates image data and geotemporal metadata to first predict depth markers, segmenting the soil profile into horizon candidates. Each segment is characterized by a set of horizon-specific morphological features. Finally, horizon labels are predicted based on the multimodal concatenated feature vector, leveraging a graph-based label representation to account for the complex hierarchical relationships among soil horizons. Our method is designed to address complex hierarchical classification, where the number of possible labels is very large, imbalanced and non-trivially structured. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a real-world soil profile dataset and a comprehensive user study with domain experts. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate that SoilNet reliably predicts soil horizons that are plausible and accurate. User study results indicate that SoilNet achieves predictive performance on par with or better than that of human experts. All code can be found at: https://github.com/calgo-lab/BGR/

AI.title_translation: SoilNet：一个用于土壤层位分层分类的多模态多任务模型
AI.tldr: SoilNet是一个多模态、多任务AI模型，用于解决复杂的土壤层位分层分类问题，通过整合图像和地理时序元数据，并使用基于图的标签表示，其性能可媲美甚至优于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 土壤层位分类由于其多模态、多任务特性以及复杂的层次化标签分类法，仍然具有挑战性，而准确的分类对于监测土壤状况至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了SoilNet，一个结构化的模块化流程：首先整合图像数据和地理时序元数据来预测深度标记并分割土壤剖面；然后提取层位特有的形态特征；最后，利用多模态串联特征向量和基于图的标签表示法，对具有复杂层次关系的土壤层位进行预测。
AI.result: 在真实世界土壤剖面数据集上证明了方法的有效性。实证评估表明SoilNet可靠地预测出合理且准确的土壤层位。用户研究结果显示，SoilNet的预测性能与人类专家相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: SoilNet成功地解决了复杂的土壤层位分层分类问题，通过采用多模态、多任务和透明化的结构化方法，实现了与人类专家相当或更优的预测性能。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI），特别是基础模型，最近的进展改善了包括地球科学在内的许多应用领域的现有技术水平。然而，一些特定的问题尚未从这一进展中受益。例如，土壤层位分类因其多模态和多任务特性以及复杂的层次化标签分类法而仍然具有挑战性。准确的土壤层位分类对于监测土壤状况至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了SoilNet——一个多模态多任务模型，通过结构化的模块化流程来解决这个问题。与通用AI基础模型相反，我们的方法被设计成天然透明，遵循人类专家为解决这一具有挑战性的注释任务而开发的任务结构。所提出的方法整合了图像数据和地理时序元数据，首先预测深度标记，将土壤剖面分割成候选层位。每个层位段都通过一组层位特有的形态特征来表征。最后，利用基于图的标签表示法来解释土壤层位之间复杂的层次关系，基于多模态串联特征向量来预测层位标签。我们的方法旨在解决复杂的层次分类问题，其中可能的标签数量非常大、不平衡且结构非平凡。我们在一个真实世界的土壤剖面数据集上以及对领域专家的综合用户研究中证明了我们方法的有效性。我们的实证评估表明，SoilNet能够可靠地预测出合理且准确的土壤层位。用户研究结果表明，SoilNet的预测性能与人类专家相当或更优。所有代码可在以下网址找到：https://github.com/calgo-lab/BGR/
AI.summary: 本文提出了SoilNet，一个多模态多任务模型，用于解决具有挑战性的土壤层位分层分类问题。该模型通过结构化模块化流程，整合图像数据和地理时序元数据，进行剖面分割、特征提取，并利用基于图的标签表示法处理复杂的层次化标签。SoilNet通过实证评估和用户研究证明了其有效性，其预测准确性和合理性与人类专家相当或更优。
AI.keywords: 土壤层位分类, 多模态, 多任务, 分层分类, 基于图的标签表示
AI.comments: **创新点：** 1. 专门针对地球科学中复杂的、多模态、多任务的土壤层位分类问题设计了一个定制化的AI模型（SoilNet），而不是依赖通用基础模型。2. 引入了结构化的模块化流程，模仿人类专家的标注过程，增强了模型的可解释性（透明性）。3. 使用基于图的标签表示法来有效地处理数量巨大、不平衡且具有复杂层次结构的标签分类法。**重要性：** 实现了与人类专家相当或更优的预测性能，对于土壤条件监测和地球科学自动化具有重要意义。

title: Rethinking Creativity Evaluation: A Critical Analysis of Existing Creativity Evaluations
summary: We examine, analyze, and compare four representative creativity measures--perplexity, LLM-as-a-Judge, the Creativity Index (CI; measuring n-gram overlap with web corpora), and syntactic templates (detecting repetition of common part-of-speech patterns)--across the diverse creative domains, such as creative writing, unconventional problem-solving, and research ideation. For each domain, we compile datasets with human-aligned creative and uncreative examples and evaluate each metric's ability to discriminate between the two sets. Our analyses reveal limited consistency both across domains and metrics, as metrics that distinguish creativity in one domain fail in others (e.g., CI correctly distinguishes in creative writing but fails in problem-solving), and different metrics often disagree on the same data points (e.g., CI suggests one set to be more creative, while perplexity indicates the other set to be more creative.) We highlight key limitations, such as perplexity reflecting fluency rather than novelty; LLM-as-a-Judge producing inconsistent judgments under minor prompt variations and exhibiting bias towards particular labels; CI primarily measuring lexical diversity, with high sensitivity to implementation choices; and syntactic templates being ineffective in settings dominated by formulaic language. Our findings underscore the need for more robust, generalizable evaluation frameworks that better align with human judgments of creativity.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考创造力评估：对现有创造力评估的批判性分析
AI.tldr: 本文对四种主流创造力评估指标（困惑度、LLM-as-a-Judge、创造力指数和句法模板）在不同创造性领域（如创意写作、问题解决）的表现进行了批判性分析。结果显示，这些指标在跨领域和跨指标之间一致性有限，且存在严重局限性（如困惑度仅反映流畅性，LLM-as-a-Judge存在偏差和不一致性）。研究强调需要开发更通用、更符合人类判断的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有创造力评估方法缺乏一致性和可靠性，需要对其进行批判性分析和重新思考，以推动开发更健壮、更通用的评估框架。
AI.method: 研究检查、分析并比较了四种代表性的创造力衡量指标（困惑度、LLM-as-a-Judge、创造力指数（CI）和句法模板）。研究者在创意写作、非常规问题解决和研究构思等不同领域汇编了与人类判断一致的创造性和非创造性数据集，然后评估了每种指标区分这两组样本的能力。
AI.result: 分析揭示了指标在跨领域和跨指标之间的一致性有限。例如，在某一领域有效的指标在其他领域会失效（如CI在创意写作中有效但在问题解决中失败），且不同指标在相同数据点上经常产生分歧（如CI和困惑度的判断结果相反）。具体局限包括：困惑度反映流畅性而非新颖性；LLM-as-a-Judge在微小提示变化下判断不一致并带有偏差；CI主要衡量词汇多样性且对实施选择高度敏感；句法模板在惯用语境中无效。
AI.conclusion: 这一研究结果强调了开发更健壮、更通用、更符合人类创造力判断的评估框架的必要性。
AI.translation: 我们考察、分析并比较了四种代表性的创造力衡量指标——困惑度（perplexity）、LLM-as-a-Judge、创造力指数（CI；衡量与网络语料库的n-gram重叠）和句法模板（检测常见词性模式的重复）——跨越了不同的创造性领域，例如创意写作、非常规问题解决和研究构思。对于每个领域，我们整理了与人类判断一致的创造性和非创造性示例数据集，并评估了每种指标区分这两组样本的能力。我们的分析揭示了跨领域和跨指标之间的一致性有限，因为在一个领域能区分创造力的指标在其他领域会失败（例如，CI在创意写作中能正确区分，但在问题解决中失败），并且不同的指标在相同数据点上经常产生分歧（例如，CI提示一组更具创造性，而困惑度则指示另一组）。我们强调了关键的局限性，例如困惑度反映的是流畅性而非新颖性；LLM-as-a-Judge在微小的提示变化下会产生不一致的判断并对特定标签表现出偏见；CI主要衡量词汇多样性，对实施选择高度敏感；句法模板在惯用语言主导的环境中无效。我们的发现强调了需要更健壮、更通用且与人类创造力判断更好地对齐的评估框架。
AI.summary: 本文对四种主流的创造力评估指标（困惑度、LLM-as-a-Judge、创造力指数和句法模板）在创意写作、问题解决和研究构思等多个创造性领域进行了批判性分析和比较。研究通过人类校准的数据集评估了这些指标的区分能力。结果显示，这些评估指标在跨领域和跨指标上缺乏一致性，且存在严重缺陷。研究强调迫切需要开发出更通用、更可靠且与人类判断高度一致的创造力评估框架。
AI.keywords: 创造力评估, LLM-as-a-Judge, 困惑度, 创造力指数, 泛化性
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于它首次对当前流行的、尤其是基于大模型（LLM-as-a-Judge）和统计学（CI, Perplexity）的创造力评估方法进行了系统性的、跨领域的批判性检验。研究通过具体的实验数据揭示了这些指标在实际应用中的局限性和不一致性，有力地挑战了现有评估的可靠性。其创新点在于采用了“人类校准的创造性/非创造性示例”数据集作为黄金标准，并明确诊断了每种方法的失败原因（例如，区分流畅性和新颖性）。这项工作为未来设计更科学、更具泛化能力的创造力评估标准奠定了基础。

title: Holistic Explainable AI (H-XAI): Extending Transparency Beyond Developers in AI-Driven Decision Making
summary: As AI systems increasingly mediate decisions in domains such as credit scoring and financial forecasting, their lack of transparency and bias raises critical concerns for fairness and public trust. Existing explainable AI (XAI) approaches largely serve developers, focusing on model justification rather than the needs of affected users or regulators. We introduce Holistic eXplainable AI (H-XAI), a framework that integrates causality-based rating methods with post-hoc explanation techniques to support transparent, stakeholder-aligned evaluation of AI systems deployed in online decision contexts. H-XAI treats explanation as an interactive, hypothesis-driven process, allowing users, auditors, and organizations to ask questions, test hypotheses, and compare model behavior against automatically generated random and biased baselines. By combining global and instance-level explanations, H-XAI helps communicate model bias and instability that shape everyday digital decisions. Through case studies in credit risk assessment and stock price prediction, we show how H-XAI extends explainability beyond developers toward responsible and inclusive AI practices that strengthen accountability in sociotechnical systems.

AI.title_translation: 全面可解释人工智能（H-XAI）：在AI驱动的决策制定中将透明度扩展到开发者之外
AI.tldr: 现有的XAI只服务于开发者。本文提出了H-XAI框架，结合因果关系和事后解释技术，将AI系统的透明度和问责制扩展到用户、监管机构和审计师等更广泛的利益相关者，以确保负责任的AI实践。
AI.motivation: AI系统在信用评分和金融预测等关键领域中介决策时，缺乏透明度和存在偏见，引发了对公平性和公众信任的担忧。现有的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法主要服务于开发者，侧重于模型证明，而忽略了受影响用户或监管者的需求。
AI.method: 引入了“全面可解释人工智能”（H-XAI）框架。该框架集成了基于因果关系的评分方法和事后（post-hoc）解释技术。H-XAI将解释视为一个交互式、假设驱动的过程，允许用户、审计师和组织提问、测试假设，并将模型行为与自动生成的随机和有偏见的基线进行比较。它还结合了全局和实例级解释。
AI.result: 通过在信用风险评估和股票价格预测中的案例研究，H-XAI展示了如何将可解释性扩展到开发者之外，促进负责任和包容性的AI实践，从而加强社会技术系统中的问责制。
AI.conclusion: H-XAI通过将可解释性扩展到开发者之外，促进了负责任和包容性的AI实践，从而加强了社会技术系统中的问责制。
AI.translation: 随着AI系统越来越多地中介信用评分和金融预测等领域的决策，它们缺乏透明度和存在偏见的问题引发了对公平性和公众信任的严重担忧。现有的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法主要服务于开发者，侧重于模型证明，而不是受影响用户或监管者的需求。我们引入了全面可解释人工智能（H-XAI），这是一个将基于因果关系的评分方法与事后解释技术相结合的框架，旨在支持在在线决策环境中部署的AI系统的透明、利益相关者一致的评估。H-XAI将解释视为一个交互式、假设驱动的过程，允许用户、审计师和组织提问、测试假设，并将模型行为与自动生成的随机和有偏见的基线进行比较。通过结合全局和实例级解释，H-XAI有助于传达影响日常数字决策的模型偏见和不稳定性。通过在信用风险评估和股票价格预测中的案例研究，我们展示了H-XAI如何将可解释性扩展到开发者之外，促进负责任和包容性的AI实践，从而加强社会技术系统中的问责制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“全面可解释人工智能”（H-XAI）框架，以解决现有XAI方法仅服务于开发者而忽略用户和监管者需求的局限性。H-XAI通过结合基于因果关系的评分方法和事后解释技术，提供了一个交互式、假设驱动的解释过程，允许利益相关者测试假设并比较模型行为与基线。该框架旨在揭示模型偏见和不稳定性，从而在关键决策领域实现超越开发者的、负责任和包容性的AI实践。
AI.keywords: 全面可解释人工智能 (H-XAI), 透明度, 利益相关者, 因果关系, 模型偏见
AI.comments: H-XAI的创新在于其将可解释性的焦点从单纯的模型证明（服务于开发者）转移到了利益相关者（用户、监管者、审计师）的需求上。它通过集成因果关系和事后解释技术，并引入交互式、假设驱动的解释流程及自动基线比较，增强了AI系统的透明度和问责制。这对于推动AI伦理和治理，以及在关键社会技术系统中建立公众信任具有重要意义。

title: Accelerating Data Chunking in Deduplication Systems using Vector Instructions
comments: This paper has been accepted for publication with the ACM Transactions on Storage journal. It is the follow-up work to our FAST 2025 paper, "VectorCDC: Accelerating Data Deduplication with Vector Instructions". The associated code is available at https://github.com/UWASL/dedup-bench
summary: Content-defined Chunking (CDC) algorithms dictate the overall space savings that deduplication systems achieve. However, due to their need to scan each file in its entirety, they are slow and often the main performance bottleneck within data deduplication. We present VectorCDC, a method to accelerate hashless CDC algorithms using vector CPU instructions, such as SSE / AVX. We analyzed the state-of-the-art chunking algorithms and discovered that hashless algorithms primarily use two data processing patterns to identify chunk boundaries: Extreme Byte Searches and Range Scans. VectorCDC presents a vector-friendly approach to accelerate these two patterns. Using VectorCDC, we accelerated three state-of-the-art hashless chunking algorithms: RAM, AE, and MAXP. Our evaluation shows that VectorCDC is effective on Intel, AMD, ARM, and IBM CPUs, achieving 8.35x - 26.2x higher throughput than existing vector-accelerated algorithms, and 15.3x - 207.2x higher throughput than existing unaccelerated algorithms. VectorCDC achieves this without affecting the deduplication space savings.
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication with the ACM Transactions on Storage journal. It is the follow-up work to our FAST 2025 paper, "VectorCDC: Accelerating Data Deduplication with Vector Instructions". The associated code is available at https://github.com/UWASL/dedup-bench

AI.title_translation: 使用向量指令加速重复数据删除系统中的数据分块
AI.tldr: 内容定义分块（CDC）是重复数据删除系统的性能瓶颈。本文提出了VectorCDC，利用向量指令（SSE/AVX）加速无哈希CDC算法中的关键数据处理模式。VectorCDC在多种CPU上实现了15.3倍至207.2倍的吞吐量提升，且保持了去重率。
AI.motivation: 内容定义分块（CDC）算法是重复数据删除系统实现空间节省的关键，但由于需要扫描整个文件，它们速度慢，通常是主要的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出VectorCDC方法，利用SSE/AVX等向量CPU指令加速无哈希（hashless）的CDC算法。VectorCDC通过向量友好的方法，加速了无哈希算法中主要的两种数据处理模式：极端字节搜索（Extreme Byte Searches）和范围扫描（Range Scans）。
AI.result: VectorCDC成功加速了RAM、AE和MAXP三种无哈希分块算法。在Intel、AMD、ARM和IBM CPU上均有效，吞吐量比现有向量加速算法高8.35倍至26.2倍，比现有未加速算法高15.3倍至207.2倍，同时不影响重复数据删除的空间节省。
AI.conclusion: VectorCDC是一种高效的方法，能够利用向量指令显著加速内容定义分块过程，从而解决重复数据删除系统的性能瓶颈，同时保持原有的数据去重效率。
AI.translation: 内容定义分块（CDC）算法决定了重复数据删除系统能实现的总空间节省。然而，由于它们需要扫描每个文件的全部内容，因此速度缓慢，并且通常是数据重复数据删除中的主要性能瓶颈。我们提出了VectorCDC，一种利用SSE/AVX等向量CPU指令来加速无哈希CDC算法的方法。我们分析了最先进的分块算法，发现无哈希算法主要使用两种数据处理模式来识别分块边界：极端字节搜索（Extreme Byte Searches）和范围扫描（Range Scans）。VectorCDC提出了一种向量友好的方法来加速这两种模式。利用VectorCDC，我们加速了三种最先进的无哈希分块算法：RAM、AE和MAXP。我们的评估表明，VectorCDC在Intel、AMD、ARM和IBM CPU上均有效，吞吐量比现有向量加速算法高8.35倍至26.2倍，比现有未加速算法高15.3倍至207.2倍。VectorCDC实现这一目标的同时，不影响重复数据删除的空间节省。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了VectorCDC，这是一种利用SSE/AVX等向量指令来加速无哈希内容定义分块（CDC）算法的方法，旨在解决数据去重系统的主要性能瓶颈。通过分析，VectorCDC专注于加速极端字节搜索和范围扫描两种关键数据处理模式。评估结果显示，VectorCDC在多种CPU上实现了极高的吞吐量提升（相比未加速算法提高15.3倍至207.2倍），同时保持了原始的去重空间节省效果。
AI.keywords: 数据分块, 重复数据删除, 向量指令, CDC, 性能
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于精准定位了无哈希内容定义分块（CDC）算法中的核心瓶颈模式（极端字节搜索和范围扫描），并设计了VectorCDC这一专门针对向量指令优化的架构来加速这些模式。其重要性体现在实现了巨大的性能提升（相比未加速算法最高达207.2倍），并且这种加速在主流的Intel、AMD、ARM和IBM等多种CPU架构上均有效，对提高高吞吐量数据去重系统的效率具有重大实际意义。

title: Remote Sensing Image Intelligent Interpretation with the Language-Centered Perspective: Principles, Methods and Challenges
summary: The mainstream paradigm of remote sensing image interpretation has long been dominated by vision-centered models, which rely on visual features for semantic understanding. However, these models face inherent limitations in handling multi-modal reasoning, semantic abstraction, and interactive decision-making. While recent advances have introduced Large Language Models (LLMs) into remote sensing workflows, existing studies primarily focus on downstream applications, lacking a unified theoretical framework that explains the cognitive role of language. This review advocates a paradigm shift from vision-centered to language-centered remote sensing interpretation. Drawing inspiration from the Global Workspace Theory (GWT) of human cognition, We propose a language-centered framework for remote sensing interpretation that treats LLMs as the cognitive central hub integrating perceptual, task, knowledge and action spaces to enable unified understanding, reasoning, and decision-making. We first explore the potential of LLMs as the central cognitive component in remote sensing interpretation, and then summarize core technical challenges, including unified multimodal representation, knowledge association, and reasoning and decision-making. Furthermore, we construct a global workspace-driven interpretation mechanism and review how language-centered solutions address each challenge. Finally, we outline future research directions from four perspectives: adaptive alignment of multimodal data, task understanding under dynamic knowledge constraints, trustworthy reasoning, and autonomous interaction. This work aims to provide a conceptual foundation for the next generation of remote sensing interpretation systems and establish a roadmap toward cognition-driven intelligent geospatial analysis.

AI.title_translation: 遥感影像智能解译的语言中心视角：原理、方法与挑战
AI.tldr: 本文回顾并提倡将遥感图像解译范式从传统的视觉中心模型转向语言中心模型，借鉴人类认知中的全局工作空间理论（GWT），提出一个以大型语言模型（LLMs）为认知中心的统一框架，并总结了当前挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 主流的遥感图像解译范式是视觉中心的，但其在处理多模态推理、语义抽象和交互式决策方面存在固有限制。现有将LLMs引入遥感的工作缺乏统一的理论框架来解释语言的认知作用。因此，需要提出一种从视觉中心到语言中心的范式转变。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性文章。方法包括：借鉴人类认知的全局工作空间理论（GWT），提出一个语言中心的遥感解译框架，将LLMs视为整合感知、任务、知识和行动空间的认知中心枢纽。总结了核心技术挑战，并构建了一个全局工作空间驱动的解译机制来回顾语言中心解决方案如何应对这些挑战。
AI.result: 本文提出了一个语言中心的框架，旨在为下一代遥感解译系统提供概念基础，并建立一条通往认知驱动的智能地理空间分析的路线图。此外，文章还概述了四个未来的研究方向：自适应对齐、动态知识下的任务理解、可信赖推理和自主交互。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在通过提出一个基于全局工作空间理论的语言中心框架，为下一代遥感解译系统提供概念基础，并建立一条通往认知驱动的智能地理空间分析的路线图。
AI.translation: 长期以来，遥感影像解译的主流范式一直由视觉中心模型主导，这些模型依赖视觉特征进行语义理解。然而，这些模型在处理多模态推理、语义抽象和交互式决策方面面临固有限制。尽管最近的进展已将大型语言模型（LLMs）引入遥感工作流程，但现有研究主要集中于下游应用，缺乏解释语言认知作用的统一理论框架。本综述提倡将遥感解译的范式从视觉中心转向语言中心。借鉴人类认知的全局工作空间理论（GWT），我们提出了一个语言中心的遥感解译框架，该框架将LLMs视为整合感知、任务、知识和行动空间的认知中心枢纽，以实现统一的理解、推理和决策。我们首先探讨了LLMs作为遥感解译中核心认知组件的潜力，然后总结了核心技术挑战，包括统一多模态表示、知识关联以及推理与决策。此外，我们构建了一个全局工作空间驱动的解译机制，并回顾了语言中心解决方案如何应对各项挑战。最后，我们从四个角度概述了未来的研究方向：多模态数据的自适应对齐、动态知识约束下的任务理解、可信赖的推理以及自主交互。这项工作旨在为下一代遥感解译系统提供概念基础，并建立一条通往认知驱动的智能地理空间分析的路线图。
AI.summary: 本综述批判了传统的视觉中心遥感解译范式在多模态和高级语义理解上的局限性。为应对此挑战，文章倡导范式转变为语言中心，并提出一个基于人类全局工作空间理论（GWT）的框架，将大型语言模型（LLMs）定位为整合感知、任务、知识和行动的认知中心枢纽。文章总结了统一多模态表示、知识关联和推理决策等核心技术挑战，构建了解译机制，并提出了未来研究的四个方向，旨在为认知驱动的智能地理空间分析提供理论基础和发展路线图。
AI.keywords: 遥感解译, 语言中心, 大型语言模型, 全局工作空间理论, 认知框架
AI.comments: **创新性/重要性：** 本文的创新点在于明确提出并系统化地倡导将遥感解译的范式从视觉中心转向语言中心，并首次将人类认知的全局工作空间理论（GWT）引入遥感领域，为LLMs在遥感中的应用提供了急需的理论支撑和统一框架。这对于推动遥感智能解译系统向更高级别的语义抽象、多模态推理和自主决策发展具有重要指导意义，为“认知驱动”的地理空间分析奠定了概念基础。

title: CCFQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual and Cross-Modal Speech and Text Factuality Evaluation
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly popularized in the multilingual world, ensuring hallucination-free factuality becomes markedly crucial. However, existing benchmarks for evaluating the reliability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly focus on textual or visual modalities with a primary emphasis on English, which creates a gap in evaluation when processing multilingual input, especially in speech. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Cross-lingual and Cross-modal Factuality benchmark (CCFQA). Specifically, the CCFQA benchmark contains parallel speech-text factual questions across 8 languages, designed to systematically evaluate MLLMs' cross-lingual and cross-modal factuality capabilities. Our experimental results demonstrate that current MLLMs still face substantial challenges on the CCFQA benchmark. Furthermore, we propose a few-shot transfer learning strategy that effectively transfers the Question Answering (QA) capabilities of LLMs in English to multilingual Spoken Question Answering (SQA) tasks, achieving competitive performance with GPT-4o-mini-Audio using just 5-shot training. We release CCFQA as a foundational research resource to promote the development of MLLMs with more robust and reliable speech understanding capabilities. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yxduir/ccfqa.

AI.title_translation: CCFQA：一个用于跨语言和跨模态语音与文本事实性评估的基准
AI.tldr: 我们提出了CCFQA，一个包含8种语言的语音-文本事实性问题的跨语言跨模态基准，用于评估多模态大模型的可靠性。结果显示现有模型仍面临挑战，但我们提出的少样本迁移学习策略能有效提升多语言口语问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有用于评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）可靠性的基准主要集中于文本或视觉模态，且主要侧重于英语，这在处理多语言输入（尤其是语音）时产生了评估空白。为了填补这一空白，确保在全球化普及的大模型中实现无幻觉的事实性，本文提出了CCFQA基准。
AI.method: 提出了跨语言和跨模态事实性基准（CCFQA），该基准包含8种语言的并行语音-文本事实性问题。此外，提出了一种少样本迁移学习策略，用于将大模型在英语中的问答能力有效地迁移到多语言口语问答（SQA）任务中。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，当前的多模态大模型在CCFQA基准上仍面临巨大挑战。此外，本文提出的少样本迁移学习策略仅使用5次训练，就能有效地将英语问答能力迁移到多语言口语问答任务中，实现了与GPT-4o-mini-Audio相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: CCFQA作为一个基础研究资源被发布，旨在促进开发具有更强大和更可靠语音理解能力的多模态大模型。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在多语言世界中日益普及，确保无幻觉的事实性变得尤为关键。然而，现有用于评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）可靠性的基准主要集中于文本或视觉模态，且主要侧重于英语，这在处理多语言输入（尤其是语音）时产生了评估空白。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个新的跨语言和跨模态事实性基准（CCFQA）。具体来说，CCFQA基准包含8种语言的并行语音-文本事实性问题，旨在系统地评估MLLMs的跨语言和跨模态事实性能力。我们的实验结果表明，当前的多模态大模型在CCFQA基准上仍面临巨大挑战。此外，我们提出了一种少样本迁移学习策略，该策略能有效地将LLMs的英语问答（QA）能力迁移到多语言口语问答（SQA）任务中，仅使用5次训练就实现了与GPT-4o-mini-Audio相当的性能。我们发布CCFQA作为一个基础研究资源，以促进开发具有更强大和更可靠语音理解能力的多模态大模型。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/yxduir/ccfqa获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CCFQA，这是一个新的跨语言和跨模态事实性基准，旨在解决现有MLLM评估主要依赖英语文本/视觉模态，忽视多语言语音输入的问题。CCFQA包含8种语言的并行语音-文本事实性问题，用于系统评估MLLMs的可靠性。实验表明现有模型表现不佳，作者随后提出了一种少样本迁移学习策略，该策略能有效地将英语问答能力迁移到多语言口语问答任务中，并取得了与GPT-4o-mini-Audio相媲美的结果。
AI.keywords: 跨语言, 跨模态, 事实性评估, 基准, 语音问答
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了首个专门针对多模态大模型（MLLMs）事实性评估的跨语言、跨模态（语音和文本）基准CCFQA。这解决了现有评估体系过度依赖英语和单一模态的重大局限性，对于推动MLLMs在多语言环境下的可靠性和鲁棒性发展至关重要。此外，提出的少样本迁移学习策略为在资源有限的多语言语音问答任务中提高模型性能提供了一个高效的解决方案。

title: 1-2-3 Check: Enhancing Contextual Privacy in LLM via Multi-Agent Reasoning
comments: Accepted at the International Association for AI Safety and Ethics AI (IASEAI) 2026
summary: Addressing contextual privacy concerns remains challenging in interactive settings where large language models (LLMs) process information from multiple sources (e.g., summarizing meetings with private and public information). We introduce a multi-agent framework that decomposes privacy reasoning into specialized subtasks (extraction, classification), reducing the information load on any single agent while enabling iterative validation and more reliable adherence to contextual privacy norms. To understand how privacy errors emerge and propagate, we conduct a systematic ablation over information-flow topologies, revealing when and why upstream detection mistakes cascade into downstream leakage. Experiments on the ConfAIde and PrivacyLens benchmark with several open-source and closed-sourced LLMs demonstrate that our best multi-agent configuration substantially reduces private information leakage (\textbf{18\%} on ConfAIde and \textbf{19\%} on PrivacyLens with GPT-4o) while preserving the fidelity of public content, outperforming single-agent baselines. These results highlight the promise of principled information-flow design in multi-agent systems for contextual privacy with LLMs.

title: Recent Advances and Trends in Research Paper Recommender Systems: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: As the volume of scientific publications grows exponentially, researchers increasingly face difficulties in locating relevant literature. Research Paper Recommender Systems have become vital tools to mitigate this information overload by delivering personalized suggestions. This survey provides a comprehensive analysis of Research Paper Recommender Systems developed between November 2021 and December 2024, building upon prior reviews in the field. It presents an extensive overview of the techniques and approaches employed, the datasets utilized, the evaluation metrics and procedures applied, and the status of both enduring and emerging challenges observed during the research. Unlike prior surveys, this survey goes beyond merely cataloguing techniques and models, providing a thorough examination of how these methods are implemented across different stages of the recommendation process. By furnishing a detailed and structured reference, this work aims to function as a consultative resource for the research community, supporting informed decision-making and guiding future investigations in the advances of effective Research Paper Recommender Systems.

title: Complex Logical Instruction Generation
summary: Instruction following has catalyzed the recent era of Large Language Models (LLMs) and is the foundational skill underpinning more advanced capabilities such as reasoning and agentic behaviors. As tasks grow more challenging, the logic structures embedded in natural language instructions becomes increasingly intricate. However, how well LLMs perform on such logic-rich instructions remains under-explored. We propose LogicIFGen and LogicIFEval. LogicIFGen is a scalable, automated framework for generating verifiable instructions from code functions, which can naturally express rich logic such as conditions, loops, and function calls. We further curate a collection of complex code functions and use LogicIFGen to construct LogicIFEval, a benchmark comprising 426 verifiable logic-rich instructions. Our experiments demonstrate that current state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle to correctly follow the instructions in LogicIFEval. Most LLMs can only follow fewer than 60% of the instructions, revealing significant deficiencies in the instruction-following ability. Code and Benchmark: https://github.com/mianzhang/LogicIF

AI.tldr: 提出了LogicIFGen框架和LogicIFEval基准（包含426条基于代码函数的复杂逻辑指令）。实验证明，当前的SOTA LLMs在处理这些复杂逻辑指令时表现不佳，准确率低于60%，揭示了其指令遵循能力的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 指令遵循是LLMs实现推理和智能体行为等高级能力的基础。然而，随着任务复杂性的增加，指令中的逻辑结构也更复杂，目前缺乏对LLMs处理此类富含逻辑指令能力的深入探索。

AI.result: 实验证明，当前最先进的LLMs在LogicIFEval基准上表现不佳。大多数LLMs只能正确遵循不到60%的指令。

title: Physics-Constrained Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Models for Generation and Inverse Problems
summary: We present a framework for fine-tuning flow-matching generative models to enforce physical constraints and solve inverse problems in scientific systems. Starting from a model trained on low-fidelity or observational data, we apply a differentiable post-training procedure that minimizes weak-form residuals of governing partial differential equations (PDEs), promoting physical consistency and adherence to boundary conditions without distorting the underlying learned distribution. To infer unknown physical inputs, such as source terms, material parameters, or boundary data, we augment the generative process with a learnable latent parameter predictor and propose a joint optimization strategy. The resulting model produces physically valid field solutions alongside plausible estimates of hidden parameters, effectively addressing ill-posed inverse problems in a data-driven yet physicsaware manner. We validate our method on canonical PDE benchmarks, demonstrating improved satisfaction of PDE constraints and accurate recovery of latent coefficients. Our approach bridges generative modelling and scientific inference, opening new avenues for simulation-augmented discovery and data-efficient modelling of physical systems.

AI.title_translation: 针对生成和逆问题的流匹配模型的物理约束微调
AI.tldr: 提出了一种框架，用于微调流匹配生成模型，使其遵循物理定律（最小化PDE残差）并解决科学系统中的逆问题，同时还能推断隐藏的物理参数。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过在低保真或观测数据训练的模型基础上，施加物理约束（偏微分方程的弱形式残差），以解决科学系统中的生成和逆问题，确保物理有效性和边界条件的遵守。
AI.method: 提出了一种可微分的后训练（post-training）微调程序，通过最小化控制偏微分方程（PDEs）的弱形式残差来强制执行物理约束。对于逆问题，通过增加一个可学习的潜在参数预测器来增强生成过程，并采用联合优化策略。
AI.result: 在规范的PDE基准测试中验证了该方法，结果表明其提高了对PDE约束的满足度，并能准确恢复潜在系数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法弥合了生成建模和科学推理之间的差距，为模拟增强的发现和物理系统的节省数据的建模开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个框架，用于微调流匹配生成模型，以在科学系统中强制执行物理约束并解决逆问题。从一个在低保真或观测数据上训练的模型开始，我们应用一个可微分的后训练程序，该程序最小化控制偏微分方程（PDEs）的弱形式残差，从而在不扭曲底层学习分布的情况下，促进物理一致性和对边界条件的遵守。为了推断未知的物理输入，例如源项、材料参数或边界数据，我们通过一个可学习的潜在参数预测器来增强生成过程，并提出了一种联合优化策略。由此产生的模型可以生成物理有效的场解以及对隐藏参数的合理估计，从而以数据驱动但又物理感知的方式有效地解决了病态逆问题。我们在规范的PDE基准测试中验证了我们的方法，证明了其提高了对PDE约束的满足度以及对潜在系数的准确恢复。我们的方法弥合了生成建模和科学推理之间的差距，为模拟增强的发现和物理系统的节省数据的建模开辟了新途径。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种物理约束的微调框架，用于改进流匹配生成模型。该方法通过最小化控制PDE的弱形式残差，使模型在生成和解决科学系统逆问题时保持物理一致性。通过引入潜在参数预测器和联合优化策略，模型能够同时提供有效的场解和隐藏物理参数（如源项、材料参数）的估计，从而高效地解决了病态逆问题。
AI.keywords: 流匹配模型, 物理约束, 逆问题, 偏微分方程, 微调
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于提出了一个将生成建模（流匹配模型）与严格的物理约束（通过最小化PDE弱形式残差）相结合的后训练微调框架。这解决了纯数据驱动模型在科学应用中缺乏物理有效性的核心限制。通过引入对潜在参数的联合优化，该方法有效地将生成模型扩展到解决病态逆问题，这对于科学发现和数据效率建模具有重要的实际意义。

title: Learning to Detect Unseen Jailbreak Attacks in Large Vision-Language Models
comments: 12 pages; Previously this version appeared as arXiv:2510.15430 which was submitted as a new work by accident
summary: Despite extensive alignment efforts, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. To mitigate these risks, existing detection methods are essential, yet they face two major challenges: generalization and accuracy. While learning-based methods trained on specific attacks fail to generalize to unseen attacks, learning-free methods based on hand-crafted heuristics suffer from limited accuracy and reduced efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose Learning to Detect (LoD), a learnable framework that eliminates the need for any attack data or hand-crafted heuristics. LoD operates by first extracting layer-wise safety representations directly from the model's internal activations using Multi-modal Safety Concept Activation Vectors classifiers, and then converting the high-dimensional representations into a one-dimensional anomaly score for detection via a Safety Pattern Auto-Encoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoD consistently achieves state-of-the-art detection performance (AUROC) across diverse unseen jailbreak attacks on multiple LVLMs, while also significantly improving efficiency. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Learning-to-Detect-51CB.
