GTA generates artificial populations from census-based sociodemographic data. It simulates activity schedules and mode choices, enabling scalable, human-like simulations without handcrafted rules. We evaluate GTA in Berlin-scale experiments, comparing simulation results against empirical data. While agents replicate patterns, such as modal split by socioeconomic status, they show systematic biases in trip length and mode preference. GTA offers new opportunities for modeling how future innovations, from bike lanes to transit apps, shape mobility decisions.
comment: This version has been conditionally accepted at CHI 2026

title: Artificial Intelligence in Spanish Gastroenterology: high expectations, limited integration. A national survey
summary: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a disruptive innovation in medicine, yet its adoption within gastroenterology remains limited and poorly characterized. We aimed to examine knowledge, practical applications, perceived barriers, and expectations regarding AI among gastroenterology specialists in Spain. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional observational study using a structured online survey distributed by the Spanish Society of Digestive Pathology (SEPD) in 2025. The questionnaire collected sociodemographic data, patterns of AI use, perceptions, and educational needs. Descriptive statistics and multivariable models were applied. Results: Among 283 respondents (mean age 44.6 +/- 9.7 years), 87.5% acknowledged AI as a transformative tool, but only 60.2% (95% CI: 54.3-66.1%) reported using it, mostly outside institutional frameworks. Notably, 80.2% of users initiated AI use within the past year. Independent predictors of frequent use included previous training (OR=2.44), employment in university hospitals (OR=2.14), and younger age (OR=1.36 per 5-year decrease). Main barriers were lack of training (61%), absence of institutional strategies (46%), and ethical concerns (50%). While 93.8% agreed that AI training programmes are necessary, only 18.4% had received formal training. Conclusions: A substantial gap exists between the favorable perception of AI and its actual integration into clinical practice within Spanish gastroenterology. The rapid adoption outside institutional frameworks underscores the urgent need for accredited training programmes and governance standards led by scientific societies.

title: Atomic Depth Estimation From Noisy Electron Microscopy Data Via Deep Learning
summary: We present a novel approach for extracting 3D atomic-level information from transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images affected by significant noise. The approach is based on formulating depth estimation as a semantic segmentation problem. We address the resulting segmentation problem by training a deep convolutional neural network to generate pixel-wise depth segmentation maps using simulated data corrupted by synthetic noise. The proposed method was applied to estimate the depth of atomic columns in CeO2 nanoparticles from simulated images and real-world TEM data. Our experiments show that the resulting depth estimates are accurate, calibrated and robust to noise.

title: iFSQ: Improving FSQ for Image Generation with 1 Line of Code
comments: Technical Report; Fixed eq.7 & 8 and corresponding content
summary: The field of image generation is currently bifurcated into autoregressive (AR) models operating on discrete tokens and diffusion models utilizing continuous latents. This divide, rooted in the distinction between VQ-VAEs and VAEs, hinders unified modeling and fair benchmarking. Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) offers a theoretical bridge, yet vanilla FSQ suffers from a critical flaw: its equal-interval quantization can cause activation collapse. This mismatch forces a trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and information efficiency. In this work, we resolve this dilemma by simply replacing the activation function in original FSQ with a distribution-matching mapping to enforce a uniform prior. Termed iFSQ, this simple strategy requires just one line of code yet mathematically guarantees both optimal bin utilization and reconstruction precision. Leveraging iFSQ as a controlled benchmark, we uncover two key insights: (1) The optimal equilibrium between discrete and continuous representations lies at approximately 4 bits per dimension. (2) Under identical reconstruction constraints, AR models exhibit rapid initial convergence, whereas diffusion models achieve a superior performance ceiling, suggesting that strict sequential ordering may limit the upper bounds of generation quality. Finally, we extend our analysis by adapting Representation Alignment (REPA) to AR models, yielding LlamaGen-REPA. Codes is available at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/iFSQ

title: Rethinking Benchmarks for Differentially Private Image Classification
summary: We revisit benchmarks for differentially private image classification. We suggest a comprehensive set of benchmarks, allowing researchers to evaluate techniques for differentially private machine learning in a variety of settings, including with and without additional data, in convex settings, and on a variety of qualitatively different datasets. We further test established techniques on these benchmarks in order to see which ideas remain effective in different settings. Finally, we create a publicly available leader board for the community to track progress in differentially private machine learning.

title: SpecBridge: Bridging Mass Spectrometry and Molecular Representations via Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: Small-molecule identification from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) remains a bottleneck in untargeted settings where spectral libraries are incomplete. While deep learning offers a solution, current approaches typically fall into two extremes: explicit generative models that construct molecular graphs atom-by-atom, or joint contrastive models that learn cross-modal subspaces from scratch. We introduce SpecBridge, a novel implicit alignment framework that treats structure identification as a geometric alignment problem. SpecBridge fine-tunes a self-supervised spectral encoder (DreaMS) to project directly into the latent space of a frozen molecular foundation model (ChemBERTa), and then performs retrieval by cosine similarity to a fixed bank of precomputed molecular embeddings. Across MassSpecGym, Spectraverse, and MSnLib benchmarks, SpecBridge improves top-1 retrieval accuracy by roughly 20-25% relative to strong neural baselines, while keeping the number of trainable parameters small. These results suggest that aligning to frozen foundation models is a practical, stable alternative to designing new architectures from scratch. The code for SpecBridge is released at https://github.com/HassounLab/SpecBridge.

title: Power-based Partial Attention: Bridging Linear-Complexity and Full Attention
summary: It is widely accepted from transformer research that "attention is all we need", but the amount of attention required has never been systematically quantified. Is quadratic $O(L^2)$ attention necessary, or is there a sub-quadratic attention mechanism that can achieve comparable performance? To answer this question, we introduce power-based partial attention (PPA), an attention mechanism of order $O(L^{1+p})$, where $0 \leq p \leq 1$, such that $p=0$ corresponds to sliding window attention with linear complexity, and $p=1$ corresponds to full attention. With this attention construction, we can explore how transformer architecture performance varies as a function of the attention scaling behavior controlled by $p$. The overall trend from our experiments shows an S-curve-like behavior where the performance transitions from sliding-window (linear-complexity) attention to full attention over a narrow window of $p$ values, and plateaus as $p$ approaches $1$. In our experiments, we show that there exists $0<p<1$ such that $O(L^{1+p})$ attention is sufficient to achieve similar results as $O(L^2)$ full attention.

title: Numerical Study of Dissipative Weak Solutions for the Euler Equations of Gas Dynamics
summary: We study dissipative weak (DW) solutions of the Euler equations of gas dynamics using the first-, second-, third-, fifth-, seventh-, and ninth-order local characteristic decomposition-based central-upwind (LCDCU), low-dissipation central-upwind (LDCU), and viscous finite volume (VFV) methods, whose higher-order extensions are obtained via the framework of the alternative weighted essentially non-oscillatory (A-WENO) schemes. These methods are applied to several benchmark problems, including several two-dimensional Riemann problems and a Kelvin-Helmholtz instability test. The numerical results demonstrate that for methods converging only weakly in space and time, the limiting solutions are generalized DW solutions, approximated in the sense of ${\cal K}$-convergence and dependent on the numerical scheme. For all of the studied methods, we compute the associated Young measures and compare the DW solutions using entropy production and energy defect criteria.

title: Will It Zero-Shot?: Predicting Zero-Shot Classification Performance For Arbitrary Queries
summary: Vision-Language Models like CLIP create aligned embedding spaces for text and images, making it possible for anyone to build a visual classifier by simply naming the classes they want to distinguish. However, a model that works well in one domain may fail in another, and non-expert users have no straightforward way to assess whether their chosen VLM will work on their problem. We build on prior work using text-only comparisons to evaluate how well a model works for a given natural language task, and explore approaches that also generate synthetic images relevant to that task to evaluate and refine the prediction of zero-shot accuracy. We show that generated imagery to the baseline text-only scores substantially improves the quality of these predictions. Additionally, it gives a user feedback on the kinds of images that were used to make the assessment. Experiments on standard CLIP benchmark datasets demonstrate that the image-based approach helps users predict, without any labeled examples, whether a VLM will be effective for their application.

title: Truth-Revealing Participatory Budgeting
summary: Participatory Budgeting (PB) is commonly studied from an axiomatic perspective, where the aim is to design procedurally fair and economically efficient rules for voters with full information regarding their preferences. In contrast, we take an epistemic perspective and consider a framework where PB projects have different levels of underlying quality, indicating how well the project will take effect, which cannot be directly observed before implementation. Agents with noisy information cast votes to aggregate their information, and aim to elect a high-quality set of projects. We evaluate the performance of common PB rules by measuring the expected utility of their outcomes, compared to the optimal set of projects. We find that the quality of approximation improves as the range of project costs shrinks. When projects have unit cost, these common rules can identify the ``best'' set with probability converging to 1. We also study whether strategic agents have incentives to honestly convey their information in the vote. We find that it happens only under very restrictive conditions. We also run numerical experiments to examine the performance of different rules empirically and support our theoretical findings.

title: How AI Coding Agents Modify Code: A Large-Scale Study of GitHub Pull Requests
summary: AI coding agents are increasingly acting as autonomous contributors by generating and submitting pull requests (PRs). However, we lack empirical evidence on how these agent-generated PRs differ from human contributions, particularly in how they modify code and describe their changes. Understanding these differences is essential for assessing their reliability and impact on development workflows. Using the MSR 2026 Mining Challenge version of the AIDev dataset, we analyze 24,014 merged Agentic PRs (440,295 commits) and 5,081 merged Human PRs (23,242 commits). We examine additions, deletions, commits, and files touched, and evaluate the consistency between PR descriptions and their diffs using lexical and semantic similarity. Agentic PRs differ substantially from Human PRs in commit count (Cliff's $δ= 0.5429$) and show moderate differences in files touched and deleted lines. They also exhibit slightly higher description-to-diff similarity across all measures. These findings provide a large-scale empirical characterization of how AI coding agents contribute to open source development.

AI.title_translation: AI 编码代理如何修改代码：一项针对 GitHub 拉取请求的大规模研究
AI.tldr: 对 GitHub 上数万个 AI 代理生成的拉取请求与人类请求进行了大规模比较。发现 AI 代理的 PR 提交次数更多，涉及的文件和删除的行数差异中等，并且代码描述与实际更改的相似度略高于人类。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理正日益成为自主贡献者，通过生成和提交拉取请求（PR）参与开发。然而，我们缺乏关于这些代理生成的 PR 与人工贡献在修改代码和描述更改方面差异的实证证据。理解这些差异对于评估 AI 代理的可靠性及其对开发工作流程的影响至关重要。
AI.method: 使用 AIDev 数据集的 MSR 2026 挖掘挑战版本，分析了 24,014 个已合并的代理 PR 和 5,081 个人工 PR。研究检查了新增、删除、提交和涉及的文件数量，并使用词汇和语义相似性评估了 PR 描述与其差异（diffs）之间的一致性。
AI.result: 代理 PR 在提交次数上与人工 PR 存在显著差异（Cliff's $\delta= 0.5429$），在涉及的文件和删除的行数方面存在中等差异。此外，代理 PR 在所有度量中都表现出略高的描述与差异相似性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为 AI 编码代理如何对开源开发做出贡献提供了大规模的实证特征描述。
AI.translation: AI 编码代理正日益通过生成和提交拉取请求（PR）而成为自主贡献者。然而，我们缺乏关于这些代理生成的 PR 与人工贡献在如何修改代码和描述更改方面存在何种差异的实证证据。理解这些差异对于评估它们的可靠性及其对开发工作流程的影响至关重要。本研究使用 AIDev 数据集的 MSR 2026 挖掘挑战版本，分析了 24,014 个已合并的代理 PR（440,295 次提交）和 5,081 个已合并的人工 PR（23,242 次提交）。我们检查了新增、删除、提交和涉及的文件数量，并使用词汇和语义相似性评估了 PR 描述与其差异（diffs）之间的一致性。代理 PR 在提交次数上与人工 PR 存在显著差异（Cliff's $\delta= 0.5429$），在涉及的文件和删除的行数方面存在中等差异。它们在所有度量中也表现出略高的描述与差异相似性。这些发现提供了关于 AI 编码代理如何对开源开发做出贡献的大规模实证特征描述。
AI.summary: 本研究对 24,014 个由 AI 编码代理生成的 GitHub 拉取请求（PR）和 5,081 个人工 PR 进行了大规模实证比较，旨在量化它们在代码修改和更改描述方面的差异。分析结果显示，代理 PR 在提交次数上与人工 PR 存在显著差异，在涉及的文件和删除行数上存在中等差异。关键发现是，代理 PR 的描述与其代码更改的一致性（相似性）略高于人类 PR。
AI.keywords: AI 编码代理, 拉取请求, GitHub, 代码修改, 大规模研究
AI.comments: 本研究的重要性在于，它是最早对自主 AI 编码代理在真实世界（GitHub）中的贡献风格进行大规模、定量描述的研究之一。它提供了评估 AI 可靠性及其对开发工作流程影响所需的基础实证数据。通过量化代理 PR 与人类 PR 在提交数量和描述一致性等方面的差异，为未来 AI 工具的设计和集成提供了关键的见解，填补了关于 AI 代理实际贡献模式的实证空白。

title: Memento: Towards Proactive Visualization of Everyday Memories with Personal Wearable AR Assistant
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures. This is the author's version of the article that will appear at the IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces Abstracts and Workshops (IEEE VRW) 2026
summary: We introduce Memento, a conversational AR assistant that permanently captures and memorizes user's verbal queries alongside their spatiotemporal and activity contexts. By storing these "memories," Memento discovers connections between users' recurring interests and the contexts that trigger them. Upon detection of similar or identical spatiotemporal activity, Memento proactively recalls user interests and delivers up-to-date responses through AR, seamlessly integrating AR experience into their daily routine. Unlike prior work, each interaction in Memento is not a transient event, but a connected series of interactions with coherent long--term perspective, tailored to the user's broader multimodal (visual, spatial, temporal, and embodied) context. We conduct preliminary evaluation through user feedbacks with participants of diverse expertise in immersive apps, and explore the value of proactive context-aware AR assistant in everyday settings. We share our findings and challenges in designing a proactive, context-aware AR system.

AI.title_translation: Memento：迈向利用个人可穿戴AR助手实现日常记忆的主动可视化
AI.tldr: Memento是一个可穿戴AR助手，它永久记录用户的口头查询及其多模态上下文（时空、活动），并将这些“记忆”用于在检测到相似上下文时，主动提供相关信息和响应，实现AR体验的长期、连贯集成。
AI.motivation: 引入一种新型的AR助手，旨在通过捕获和存储用户查询及其上下文，发现用户的重复兴趣与触发这些兴趣的上下文之间的联系，从而探索主动式情境感知AR助手在日常环境中的价值，并将AR体验无缝集成到用户的日常生活中。
AI.method: Memento系统永久捕获并记忆用户的口头查询以及时空和活动上下文。它将这些信息存储为“记忆”，用于发现用户兴趣与触发上下文之间的连接。当系统检测到相似或相同的时空活动上下文时，它会主动回忆用户兴趣，并通过AR提供最新的响应。该系统设计侧重于连贯的长期视角和多模态上下文（视觉、空间、时间、具身）。进行了初步的用户反馈评估。
AI.result: 进行了初步的用户反馈评估，并探索了主动式情境感知AR助手在日常环境中的价值。分享了在设计主动式、情境感知AR系统中的发现和挑战。（具体评估数据未提及。）
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及具体的结论，但作者分享了在设计主动式、情境感知AR系统中的发现和挑战，并探索了其在日常环境中的价值。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 Memento，这是一款对话式AR助手，它永久捕获并记忆用户的口头查询及其时空和活动上下文。通过存储这些“记忆”，Memento 可以发现用户重复出现的兴趣与触发这些兴趣的上下文之间的联系。一旦检测到相似或相同的时空活动，Memento 就会主动回忆用户的兴趣，并通过AR提供最新的响应，将AR体验无缝集成到他们的日常生活中。与以往的工作不同，Memento 中的每次交互都不是一个短暂的事件，而是一系列相互关联、具有连贯长期视角的交互，并根据用户更广泛的多模态（视觉、空间、时间、具身）上下文进行定制。我们通过对具有沉浸式应用不同专业知识的参与者进行用户反馈，进行了初步评估，并探索了主动式情境感知AR助手在日常环境中的价值。我们分享了在设计主动式、情境感知AR系统方面的发现和挑战。
AI.summary: Memento是一种可穿戴对话式AR助手，旨在通过永久捕获用户的口头查询及其多模态上下文（时空、活动）来建立“日常记忆”。该系统通过分析这些记忆，发现用户兴趣与特定上下文之间的关联。当用户再次处于相似情境时，Memento会主动触发并可视化相关信息，提供最新的AR响应。该方法强调长期、连贯的交互视角，而非短暂事件，并通过初步用户反馈探索了这种主动式、情境感知AR系统在日常生活中的潜力。
AI.keywords: AR助手, 可穿戴计算, 情境感知, 主动式可视化, 日常记忆
AI.comments: Memento的创新点在于将AR交互从瞬时事件转变为具有连贯长期视角的“记忆”系列。通过结合用户的口头查询和多模态上下文（时空、活动），它构建了一个强大的个性化记忆库，使得AR助手能够主动预测用户的需求并提供情境感知的响应。这种主动性和长期记忆机制是推动可穿戴AR融入日常生活的关键一步，解决了传统AR应用缺乏上下文连贯性的问题，对于未来人机交互设计具有重要意义。

title: A Systemic Evaluation of Multimodal RAG Privacy
summary: The growing adoption of multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) pipelines for vision-centric tasks (e.g. visual QA) introduces important privacy challenges. In particular, while mRAG provides a practical capability to connect private datasets to improve model performance, it risks the leakage of private information from these datasets during inference. In this paper, we perform an empirical study to analyze the privacy risks inherent in the mRAG pipeline observed through standard model prompting. Specifically, we implement a case study that attempts to infer the inclusion of a visual asset, e.g. image, in the mRAG, and if present leak the metadata, e.g. caption, related to it. Our findings highlight the need for privacy-preserving mechanisms and motivate future research on mRAG privacy.

AI.title_translation: 多模态RAG隐私的系统性评估
AI.tldr: 对多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）管道的隐私风险进行了实证研究。通过案例研究，发现私人数据集中的视觉资产及其元数据（如图片说明）存在泄露风险，强调了引入隐私保护机制的必要性。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）管道在以视觉为中心的任务（如视觉问答）中的广泛应用，它带来了重要的隐私挑战。虽然mRAG能够连接私有数据集来提高模型性能，但在推理过程中存在泄露这些数据中私有信息的风险。
AI.method: 进行了一项实证研究，通过标准的模型提示（standard model prompting）来分析mRAG管道固有的隐私风险。具体实施了一个案例研究，试图推断多模态RAG中是否包含某个视觉资产（例如图像），如果包含，则尝试泄露与其相关的元数据（例如图片说明）。
AI.result: 研究结果强调了对隐私保护机制的迫切需求，并激发了未来针对mRAG隐私的研究。具体的泄露程度或成功率未在摘要中提及。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及具体的结论，但研究结果强调了mRAG隐私保护机制的必要性，并呼吁进行进一步研究。
AI.translation: 随着多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）管道在以视觉为中心的任务（例如视觉问答）中日益普及，它带来了重要的隐私挑战。特别是，虽然mRAG提供了一种连接私有数据集以提高模型性能的实用能力，但它也存在在推理过程中泄露这些数据中私有信息的风险。在本文中，我们进行了一项实证研究，通过标准的模型提示来分析mRAG管道固有的隐私风险。具体来说，我们实施了一个案例研究，试图推断多模态RAG中是否包含某个视觉资产（例如图像），如果包含，则尝试泄露与其相关的元数据（例如图片说明）。我们的研究结果强调了对隐私保护机制的需求，并激发了未来关于mRAG隐私的研究。
AI.summary: 本文对多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）管道中的隐私风险进行了系统性评估。研究动机在于mRAG在利用私有数据提升性能的同时，存在在推理时泄露信息的风险。作者通过一项实证研究和特定的案例分析，测试了通过标准模型提示推断视觉资产的包含性并泄露其元数据（如图片说明）的可能性。研究结果强调了未来在mRAG中开发和应用隐私保护机制的紧迫性。
AI.keywords: 多模态RAG, 隐私风险, 视觉资产, 数据泄露, 实证研究
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它是对新兴的多模态检索增强生成（mRAG）管道隐私风险进行的早期且系统的实证评估。mRAG结合了视觉和语言数据，其隐私泄露的复杂性高于传统的单模态系统。通过设计一个针对视觉资产包含性和元数据泄露的案例研究，作者有效地展示了mRAG在实际应用中潜在的安全漏洞，为该领域未来的隐私保护机制设计（例如差分隐私或安全多方计算）提供了明确的研究方向和必要性证明。

title: The LLM Data Auditor: A Metric-oriented Survey on Quality and Trustworthiness in Evaluating Synthetic Data
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for generating data across various modalities. By transforming data from a scarce resource into a controllable asset, LLMs mitigate the bottlenecks imposed by the acquisition costs of real-world data for model training, evaluation, and system iteration. However, ensuring the high quality of LLM-generated synthetic data remains a critical challenge. Existing research primarily focuses on generation methodologies, with limited direct attention to the quality of the resulting data. Furthermore, most studies are restricted to single modalities, lacking a unified perspective across different data types. To bridge this gap, we propose the \textbf{LLM Data Auditor framework}. In this framework, we first describe how LLMs are utilized to generate data across six distinct modalities. More importantly, we systematically categorize intrinsic metrics for evaluating synthetic data from two dimensions: quality and trustworthiness. This approach shifts the focus from extrinsic evaluation, which relies on downstream task performance, to the inherent properties of the data itself. Using this evaluation system, we analyze the experimental evaluations of representative generation methods for each modality and identify substantial deficiencies in current evaluation practices. Based on these findings, we offer concrete recommendations for the community to improve the evaluation of data generation. Finally, the framework outlines methodologies for the practical application of synthetic data across different modalities.

AI.title_translation: LLM数据审计员：一项面向指标的评估合成数据质量和可信度的调查
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“LLM数据审计员”框架，对LLM生成的合成数据进行评估。该框架系统地分类了衡量数据质量和可信度的内在指标，并发现现有评估实践存在严重缺陷，最后提出了改进建议。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能生成数据以缓解真实数据采集成本，但确保所生成合成数据的高质量仍是关键挑战。现有研究主要关注生成方法，缺乏对结果数据质量的直接关注，且缺乏跨模态的统一视角。
AI.method: 提出了“LLM数据审计员”框架。首先描述了LLM如何跨六种不同模态生成数据。更重要的是，系统地从质量和可信度两个维度，对评估合成数据的内在指标进行了分类，将评估重点从外在（下游任务性能）转向数据本身的固有属性。
AI.result: 使用该评估系统分析了每种模态的代表性生成方法的实验评估，并发现了当前评估实践中存在重大缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 根据研究发现，为社区改进数据生成评估提供了具体的建议。此外，该框架还概述了跨不同模态合成数据的实际应用方法。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为跨各种模态生成数据的强大工具。通过将数据从稀缺资源转变为可控资产，LLMs缓解了获取真实世界数据用于模型训练、评估和系统迭代所带来的瓶颈。然而，确保LLM生成的合成数据的高质量仍然是一个关键挑战。现有研究主要侧重于生成方法，对结果数据的质量直接关注有限。此外，大多数研究仅限于单一模态，缺乏跨不同数据类型的统一视角。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了“LLM数据审计员”框架。在这个框架中，我们首先描述了LLMs如何被用于跨六种不同模态生成数据。更重要的是，我们系统地从质量和可信度两个维度对评估合成数据的内在指标进行了分类。这种方法将焦点从依赖下游任务性能的外在评估，转移到数据本身的固有属性上。利用这个评估系统，我们分析了每种模态的代表性生成方法的实验评估，并指出了当前评估实践中存在的重大缺陷。基于这些发现，我们为社区改进数据生成评估提供了具体的建议。最后，该框架概述了跨不同模态合成数据的实际应用方法。
AI.summary: 本调查提出了一个名为“LLM数据审计员”的框架，旨在解决LLM生成合成数据质量评估中的挑战。针对现有研究缺乏统一视角和过度关注生成方法的问题，该框架首先描述了LLM在六种模态中的数据生成方式，随后系统地构建了基于质量和可信度两个维度的内在指标体系。通过应用这些指标分析现有生成方法的评估，本研究发现了当前实践中的显著不足，并提供了具体的改进建议，同时概述了合成数据的实际应用方法。
AI.keywords: LLM, 合成数据, 数据质量, 可信度, 跨模态评估
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个系统化的、面向指标的框架（LLM Data Auditor），专注于评估LLM生成的合成数据本身的内在质量（Quality）和可信度（Trustworthiness），而不是仅仅依赖下游任务性能（外在评估）。这种视角转变对于推动高质量合成数据的研究至关重要，因为它提供了一个统一的、跨模态的评估标准，直接指出了当前研究中评估实践的重大缺陷，为未来数据生成的研究提供了明确的改进方向。

title: The Script is All You Need: An Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Dialogue-to-Cinematic Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have produced models capable of synthesizing stunning visual content from simple text prompts. However, these models struggle to generate long-form, coherent narratives from high-level concepts like dialogue, revealing a ``semantic gap'' between a creative idea and its cinematic execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel, end-to-end agentic framework for dialogue-to-cinematic-video generation. Central to our framework is ScripterAgent, a model trained to translate coarse dialogue into a fine-grained, executable cinematic script. To enable this, we construct ScriptBench, a new large-scale benchmark with rich multimodal context, annotated via an expert-guided pipeline. The generated script then guides DirectorAgent, which orchestrates state-of-the-art video models using a cross-scene continuous generation strategy to ensure long-horizon coherence. Our comprehensive evaluation, featuring an AI-powered CriticAgent and a new Visual-Script Alignment (VSA) metric, shows our framework significantly improves script faithfulness and temporal fidelity across all tested video models. Furthermore, our analysis uncovers a crucial trade-off in current SOTA models between visual spectacle and strict script adherence, providing valuable insights for the future of automated filmmaking.

AI.title_translation: 剧本就是你所需要的一切：一种用于长程对话到电影级视频生成的智能体框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端的智能体框架（包括ScripterAgent和DirectorAgent），用于将对话转化为连贯的长程电影级视频。该框架通过生成精细的电影剧本来弥合语义鸿沟，并引入了新的基准ScriptBench和评估指标VSA。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型难以根据对话等高级概念生成长篇、连贯的叙事，这暴露了创意理念与其电影化实现之间的“语义鸿沟”。
AI.method: 提出了一种端到端的智能体框架。核心是**ScripterAgent**，它将粗糙的对话转化为可执行的、细粒度的电影剧本（通过在新建的**ScriptBench**上训练）。然后，**DirectorAgent**利用跨场景连续生成策略来协调最先进的视频模型，以确保长程连贯性。评估通过**CriticAgent**和新的**视觉-剧本对齐（VSA）**指标进行。
AI.result: 该框架显著提高了所有测试视频模型的剧本忠实度和时间保真度。分析揭示了当前最先进模型在视觉奇观和严格剧本依从性之间存在关键的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功弥合了对话到电影级视频生成中的语义鸿沟，并通过引入新的评估机制和基准，为自动化电影制作的未来提供了有价值的见解。
AI.translation: 近期视频生成领域的进展已催生出能够从简单文本提示合成出惊艳视觉内容的模型。然而，这些模型难以根据对话等高级概念生成长篇、连贯的叙事，揭示了创意理念与其电影化执行之间的“语义鸿沟”。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们引入了一种新颖的、端到端的智能体框架，用于对话到电影级视频的生成。我们框架的核心是**ScripterAgent**，一个经过训练的模型，用于将粗糙的对话翻译成细粒度的、可执行的电影剧本。为此，我们构建了**ScriptBench**，一个通过专家指导流程标注的、具有丰富多模态上下文的新型大规模基准。生成的剧本随后指导**DirectorAgent**，它利用跨场景连续生成策略来协调最先进的视频模型，以确保长程连贯性。我们全面的评估，包括一个由AI驱动的**CriticAgent**和一个新的**视觉-剧本对齐（VSA）**度量，表明我们的框架显著提高了所有测试视频模型的剧本忠实度和时间保真度。此外，我们的分析揭示了当前SOTA模型在视觉奇观和严格剧本依从性之间存在关键的权衡，为自动化电影制作的未来提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为“剧本就是你所需要的一切”的智能体框架，旨在解决现有视频生成模型在将高级对话概念转化为连贯、长程电影级视频时遇到的“语义鸿沟”。该框架包含**ScripterAgent**（负责将对话转化为细致的电影剧本，并基于新的**ScriptBench**基准进行训练）和**DirectorAgent**（负责利用跨场景连续生成策略协调视频模型）。评估采用了**CriticAgent**和**VSA**指标，结果显示该框架显著提升了视频的剧本忠实度和时间连贯性，并揭示了现有模型在视觉质量与剧本遵循度之间的平衡问题。
AI.keywords: 智能体框架, 电影级视频生成, 剧本对齐, ScripterAgent, ScriptBench
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其将复杂的长程视频生成任务分解为专业化的“智能体”（ScripterAgent, DirectorAgent, CriticAgent）和结构化的中间表示（电影剧本）。剧本作为核心，有效地将高层次的语义输入（对话）与低层次的视觉生成操作解耦，这是弥合“语义鸿沟”的关键。引入**ScriptBench**和**VSA**指标，体现了对生成内容质量和对齐度进行精确评估的努力，对于推动自动化电影制作领域的发展具有重要意义。该框架揭示的视觉效果与剧本忠实度之间的权衡，也为未来模型设计指明了方向。

title: MV-S2V: Multi-View Subject-Consistent Video Generation
summary: Existing Subject-to-Video Generation (S2V) methods have achieved high-fidelity and subject-consistent video generation, yet remain constrained to single-view subject references. This limitation renders the S2V task reducible to an S2I + I2V pipeline, failing to exploit the full potential of video subject control. In this work, we propose and address the challenging Multi-View S2V (MV-S2V) task, which synthesizes videos from multiple reference views to enforce 3D-level subject consistency. Regarding the scarcity of training data, we first develop a synthetic data curation pipeline to generate highly customized synthetic data, complemented by a small-scale real-world captured dataset to boost the training of MV-S2V. Another key issue lies in the potential confusion between cross-subject and cross-view references in conditional generation. To overcome this, we further introduce Temporally Shifted RoPE (TS-RoPE) to distinguish between different subjects and distinct views of the same subject in reference conditioning. Our framework achieves superior 3D subject consistency w.r.t. multi-view reference images and high-quality visual outputs, establishing a new meaningful direction for subject-driven video generation. Our project page is available at: https://szy-young.github.io/mv-s2v

AI.title_translation: MV-S2V：多视角主体一致性视频生成
AI.tldr: 现有S2V方法受限于单视角，无法实现3D主体一致性。本文提出MV-S2V任务，利用多视角参考图生成视频，并使用合成数据、真实数据和TS-RoPE来解决数据稀缺和参考混淆问题，显著提高了3D主体一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的主体到视频生成（S2V）方法受限于单视角主体参考，导致任务退化为S2I（主体到图像）+I2V（图像到视频）的流水线，未能充分发挥视频主体控制的潜力。作者旨在解决具有挑战性的多视角S2V（MV-S2V）任务，以实现3D级别的主体一致性。
AI.method: 1. 提出并解决了多视角S2V（MV-S2V）任务。 2. 开发了一种合成数据整理流程（synthetic data curation pipeline）来生成高度定制化的合成数据，并辅以小规模的真实世界捕获数据集。 3. 引入时间偏移的RoPE（Temporally Shifted RoPE, TS-RoPE）来区分条件生成中的跨主体和同一主体的不同视角参考，以避免混淆。
AI.result: 该框架实现了相对于多视角参考图像的卓越的3D主体一致性，并输出了高质量的视觉效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为主体驱动的视频生成建立了一个新的、有意义的方向。
AI.translation: 现有的主体到视频生成（S2V）方法已经实现了高保真度和主体一致性的视频生成，但仍局限于单视角主体参考。这种限制使得S2V任务可以简化为S2I + I2V的流水线，未能充分发挥视频主体控制的全部潜力。在这项工作中，我们提出并解决了具有挑战性的多视角S2V（MV-S2V）任务，该任务从多个参考视角合成视频，以强制实现3D级别的主体一致性。考虑到训练数据的稀缺性，我们首先开发了一个合成数据整理流程来生成高度定制化的合成数据，并辅以一个小规模的真实世界捕获数据集，以促进MV-S2V的训练。另一个关键问题在于条件生成中跨主体和跨视角参考之间潜在的混淆。为了克服这个问题，我们进一步引入了时间偏移的RoPE（TS-RoPE）来区分参考条件中的不同主体和同一主体的不同视角。我们的框架实现了相对于多视角参考图像的卓越的3D主体一致性以及高质量的视觉输出，为主体驱动的视频生成建立了一个新的有意义的方向。我们的项目页面位于：https://szy-young.github.io/mv-s2v
AI.summary: 本文提出了多视角主体一致性视频生成（MV-S2V）任务，旨在克服现有S2V方法仅限于单视角参考的问题，实现3D级别的主体一致性。为解决数据稀缺，作者创建了一个合成数据生成流程并结合真实数据集。同时，为了解决条件生成中跨主体和跨视角参考的混淆，引入了时间偏移的RoPE（TS-RoPE）。实验结果表明，MV-S2V框架在多视角参考下实现了卓越的3D主体一致性和高质量的视频生成，为该领域开辟了新方向。
AI.keywords: Multi-View S2V, Subject-Consistent Video Generation, 3D Consistency, TS-RoPE
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将S2V任务从二维平面的一致性推向了三维空间的一致性，通过引入多视角参考（MV-S2V）来解决现有方法退化为S2I+I2V流水线的问题，极大地提高了主体控制的难度和实用性。为解决训练数据稀缺，作者结合了合成数据和真实数据，这种数据增强策略对于新兴的、对数据要求高的3D生成任务至关重要。TS-RoPE的引入巧妙地解决了多条件输入（多视角/多主体）之间的内在区分问题，是技术上的一个亮点。该工作为未来更复杂的3D感知视频生成模型奠定了基础。

title: Geometry-Grounded Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian Splatting (GS) has demonstrated impressive quality and efficiency in novel view synthesis. However, shape extraction from Gaussian primitives remains an open problem. Due to inadequate geometry parameterization and approximation, existing shape reconstruction methods suffer from poor multi-view consistency and are sensitive to floaters. In this paper, we present a rigorous theoretical derivation that establishes Gaussian primitives as a specific type of stochastic solids. This theoretical framework provides a principled foundation for Geometry-Grounded Gaussian Splatting by enabling the direct treatment of Gaussian primitives as explicit geometric representations. Using the volumetric nature of stochastic solids, our method efficiently renders high-quality depth maps for fine-grained geometry extraction. Experiments show that our method achieves the best shape reconstruction results among all Gaussian Splatting-based methods on public datasets.

AI.tldr: 针对高斯溅射（GS）在形状提取上的不足，本文提出了“几何基础的高斯溅射”，通过将高斯基元理论化为“随机实体”，直接将其视为明确的几何表示，从而高效地渲染高质量深度图，实现了最佳的形状重建效果。
AI.motivation: 高斯溅射（GS）在新视角合成中表现出色，但从高斯基元中提取形状是一个悬而未决的问题。现有形状重建方法由于几何参数化和近似不足，导致多视图一致性差，且对“漂浮物”（floaters）敏感。
AI.method: 提出了一个严格的理论推导，将高斯基元确立为一种特定类型的“随机实体”（stochastic solids）。这一理论框架为“几何基础的高斯溅射”提供了原则性基础，使其能够将高斯基元直接视为明确的几何表示。利用随机实体的体积特性，该方法可以高效地渲染高质量的深度图，以进行精细的几何提取。
AI.result: 实验表明，在公共数据集上，该方法在所有基于高斯溅射的方法中实现了最佳的形状重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高斯基元理论化为随机实体并利用其体积特性，该方法成功解决了高斯溅射中形状提取的难题，并实现了最先进的几何重建性能。
AI.translation: 高斯溅射（GS）在新视角合成中展示了令人印象深刻的质量和效率。然而，从高斯基元中提取形状仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。由于几何参数化和近似的不足，现有的形状重建方法存在多视图一致性差、对“漂浮物”敏感的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一个严格的理论推导，将高斯基元确立为一种特定类型的随机实体。这一理论框架通过将高斯基元直接视为明确的几何表示，为“几何基础的高斯溅射”提供了原则性的基础。利用随机实体的体积特性，我们的方法可以高效地渲染高质量的深度图，以进行精细的几何提取。实验表明，在公共数据集上，我们的方法在所有基于高斯溅射的方法中取得了最佳的形状重建结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出“几何基础的高斯溅射”（Geometry-Grounded Gaussian Splatting），旨在解决传统高斯溅射（GS）在形状提取中多视图一致性差和对漂浮物敏感的问题。通过严格的理论推导，将高斯基元定义为“随机实体”，使其能够被视为明确的几何表示。利用随机实体的体积特性，该方法高效地渲染高质量深度图，实现了基于GS方法中的最佳形状重建性能。
AI.keywords: 高斯溅射, 形状提取, 几何重建, 随机实体, 深度图
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于为高斯溅射（GS）提供了坚实的几何理论基础。通过将高斯基元提升至“随机实体”的地位，它解决了GS长期以来缺乏明确几何表示的问题。这种理论上的严谨性使得形状提取不再是后处理步骤，而是基于基元本身性质的直接渲染。其重要性在于，它极大地拓宽了GS的应用范围，使其不仅适用于新视角合成，还能用于高质量的三维重建任务，克服了现有方法对“漂浮物”和多视图不一致性的敏感性。抽象中未提及计算复杂度或训练/推理速度的对比，这可能是潜在的局限性信息缺失。

title: The Stateless Pattern: Ephemeral Coordination as the Third Pillar of Digital Sovereignty
comments: The implementation is released under the AGPLv3 license at https://github.com/scarlin90/signingroom with source code publicly auditable at the associated GitHub repository, enabling independent verification and self-hosting for users requiring maximum sovereignty
summary: For the past three decades, the architecture of the internet has rested on two primary pillars - communication on the World Wide Web and Value such as Bitcoin/Distributed ledgers. However, a third critical pillar, Private Coordination has remained dependent on centralised intermediaries, effectively creating a surveillance architecture by default. This paper introduces the 'Stateless Pattern', a novel network topology that replaces the traditional 'Fortress' security model (database-centric) with a 'Mist' model (ephemeral relays). By utilising client-side cryptography and self-destructing server instances, we demonstrate a protocol where the server acts as a blind medium rather than a custodian of state. We present empirical data from a live deployment (https://signingroom.io), analysing over 1,900 requests and cache-hit ratios to validate the system's 'Zero-Knowledge' properties and institutional utility. The findings suggest that digital privacy can be commoditised as a utility, technically enforcing specific articles of the universal declaration of human rights not through policy, but through physics.
comment: The implementation is released under the AGPLv3 license at https://github.com/scarlin90/signingroom with source code publicly auditable at the associated GitHub repository, enabling independent verification and self-hosting for users requiring maximum sovereignty

AI.title_translation: 无状态模式：作为数字主权第三支柱的短暂协调
AI.tldr: 互联网的私人协调环节是中心化和受监视的。本文提出了“无状态模式”，使用客户端加密和自毁服务器实例，将服务器变成一个“盲”中介，从而实现零知识的私人协调，并使数字隐私成为一种技术强制执行的人权。
AI.motivation: 互联网的私人协调（Private Coordination）长期以来依赖中心化中介，默认创建了监控架构，损害了数字主权。作者旨在建立一个去中心化、保护隐私的“第三支柱”。
AI.method: 引入“无状态模式”网络拓扑。该模式用“迷雾”（ephemeral relays，短暂中继）模型取代传统的“堡垒”（数据库中心）安全模型。技术上利用客户端侧加密和自毁服务器实例，确保服务器只作为盲中介而非状态保管者。
AI.result: 通过对实时部署（signingroom.io）的1,900多个请求和缓存命中率的实证数据分析，验证了该系统的“零知识”特性和机构实用性。
AI.conclusion: 数字隐私可以被商品化为一种公用事业，通过技术（物理）而非政策，来强制执行《世界人权宣言》中的特定条款。
AI.translation: 在过去的三十年里，互联网的架构一直基于两大支柱——万维网上的通信和比特币/分布式账本等价值。然而，第三个关键支柱——私人协调——仍然依赖于中心化中介，这实际上默认创建了一个监控架构。本文介绍了“无状态模式”，这是一种新颖的网络拓扑结构，用“迷雾”（短暂中继）模型取代了传统的“堡垒”（以数据库为中心）安全模型。通过利用客户端侧加密和自毁服务器实例，我们演示了一种协议，其中服务器充当盲中介而不是状态保管者。我们提供了来自实时部署（https://signingroom.io）的经验数据，分析了超过1,900个请求和缓存命中率，以验证系统的“零知识”属性和机构实用性。研究结果表明，数字隐私可以作为一种公用事业商品化，通过物理（技术）而非政策，在技术上强制执行《世界人权宣言》的特定条款。
AI.summary: 本文提出“无状态模式”（Stateless Pattern），旨在解决数字主权中私人协调环节的中心化和监控问题。该模式是一种新的网络拓扑，利用客户端加密和短暂自毁的服务器实例，将服务器转变为零知识的“盲中介”（Mist model）。通过对实时部署数据的分析，证明了该模式的实用性和零知识特性，并提出数字隐私可以通过技术手段而非政策，成为一种可强制执行的人权公用事业。
AI.keywords: 无状态模式, 数字主权, 短暂协调, 零知识, 客户端加密
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将数字主权所需的私人协调提升到与通信和价值并列的“第三支柱”高度，并提出了一种激进的技术解决方案——“无状态模式”。通过用“短暂中继”（Ephemeral Relays）取代传统数据库安全模型，它提供了一个技术上保证零知识和隐私的框架。其重要性在于将隐私保护从依赖政策法规转向依赖“物理”（即技术强制），为实现真正的数字主权提供了具体的、可验证的实现路径。

title: Causal Pre-training Under the Fairness Lens: An Empirical Study of TabPFN
summary: Foundation models for tabular data, such as the Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN), are pre-trained on a massive number of synthetic datasets generated by structural causal models (SCM). They leverage in-context learning to offer high predictive accuracy in real-world tasks. However, the fairness properties of these foundational models, which incorporate ideas from causal reasoning during pre-training, remain underexplored. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation of TabPFN and its fine-tuned variants, assessing predictive performance, fairness, and robustness across varying dataset sizes and distributional shifts. Our results reveal that while TabPFN achieves stronger predictive accuracy compared to baselines and exhibits robustness to spurious correlations, improvements in fairness are moderate and inconsistent, particularly under missing-not-at-random (MNAR) covariate shifts. These findings suggest that the causal pre-training in TabPFN is helpful but insufficient for algorithmic fairness, highlighting implications for deploying TabPFN (and similar) models in practice and the need for further fairness interventions.

AI.title_translation: 在公平性视角下的因果预训练：对 TabPFN 的实证研究
AI.tldr: TabPFN是表格数据的基础模型，使用因果预训练。本研究实证评估了其准确性、鲁棒性和公平性。结果显示，虽然TabPFN准确性和鲁棒性较好，但其公平性提升有限且不稳定，尤其是在MNAR协变量偏移下。因果预训练对公平性有益但不足。
AI.motivation: 表格数据的基础模型（如TabPFN）利用因果推理进行预训练，取得了高预测精度，但其公平性属性尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 对TabPFN及其微调变体进行全面的实证评估，在不同的数据集规模和分布偏移（特别是缺失非随机，MNAR，协变量偏移）下，评估其预测性能、公平性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: TabPFN相比基线模型实现了更强的预测准确性，并对虚假相关性表现出鲁棒性。然而，其公平性改善是温和且不一致的，尤其是在缺失非随机（MNAR）协变量偏移下。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN中的因果预训练是有益的，但不足以保证算法公平性。这表明在实际部署TabPFN（及类似）模型时，需要进一步的公平性干预措施。
AI.translation: 表格数据的基础模型，例如表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN），是在由结构因果模型（SCM）生成的大量合成数据集上进行预训练的。它们利用情境学习在现实世界任务中提供高预测精度。然而，这些在预训练过程中融入了因果推理思想的基础模型的公平性属性仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们对TabPFN及其微调变体进行了全面的实证评估，评估了其在不同数据集规模和分布偏移下的预测性能、公平性和鲁棒性。我们的结果显示，虽然TabPFN相比基线模型实现了更强的预测准确性，并对虚假相关性表现出鲁棒性，但其公平性改善是温和且不一致的，尤其是在缺失非随机（MNAR）协变量偏移下。这些发现表明，TabPFN中的因果预训练是有益的，但不足以实现算法公平性，突显了在实际部署TabPFN（及类似）模型时的影响以及需要进一步的公平性干预措施。
AI.summary: 本文对表格数据基础模型TabPFN的公平性进行了首次综合实证研究。TabPFN通过结构因果模型生成的合成数据进行因果预训练。研究评估了TabPFN在准确性、鲁棒性和公平性方面的表现，涵盖了不同数据规模和分布偏移。结果表明，TabPFN在预测准确性和对虚假相关性的鲁棒性上表现优异，但在公平性上的提升有限且不稳定，特别是在MNAR偏移下。结论指出，因果预训练对公平性有帮助但不足够，强调了未来公平性干预的必要性。
AI.keywords: TabPFN, 因果预训练, 算法公平性, 表格数据, 分布偏移
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次系统地将公平性视角引入到对TabPFN这一新兴表格数据基础模型的评估中。它有效地衔接了因果推理、基础模型和算法公平性这三个重要领域。研究结果对于指导TabPFN等模型在敏感应用场景中的实际部署具有重要意义，明确指出了仅依赖因果预训练无法充分解决公平性挑战，为后续研究设定了明确的干预方向。

title: Streaming-dLLM: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Suffix Pruning and Dynamic Decoding
comments: Tech report. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoshideta/Streaming-dLLM
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a compelling paradigm for natural language generation, leveraging parallel decoding and bidirectional attention to achieve superior global coherence compared to autoregressive models. While recent works have accelerated inference via KV cache reuse or heuristic decoding, they overlook the intrinsic inefficiencies within the block-wise diffusion process. Specifically, they suffer from spatial redundancy by modeling informative-sparse suffix regions uniformly and temporal inefficiency by applying fixed denoising schedules across all the decoding process. To address this, we propose Streaming-dLLM, a training-free framework that streamlines inference across both spatial and temporal dimensions. Spatially, we introduce attenuation guided suffix modeling to approximate the full context by pruning redundant mask tokens. Temporally, we employ a dynamic confidence aware strategy with an early exit mechanism, allowing the model to skip unnecessary iterations for converged tokens. Extensive experiments show that Streaming-dLLM achieves up to 68.2X speedup while maintaining generation quality, highlighting its effectiveness in diffusion decoding. The code is available at https://github.com/xiaoshideta/Streaming-dLLM.
comment: Tech report. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoshideta/Streaming-dLLM

AI.title_translation: Streaming-dLLM：通过后缀剪枝和动态解码加速扩散大语言模型
AI.tldr: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）因冗余后缀和固定解码策略而效率低下。我们提出了Streaming-dLLM，一个免训练框架，通过后缀剪枝（空间优化）和动态置信度解码（时间优化），实现了高达68.2倍的加速，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在块级扩散过程中存在固有的低效性：具体表现为，空间上对信息稀疏的后缀区域进行统一建模造成冗余；时间上应用固定的去噪调度表导致效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Streaming-dLLM，一个免训练框架，从空间和时间维度简化推理。空间上，引入“衰减引导的后缀建模”来剪枝冗余的掩码标记，以近似完整的上下文。时间上，采用“动态置信度感知策略”和“提前退出机制”，允许模型跳过已收敛标记的不必要迭代。
AI.result: Streaming-dLLM在保持生成质量的同时，实现了高达68.2倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: Streaming-dLLM通过解决dLLMs的固有低效性，在扩散解码中展示了其有效性，实现了高达68.2倍的显著加速。
AI.translation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）为自然语言生成提供了一种引人注目的范式，它利用并行解码和双向注意力机制，实现了优于自回归模型的全局连贯性。虽然最近的工作通过KV缓存重用或启发式解码加速了推理，但它们忽略了块级扩散过程中固有的低效性。具体来说，它们通过统一建模信息稀疏的后缀区域而遭受空间冗余，并通过在所有解码过程中应用固定的去噪调度表而遭受时间低效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Streaming-dLLM，一个免训练的框架，它在空间和时间维度上简化了推理。在空间上，我们引入了衰减引导的后缀建模，通过剪枝冗余的掩码标记来近似完整的上下文。在时间上，我们采用了一种带有提前退出机制的动态置信度感知策略，允许模型跳过已收敛标记的不必要迭代。大量的实验表明，Streaming-dLLM在保持生成质量的同时，实现了高达68.2倍的加速，突显了其在扩散解码中的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/xiaoshideta/Streaming-dLLM获取。
AI.summary: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）因块级扩散过程中的空间冗余（后缀建模）和时间低效（固定去噪调度）而受到限制。Streaming-dLLM是一个免训练框架，通过引入衰减引导的后缀剪枝（空间优化）和动态置信度感知提前退出机制（时间优化），解决了这些固有问题。实验证明，该方法在保持生成质量的同时，能将推理速度提高高达68.2倍。
AI.keywords: 扩散大语言模型, Streaming-dLLM, 后缀剪枝, 动态解码, 推理加速
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于同时从空间（后缀建模）和时间（去噪调度）两个维度优化了扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的推理过程，专门针对块级扩散固有的低效性。作为一个“免训练”的框架，其实用性和易部署性极高。报告的68.2倍加速是一个非常显著的提升，表明该方法在使dLLMs适用于实时应用方面取得了重大进展。

title: MindCine: Multimodal EEG-to-Video Reconstruction with Large-Scale Pretrained Models
summary: Reconstructing human dynamic visual perception from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is of great research significance since EEG's non-invasiveness and high temporal resolution. However, EEG-to-video reconstruction remains challenging due to: 1) Single Modality: existing studies solely align EEG signals with the text modality, which ignores other modalities and are prone to suffer from overfitting problems; 2) Data Scarcity: current methods often have difficulty training to converge with limited EEG-video data. To solve the above problems, we propose a novel framework MindCine to achieve high-fidelity video reconstructions on limited data. We employ a multimodal joint learning strategy to incorporate beyond-text modalities in the training stage and leverage a pre-trained large EEG model to relieve the data scarcity issue for decoding semantic information, while a Seq2Seq model with causal attention is specifically designed for decoding perceptual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods both qualitatively and quantitatively. Additionally, the results underscore the effectiveness of the complementary strengths of different modalities and demonstrate that leveraging a large-scale EEG model can further enhance reconstruction performance by alleviating the challenges associated with limited data.

AI.title_translation: MindCine：基于大规模预训练模型的多模态脑电图到视频重建
AI.tldr: 提出MindCine框架，通过多模态联合学习和利用大规模预训练脑电模型，解决了现有脑电到视频重建中单模态和数据稀缺的问题，实现了高保真视频重建，并超越了现有最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 脑电图（EEG）具有非侵入性和高时间分辨率，因此从EEG信号重建人类动态视觉感知具有重要的研究意义。现有方法面临单模态限制（仅对齐文本，易过拟合）和数据稀缺导致难以收敛的问题。
AI.method: 提出了MindCine框架。采用多模态联合学习策略，在训练阶段结合了文本以外的模态。利用预训练的大规模EEG模型来缓解数据稀缺问题，用于解码语义信息。设计了一个带有因果注意力的Seq2Seq模型，用于解码感知信息。
AI.result: 实验证明，该模型在定性和定量上均优于现有最先进的方法。结果强调了不同模态互补优势的有效性，并表明利用大规模EEG模型可以通过缓解数据限制带来的挑战来进一步提高重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MindCine模型通过多模态联合学习和利用大规模预训练模型，成功解决了脑电到视频重建中的数据稀疏和单模态挑战，实现了高保真重建，并显著提高了性能。
AI.translation: 从脑电图（EEG）信号重建人类动态视觉感知具有重要的研究意义，因为EEG具有非侵入性和高时间分辨率。然而，EEG到视频的重建仍然具有挑战性，原因在于：1）单模态：现有研究仅将EEG信号与文本模态对齐，忽略了其他模态，并容易遭受过拟合问题；2）数据稀缺：当前方法通常难以在有限的EEG-视频数据下训练收敛。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了一个新颖的框架MindCine，以在有限数据上实现高保真视频重建。我们采用多模态联合学习策略，在训练阶段纳入了文本以外的模态，并利用一个预训练的大规模EEG模型来缓解数据稀缺问题以解码语义信息，同时专门设计了一个带有因果注意力的Seq2Seq模型来解码感知信息。大量的实验表明，我们的模型在定性和定量上均优于现有最先进的方法。此外，结果强调了不同模态互补优势的有效性，并证明利用大规模EEG模型可以通过缓解与有限数据相关的挑战来进一步增强重建性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MindCine框架，旨在解决脑电图（EEG）到视频重建中存在的单模态限制和数据稀缺问题。MindCine通过采用多模态联合学习策略，整合了文本以外的模态，并利用大规模预训练EEG模型来辅助语义解码，同时使用带因果注意力的Seq2Seq模型解码感知信息。实验结果表明，该模型在有限数据上实现了高保真视频重建，并在性能上超越了现有最先进的方法，证明了多模态和大规模预训练模型的有效性。
AI.keywords: 脑电图到视频重建, 多模态联合学习, 大规模预训练模型, 数据稀缺, 动态视觉感知
AI.comments: 该研究的重要性在于，它推进了利用非侵入性高时间分辨率的EEG信号进行动态视觉感知重建的领域。其创新点主要在于引入了“多模态联合学习”策略，突破了以往研究仅依赖文本模态的局限，以及创造性地利用“大规模预训练EEG模型”来解决生物信号处理领域普遍存在的数据稀缺和模型难以收敛的挑战。这种结合预训练大模型来处理小样本生物信号数据的思路，在未来神经科学与AI交叉领域具有巨大的潜力。

title: UTune: Towards Uncertainty-Aware Online Index Tuning
comments: 14 pages, 18 figures. An Extended version including detailed performance analysis
summary: There have been a flurry of recent proposals on learned benefit estimators for index tuning. Although these learned estimators show promising improvement over what-if query optimizer calls in terms of the accuracy of estimated index benefit, they face significant limitations when applied to online index tuning, an arguably more common and more challenging scenario in real-world applications. There are two major challenges for learned index benefit estimators in online tuning: (1) limited amount of query execution feedback that can be used to train the models, and (2) constant coming of new unseen queries due to workload drifts. The combination of the two hinders the generalization capability of existing learned index benefit estimators. To overcome these challenges, we present UTune, an uncertainty-aware online index tuning framework that employs operator-level learned models with improved generalization over unseen queries. At the core of UTune is an uncertainty quantification mechanism that characterizes the inherent uncertainty of the operator-level learned models given limited online execution feedback. We further integrate uncertainty information into index selection and configuration enumeration, the key component of any index tuner, by developing a new variant of the classic $ε$-greedy search strategy with uncertainty-weighted index benefits. Experimental evaluation shows that UTune not only significantly improves the workload execution time compared to state-of-the-art online index tuners but also reduces the index exploration overhead, resulting in faster convergence when the workload is relatively stable.
comment: 14 pages, 18 figures. An Extended version including detailed performance analysis

AI.title_translation: UTune：面向不确定性感知的在线索引调优
AI.tldr: 针对在线索引调优中反馈数据有限和工作负载漂移导致泛化能力差的问题，本文提出了UTune框架。UTune使用不确定性量化机制和改进的$\epsilon$-greedy搜索策略，显著提高了性能，减少了探索开销，并加快了收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的索引收益估计器在应用于在线索引调优时面临重大限制。主要挑战是：1) 可用于训练模型的查询执行反馈量有限；2) 由于工作负载漂移，不断出现新的未见查询。这两点阻碍了现有学习估计器的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了UTune，一个不确定性感知的在线索引调优框架。它采用操作符级别的学习模型以提高对未见查询的泛化能力。核心是一个不确定性量化机制，用于表征模型固有的不确定性。UTune通过开发一种新的、带有不确定性加权索引收益的经典 $\epsilon$-greedy 搜索策略变体，将不确定性信息整合到索引选择和配置枚举中。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，与最先进的在线索引调优器相比，UTune不仅显著改善了工作负载执行时间，而且减少了索引探索开销，从而在工作负载相对稳定时实现了更快的收敛。
AI.conclusion: UTune通过解决在线调优中的数据稀疏性和泛化挑战，显著优于现有技术，提高了性能并加快了收敛速度。
AI.translation: 最近出现了大量关于用于索引调优的已学习收益估计器的提案。尽管这些已学习的估计器在估计索引收益的准确性方面显示出比“假设”查询优化器调用更有希望的改进，但当它们应用于在线索引调优时（这在实际应用中是一个更常见、更具挑战性的场景），它们面临着重大的限制。对于在线调优中的已学习索引收益估计器来说，存在两个主要挑战：(1) 可用于训练模型的查询执行反馈量有限，以及 (2) 由于工作负载漂移，不断有新的未见查询出现。两者的结合阻碍了现有已学习索引收益估计器的泛化能力。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了UTune，一个不确定性感知的在线索引调优框架，它采用了操作符级别的学习模型，提高了对未见查询的泛化能力。UTune的核心是一个不确定性量化机制，用于表征给定有限在线执行反馈的操作符级别学习模型所固有的不确定性。我们通过开发一种带有不确定性加权索引收益的经典 $\epsilon$-greedy 搜索策略的新变体，进一步将不确定性信息整合到索引选择和配置枚举中，这是任何索引调优器的关键组成部分。实验评估表明，与最先进的在线索引调优器相比，UTune不仅显著改善了工作负载执行时间，而且减少了索引探索开销，从而在工作负载相对稳定时实现了更快的收敛。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UTune，一个不确定性感知的在线索引调优框架，旨在解决现有基于学习的收益估计器在在线场景中因反馈数据稀疏和工作负载漂移导致的泛化能力差的问题。UTune的核心是引入不确定性量化机制来评估操作符级别学习模型的固有不确定性，并通过不确定性加权的 $\epsilon$-greedy 搜索策略将其应用于索引选择。实验证明，UTune显著提高了工作负载执行时间，减少了探索开销，并实现了更快的收敛速度。
AI.keywords: 在线索引调优, 不确定性感知, 学习模型, $\epsilon$-greedy, 工作负载漂移
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将不确定性量化机制引入到在线索引调优中，以解决现实世界中数据稀疏性和工作负载动态变化导致的模型泛化能力不足的挑战。通过操作符级别的模型和不确定性加权搜索策略（改进的 $\epsilon$-greedy），UTune能够更智能地平衡探索与利用，尤其在反馈有限的在线环境中具有重要价值。这代表了数据库自治系统领域，特别是索引调优从纯粹的性能估计转向风险或不确定性管理的进步。

title: DMAP: Human-Aligned Structural Document Map for Multimodal Document Understanding
summary: Existing multimodal document question-answering (QA) systems predominantly rely on flat semantic retrieval, representing documents as a set of disconnected text chunks and largely neglecting their intrinsic hierarchical and relational structures. Such flattening disrupts logical and spatial dependencies - such as section organization, figure-text correspondence, and cross-reference relations, that humans naturally exploit for comprehension. To address this limitation, we introduce a document-level structural Document MAP (DMAP), which explicitly encodes both hierarchical organization and inter-element relationships within multimodal documents. Specifically, we design a Structured-Semantic Understanding Agent to construct DMAP by organizing textual content together with figures, tables, charts, etc. into a human-aligned hierarchical schema that captures both semantic and layout dependencies. Building upon this representation, a Reflective Reasoning Agent performs structure-aware and evidence-driven reasoning, dynamically assessing the sufficiency of retrieved context and iteratively refining answers through targeted interactions with DMAP. Extensive experiments on MMDocQA benchmarks demonstrate that DMAP yields document-specific structural representations aligned with human interpretive patterns, substantially enhancing retrieval precision, reasoning consistency, and multimodal comprehension over conventional RAG-based approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/Forlorin/DMAP

AI.title_translation: DMAP：面向多模态文档理解的人类对齐结构化文档地图
AI.tldr: 现有的多模态问答系统忽略了文档的内在结构。本文提出了DMAP，一个结构化文档地图，显式编码文档的层级和关系结构。DMAP使用结构化语义理解代理构建，并由反射推理代理进行结构感知推理，显著优于传统RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态文档问答（QA）系统主要依赖扁平的语义检索，将文档表示为不相关的文本块集合，忽略了人类理解文档时自然利用的内在层级和关系结构（如章节组织、图文对应、交叉引用），导致逻辑和空间依赖性被破坏。
AI.method: 1. 引入文档级结构化文档地图（DMAP），显式编码多模态文档中的层级组织和元素间关系。2. 设计“结构化语义理解代理”（Structured-Semantic Understanding Agent）通过组织文本内容、图表等构建DMAP，形成人类对齐的层级模式，捕获语义和布局依赖。3. 利用“反射推理代理”（Reflective Reasoning Agent）执行结构感知和证据驱动的推理，动态评估检索上下文的充分性，并通过与DMAP的交互迭代优化答案。
AI.result: 在MMDocQA基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DMAP生成了与人类解释模式对齐的文档特定结构表示，与传统的基于RAG的方法相比，显著提高了检索精度、推理一致性和多模态理解能力。
AI.conclusion: DMAP通过显式编码文档的层级和关系结构，有效地克服了传统扁平语义检索的局限性，实现了与人类理解模式对齐的结构感知推理，从而显著增强了多模态文档问答系统的性能。
AI.translation: 现有的多模态文档问答（QA）系统主要依赖扁平的语义检索，将文档表示为一组不相关的文本块，并在很大程度上忽略了它们固有的层级和关系结构。这种扁平化破坏了人类在理解时自然利用的逻辑和空间依赖性，例如章节组织、图文对应和交叉引用关系。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了一种文档级结构化文档地图（DMAP），它显式编码了多模态文档中的层级组织和元素间关系。具体来说，我们设计了一个结构化语义理解代理（Structured-Semantic Understanding Agent），通过将文本内容与图表等组织成一个人类对齐的层级模式来构建DMAP，该模式捕获了语义和布局依赖。基于这种表示，一个反射推理代理（Reflective Reasoning Agent）执行结构感知和证据驱动的推理，动态评估检索上下文的充分性，并通过与DMAP的定向交互迭代地完善答案。在MMDocQA基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DMAP生成了与人类解释模式对齐的文档特定结构表示，与传统的基于RAG的方法相比，显著增强了检索精度、推理一致性和多模态理解能力。代码可在https://github.com/Forlorin/DMAP获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DMAP（结构化文档地图），旨在解决现有多模态文档问答系统依赖扁平语义检索而忽略文档内在结构的问题。DMAP通过“结构化语义理解代理”显式编码文档的层级组织和元素关系。在此结构基础上，“反射推理代理”执行结构感知和证据驱动的推理，动态优化答案。实验证明，DMAP在MMDocQA基准测试上显著提升了检索精度和多模态理解能力。
AI.keywords: 结构化文档地图, 多模态文档理解, RAG, 层级结构, 结构感知推理
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于明确指出并解决了传统RAG方法在处理复杂文档结构时“扁平化”的局限性。通过引入DMAP这一结构化表示，并将构建和推理过程解耦为两个专门的代理（结构化语义理解代理和反射推理代理），该方法成功地将人类理解文档时的结构感知能力融入到机器推理中。这对于提升复杂科学文献、报告等具有强结构依赖性的文档的理解和问答性能具有重要意义。这是一个将认知科学中的结构化理解模式应用于大模型检索增强（RAG）范式的重要进展。

title: daVinci-Dev: Agent-native Mid-training for Software Engineering
summary: Recently, the frontier of Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities has shifted from single-turn code generation to agentic software engineering-a paradigm where models autonomously navigate, edit, and test complex repositories. While post-training methods have become the de facto approach for code agents, **agentic mid-training**-mid-training (MT) on large-scale data that mirrors authentic agentic workflows-remains critically underexplored due to substantial resource requirements, despite offering a more scalable path to instilling foundational agentic behaviors than relying solely on expensive reinforcement learning. A central challenge in realizing effective agentic mid-training is the distribution mismatch between static training data and the dynamic, feedback-rich environment of real development. To address this, we present a systematic study of agentic mid-training, establishing both the data synthesis principles and training methodology for effective agent development at scale. Central to our approach is **agent-native data**-supervision comprising two complementary types of trajectories: **contextually-native trajectories** that preserve the complete information flow an agent experiences, offering broad coverage and diversity; and **environmentally-native trajectories** collected from executable repositories where observations stem from actual tool invocations and test executions, providing depth and interaction authenticity. We verify the model's agentic capabilities on `SWE-Bench Verified`. We demonstrate our superiority over the previous open software engineering mid-training recipe `Kimi-Dev` under two post-training settings with an aligned base model and agentic scaffold, while using less than half mid-training tokens (73.1B).
